stories.h: Unemployment Insurance Fund reports a 30 million manat misstatement in 2025 accounts
stories.s: Audit found that investment‑related funds were omitted, resulting in actual receipts of 508.6 thousand manat versus reported 30 million manat, noted in the Hesablama Palatası’s budget draft feedback.

stories.h: Calculation Council proposes liquidation or privatization of unprofitable state enterprises
stories.s: In its review of the draft 2027 state budget law, the Council said measures are needed for entities that do not pay dividends or are consistently unprofitable, including restructuring or closure.

stories.h: Accounts Chamber says economic activity will drive 2027 state budget spending
stories.s: The chamber's analysis indicates that growth in economic output is expected to be the main source of financing for the 2027 budget, according to its report released on 2026-11-14.

stories.h: Privatization debt residues could add 140 million AZN to the 2027 state budget
stories.s: The Calculation Council noted that 140 million AZN from privatization is planned for 2027, 12 % above the 2026 forecast, and that 122.1 million AZN has already been received in the first nine months of 2026.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's Chamber of Accounts warns of $176 million customs revenue risk
stories.s: The state audit body said the customs system could cause a shortfall of $176 million to the state budget, urging corrective measures.

stories.h: AccessBank, Rabitəbank, Bank of Baku and Unibank offer the highest market‑shopping cashback rates in Azerbaijan
stories.s: AccessBank’s MyCard series gives up to 3% cashback (AZN 100 monthly), Rabitəbank’s Kartmane Premium offers 3% on AZN 20, Bank of Baku’s cards provide 5% on up to AZN 15 at Araz and Bravo, and Unibank’s UCard reaches 5% in Premium tier after meeting spend and deposit thresholds.

stories.h: CBAR caps guarantor debt-to-income at 70% for new consumer loans
stories.s: The rule signed by CBAR Chairman Taleh Kazımov on Sep 15 takes effect Nov 10, limiting guarantor monthly payments to 70% of their income and applying to credit requests after that date.

stories.h: Hesablama Palatası warns medium‑term fiscal risks could raise state debt service costs
stories.s: In its response to the 2027 budget draft, the council notes that higher-than‑expected reference rates may increase variable‑rate foreign debt costs, which already make up 48.8% of external debt, and that refinancing maturing obligations could further raise expenses.

stories.h: Hesablama Palatası forecasts 2027 inflation around 5.7%
stories.s: The board cites 2026 Jan‑Sept CPI up 5.7% annual, September inflation 5.5% annual and 0.9% monthly, with price pressures from food, services and import goods.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's consumer price inflation reached 5.6% in Jan-Oct 2026
stories.s: Food prices drove the rise with a 6.8% increase, while non-food goods rose 3.7% and services 5.4%; October alone saw a 0.3% month‑on‑month CPI rise and a 5.2% year‑on‑year rate.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's non-oil-gas exports rose 2.5‑fold to $6.6516 billion in Jan‑Sep 2026
stories.s: Total export volume grew 38.1% YoY to $25.5526 billion, while imports fell 20.4% to $13.3 billion, improving the trade balance.

stories.h: EBRD’s Azerbaijan portfolio reaches €879 million at end‑October
stories.s: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development reported that its holdings in Azerbaijan total €879 million as of the end of October, according to Trend News Agency.

stories.h: Birbank Biznes launches micro‑business loan campaign with up to 5% discount
stories.s: From 29 Oct to 30 Nov 2026, customers can apply fully online for loans of 500‑50,000 manat and receive a discount of up to 5% without collateral or guarantor, according to Birbank Biznes.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's net financial assets total $64.6 billion as of October
stories.s: The figure was released by national statistics, showing the country's overall financial asset base reached $64.6 bn by the end of October 2026.

stories.h: Yelo Bank launches 44‑day interest‑free cash loan up to AZN 80,000
stories.s: The offer, running until the end of November, provides interest‑free payments for the first 44 days on loans with annual rates starting at 8.9% and terms up to 59 months.

stories.h: Azerbaijan projects 129.6 million manats in subsidies for non‑state enterprises in 2027
stories.s: The Chamber of Accounts says the draft 2027 State Budget foresees a 67.5% rise, driven mainly by a 64.4 million‑manat boost for public‑transport reform subsidies.

stories.h: Moody's says Bank Respublika-AccessBank merger will create Azerbaijan's fourth-largest bank
stories.s: The rating agency assessed that the combination of systemically important Bank Respublika and AccessBank will rank fourth in assets among Azerbaijani banks, reshaping the local banking landscape.

stories.h: IMF projects Georgia's 2026 GDP growth at 7.2% and 2027 at 5.7%
stories.s: The forecast, discussed with Finance Minister Lasha Khutsishvili and National Bank Governor Natia Turnava, also expects a 1.5% budget deficit and public debt falling to 33% of GDP in 2026.

stories.h: ABB bonds oversubscribed with total orders of 22,173,200 manat
stories.s: The 15 million manat issue, split into 5 million manat 1‑year bonds at 8.5% and 10 million manat 2‑year bonds at 9%, attracted orders 1.5‑1.7 times the offering, fully allocated to 81 and 94 investors respectively.

stories.h: US banking regulators extend comment period for third‑party risk guidance to Dec 16
stories.s: The Federal Reserve, FDIC, OCC and NCUA pushed back the deadline from Nov 16 to Dec 16 for public comments on the proposed non‑binding guidance.

stories.h: Finance Ministry says analysis of Q3 financial results for 35 state enterprises is underway
stories.s: The ministry reported that reports covering Q1 for 10 entities and Q2 for 22 have been completed, and a new medium‑term debt limit for state firms will be set, with digital monitoring systems already in use.

stories.h: Finance Minister Sahil Babayev announces plan for an overall medium‑term borrowing limit for state enterprises
stories.s: The proposal was disclosed at the Finance Ministry Collegium meeting, alongside steps to align reporting with international standards and introduce a new budgeting scoring methodology from next year.

stories.h: OFAC issues new counter‑narcotics and counter‑terrorism designations
stories.s: The U.S. Office of Foreign Assets Control announced additional designations under its counter‑narcotics and counter‑terrorism authorities on 13 Nov 2026.

stories.h: Mexico cuts rates, sparking speculation of a weaker peso
stories.s: Traders say the move could help exports and tourism by easing the peso's strength, according to Bloomberg.

stories.h: Fed Boston President Susan Collins says tighter policy may be needed to curb inflation
stories.s: Collins signaled on Friday that the inflation fight could outweigh housing concerns, hinting at possible further rate hikes.

stories.h: İKZF opens new mortgage credit application window with 1,393 requests recorded
stories.s: The Mortgage and Credit Guarantee Fund started accepting applications at 15:00 on 13 Nov 2026, receiving 6,848 submissions overall, with biometric verification via SİMA İmza and real‑time processing through Mygov portal.

stories.h: Bank of Baku completes second Mini-MBA program with ADA University
stories.s: The 6‑month, 80‑hour program trained 25 senior Bank of Baku staff in finance, marketing and business analytics, concluding with a graduation ceremony attended by the bank's chair Həsən Quliyev and ADA vice‑rector Elkin Nurməmmədov.

stories.h: İpoteka və Kredit Zəmanət Fondu allocates limits for 1,393 mortgage applicants
stories.s: The fund opened applications on 13 Nov 2026, receiving 6,848 requests, with biometric SİMA İmza verification used for the first time.

stories.h: Fed Dallas President Lorie Logan urges separating market-functioning purchases from monetary‑policy assets
stories.s: Logan suggested the FOMC hold purchased securities in a separate account and sell them quickly to avoid unintended stimulus, speaking at a Dallas Fed‑cohosted funding conference.

stories.h: Foreign‑funded fixed capital investment in Azerbaijan rose 16.5% YoY to 3.5 bn manats in Jan‑Sep 2026
stories.s: The increase to 3.5 bn manats ($2.06 bn) was reported for the January‑September 2026 period, indicating stronger foreign financing of capital projects.

stories.h: Sabira Cahangirova acquires 1.69% of Legion Financial ASC, becoming a shareholder
stories.s: She received 700 shares with a nominal value of 100 manat each, while Konstantin Kolasa's stake fell to 4.60%, matching the new shareholding pattern of the leasing firm.

stories.h: EBA backs NGFS Declaration on macro‑financial energy transition at COP31
stories.s: The European Banking Authority said the declaration highlights energy price shocks and climate‑related shocks as macro‑financial realities and calls for an orderly whole‑economy transition, linking it to upcoming EU stress‑test climate modules.

stories.h: Foreign investment in Azerbaijan's economy rose by about 17%
stories.s: The increase was reported by Report.az on 13 November 2026, indicating a notable boost in external capital flows.

stories.h: CBAR reports 9‑month use of permanent liquidity tools by local banks
stories.s: In its 9‑month Monetary Policy Review, the Central Bank said 7‑day deposit auctions were held 62 times with an average operation size of 2.042 billion manat, while overnight repo usage was only 2% of business days.

stories.h: CBAR increased the number of repo auctions by about 24% in Jan‑Sep 2026
stories.s: The central bank held 146 repo auctions, 23.7% more than the same period last year, with total sterilised liquidity reaching 1.7 billion manat, 1.4 billion higher than a year earlier.

stories.h: Azerbaijani banks cut Bloomberg platform transactions by 42.5% in Jan‑Sep 2026
stories.s: They completed 1,648 deals worth 57.6 billion manats, a 11% rise in volume, with 95% of unsecured interbank money‑market trades lasting 1‑3 days, per the CBAR’s Monetary Policy Review.

stories.h: Azerbaijan introduces tax incentives to boost stock market investment
stories.s: The government announced new tax breaks aimed at attracting investors to the Baku Stock Exchange, hoping to increase market liquidity and listings.

stories.h: European stocks slipped after four‑day rally to record highs
stories.s: The rally ended as investors took profits following a busy week, causing the indices to pull back from their peak levels.

stories.h: CBAR announces cancellation of an insurance sector licence
stories.s: The Central Bank of Azerbaijan disclosed that a licence previously granted to an insurance entity has been revoked, citing regulatory compliance reasons.

stories.h: Legion Financial to raise 95,000 AZN by issuing 950 new shares on the Baku Stock Exchange
stories.s: The 950 ordinary, registered, uncertified shares with a 100 AZN nominal value will be placed by mass offer, giving the company net proceeds of about 92.35 k AZN and increasing charter capital to 4.225 million AZN if fully subscribed.

stories.h: Azerbaijani banks recorded 57.6 billion manat of unsecured interbank deals on Blumberg in nine months
stories.s: Between January and September 2026, 1,648 transactions totalling 57.6 billion manat were executed on the Blumberg platform, according to the Central Bank of Azerbaijan.

stories.h: IMF says Caucasus and Central Asia largely shielded from Middle‑East crisis
stories.s: Deputy director‑general Roberto Kardarelli notes low economic integration with Gulf states limits direct impact, but volatile energy prices and trade disruptions remain risks.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's Ministry of Finance named defendant in 388 court cases over nine months
stories.s: The Ministry was listed as a respondent in 388 legal proceedings during the past nine months, according to Report.az.

stories.h: Azerbaijan Ministry of Finance received over 1,500 applications in nine months
stories.s: The ministry said more than 1,500 requests were accepted between February and October 2026, reflecting increased activity in the sector.

stories.h: Finance Ministry reports 91 projects underwent financial expertisation in Jan‑Sep 2026
stories.s: Of the projects, 59 worth 1.038 billion manat were completed and 32 are ongoing, as part of the state investment efficiency plan for liberated territories.

stories.h: Unique term‑deposit customers rose 28% to 231,857 as of 1 Oct 2026
stories.s: Banco.az reports the number reached 231,857, up from the previous period, according to author Gülnar Əhmədli.

stories.h: Average yield of 3‑year Azerbaijani state bonds steadied around 7.25% at Baku exchange auction
stories.s: On 13 Nov the Ministry of Finance auctioned 1080‑day bonds, achieving a weighted‑average yield of 7.2482% with 22.65 million manat placed out of 200 million manat offered, down 34.2% from the previous auction.

stories.h: Russia's Zolotaya Korona payment system resumes transfers to Georgia via TBC Bank
stories.s: After a four‑month pause, the system now allows cash pickup or direct account transfers through TBC Bank branches, but other Georgian banks remain excluded, TBC Bank said on Nov 12.

stories.h: Turkey posts $2.72 billion current‑account surplus in September
stories.s: The surplus, driven by a lower trade gap and strong services inflows, narrowed the 12‑month rolling deficit to about 2.4% of GDP, while crypto transactions were recorded for the first time.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's unified treasury account generated 47 million manat in interest revenue over Jan‑Sep 2026
stories.s: The Finance Ministry's nine‑month report shows foreign‑currency funds earned 46.8 million manat in interest, continuing the effective management that yielded 121 million manat in 2025.

stories.h: Azerbaijan spent 1.6238 billion manat on 309 projects in nine months of the state investment programme
stories.s: The Finance Ministry report says 714.4 million manat went to transport, 320.1 million to water and drainage, 87.7 million to social projects, 186.2 million to energy and industry, 93.4 million to defence and law‑enforcement, and 222 million to other projects.

stories.h: Finance Ministry drafts 114 legal acts in first nine months of 2026
stories.s: The ministry reports 90 of them were approved, including 20 laws, 27 presidential decrees and 22 cabinet decisions, while reviewing 1,148 external proposals.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's tax arrears reach $2.5 billion
stories.s: The latest data shows total outstanding tax liabilities have climbed to $2.5 billion, according to Report.az.

stories.h: MP Vüqar İskəndərov proposes a 10‑year financial‑commitment passport for major state investment projects
stories.s: He suggested the mechanism during a joint committee session on the 2027 state budget draft, urging assessment of construction, operating, maintenance costs and savings before project approval

stories.h: IMF says Caucasus and Central Asia lag behind global average in export diversification
stories.s: Chief economist Florian Niş noted that while import volumes match global trends, export baskets remain concentrated, with oil exporters showing the lowest diversification scores.

stories.h: SOFAZ delegation votes Baku to host 2028 IFSWF Annual Meeting
stories.s: The International Forum of Sovereign Wealth Funds will hold its 2028 meeting in Baku, announced after a board vote in Athens attended by State Oil Fund of Azerbaijan officials.

stories.h: Azerbaijan State Oil Fund to host 2028 Sovereign Funds Forum in Baku
stories.s: The ARDNF delegation attended the 18th International Forum in Athens and secured Baku as the venue for the 2028 annual meeting, discussing geopolitics, AI investments and portfolio resilience.

stories.h: FSB Chair warns that lack of transparency can amplify financial shocks
stories.s: In a speech, the FSB Chair highlighted how opaque markets contributed to Black Monday 1987 and recent bond market volatility, calling for better data sharing on non‑bank leveraged positions.

stories.h: State Financial Monitoring Service returns 107 million manat to budget in nine months
stories.s: The agency reported that it recovered the amount over the first nine months of 2026, boosting state revenues.

stories.h: EU to present its 22nd sanctions package against Russia, says Commission President
stories.s: Ursula von der Leyen announced the upcoming sanctions package will be unveiled before the next European Council meeting, alongside a proposal to finance Ukraine's 2027 needs.

stories.h: CBAR invites listed insurance intermediaries to attend attestation on 20 Nov 2026
stories.s: The Central Bank of Azerbaijan announced that 11 named individuals must present ID at the attestation held at the ICT Center in Baku at 14:00, per Rule 2.4 of the insurance attestation regulation.

stories.h: Central Bank of Azerbaijan deputy governor Aliyar Mammadyarov met World Bank delegation to discuss sustainable finance
stories.s: The meeting covered Azerbaijan's macroeconomic outlook, efforts to promote sustainable finance, expand financing access and implement a risk‑based supervisory framework, as well as future cooperation opportunities.

stories.h: Turkish Investment Fund evaluates new transport and logistics projects in the Caspian region
stories.s: Fund director Ramil Babayev said the 600 million‑dollar fund is studying a China‑Kyrgyzstan‑Uzbekistan rail line and other Caspian corridor initiatives, with possible cooperation with Azerbaijan‑Uzbekistan Investment Company.

stories.h: IMF senior economist says structural reforms could offset up to 20% of consumption losses from external shocks
stories.s: Speaking at the IMF regional outlook presentation in Uzbekistan, Florian Misch warned that industrial policy offers little trade diversification and highlighted deregulation and public‑spending reallocation as low‑cost alternatives.

stories.h: IMF economist says fuel subsidies and central bank independence curb inflation transmission in Caucasus and Central Asia
stories.s: Karmen Naidoo highlighted that managed exchange rates and strong central bank autonomy reduce inflation spillovers, while deeper credit markets lessen CPI rises, urging a shift away from universal fuel subsidies.

stories.h: IMF says tight monetary policy and stronger currencies curb inflation in Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan
stories.s: Assistant Director Roberto Cardarelli highlighted that tight policy and nominal effective exchange‑rate gains reduced price growth, while looser policy in Kyrgyzstan spurred inflation, warning against broad energy subsidies.

stories.h: IMF urges Middle East and Central Asian countries to tighten monetary policy to curb inflation risks
stories.s: Assistant Director Roberto Cardarelli said at the IMF regional outlook in Uzbekistan that higher‑than‑expected inflation poses the main risk and central banks must act as the first line of defence, warning against broad fiscal subsidies.

stories.h: IMF says Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan and Turkmenistan will benefit amid geopolitical challenges
stories.s: Assistant Director Roberto Cardarelli noted oil‑exporting economies in the region have a positive development vector, while oil importers such as Uzbekistan will grow about 0.5% less and face higher inflation.

stories.h: IMF says Central Asian economies show stronger resilience than expected
stories.s: Assistant Director Roberto Cardarelli highlighted that trade‑flow redistribution and foreign investment are boosting credit cycles, and that connectivity and private‑sector growth are key to reducing regional vulnerability.

stories.h: Number of insured persons in Azerbaijan reaches 5.47 million
stories.s: By 1 Nov 2026 the individual insurance register recorded 5,467,767 people, up 164,000 (3.1%) from the previous year; Jan‑Oct 2026 saw a rise of 139,670 (2.62%) versus 2025.

stories.h: US Treasury yields surge, dampening hopes the worst of the bond rout is over
stories.s: The rise comes as investors reassess the market after recent declines, raising concerns about further pressure on bond prices.

stories.h: Xalq Bank raises USD deposit annual rate to up to 3%
stories.s: The new terms apply to USD‑denominated deposits, offering up to 3% annual yield with options for monthly or term‑end interest payouts, and a lottery for new deposits until 30 Dec 2026.

stories.h: Bitcoin falls below $70,000 as crypto market sells $1.23 bn of futures positions
stories.s: In the last 24 hours Bitcoin dropped about 6% to $68,500, with $677 million of liquidations in Bitcoin futures and $1.44 bn withdrawn from US spot Bitcoin ETFs, led by BlackRock's IBIT fund.

stories.h: Azerbaijan and the UK sign joint declaration to expand trade, investment and financial market cooperation
stories.s: The declaration, signed on Nov 12 in Dublin, pledges collaboration in renewable energy, infrastructure and green finance, and aims to boost UK direct investment in Azerbaijan, which reached $936.4 million in H1 2026, up 16.1% year‑on‑year.

stories.h: Federal Reserve cancels October 2027 FOMC meeting
stories.s: The Fed announced it will hold one fewer gathering next year, removing the October 2027 rate‑setting meeting from the calendar, per Bloomberg.

stories.h: Fed announces 1.4% fee increase for payment services effective Jan 1 2027
stories.s: The new schedule will recover 101.5% of costs, raising average prices by 1.4% for checks, ACH, instant and wholesale payments to banks and credit unions.

stories.h: Federal Reserve releases revised 2027 FOMC meeting schedule
stories.s: The Fed listed eight two‑day meetings for 2027, with policy decisions announced on the second day of each, except the October 26‑27 session dedicated to broad strategy issues.

stories.h: Azericard launches AI-powered behavioral scoring solution with Mastercard
stories.s: The tool analyzes payment transactions to give financial institutions richer risk analytics, and memorandums were signed with the Azerbaijan Fintech Association, Microfinance Association and Rabitəbank for cooperation.

stories.h: UK OFSI publishes new financial sanctions guidance and webinars
stories.s: The Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation released updated guidance, video series and sectoral advice to help entities comply with UK sanctions, including a Russian oil services ban module.

stories.h: Federal Reserve issues enforcement action against former United Community Bank employee
stories.s: The U.S. Federal Reserve Board announced the action on 2026-11-12, citing violations of banking regulations by the ex‑employee.

stories.h: Finance Minister Sahil Babayev meets World Bank officials to discuss improving dividend policy of state enterprises
stories.s: The talks covered cooperation status, fiscal stability, diversification, digital finance reforms and preparation for a global conference on state enterprises in April 2027.

stories.h: Azerbaijan and the World Bank discuss priority cooperation areas
stories.s: The meeting, reported by Trend News Agency, focused on potential projects and financing to support Azerbaijan's economic development.

stories.h: Fed Cleveland President Beth Hammack calls for a more restrictive rate policy
stories.s: Hammack said a tighter stance is needed to bring inflation back to the 2% target during an Ohio State University event.

stories.h: Böyük Britaniya Rusiyanın 10 ən böyük neft istehsalçısının hamısına və kölgə filotunun gəmilərinə sanksiya tətbiq edib
stories.s: Bu paket həmçinin böyük kömür şirkətlərini, "Rosneft"in "Vostok Oil" layihəsini və neft istehsalçısı "Slavneft"i hədəf alır, Rusiyanın neft və qaz tədarük zəncirinin əksər mərhələlərini əhatə edir.
stories.he: UK sanctions all 10 of Russia's largest oil producers and shadow fleet vessels

stories.h: Azerbaijan International Bank placed 15 million manat unsecured bonds in two tranches on Baku Stock Exchange
stories.s: The auction attracted 177 investors, with 94 investors submitting 13.752 million manat orders for the 24‑month, 9 % tranche and 83 investors submitting 8.422 million manat orders for the 12‑month, 8.5 % tranche, fully covering the issue.

stories.h: State budget revenues forecast to rise 1.7% to 47.6 billion manat in 2027
stories.s: Deputy Finance Minister Himalay Məmishov said non‑oil revenues will increase by 1.6 billion manat and oil‑gas transfers will fall by 935 million manat, leaving a projected deficit of 2.8 billion manat.

stories.h: BQ ASC to issue 13,600 unsecured 15% bonds worth 1.36 million manat
stories.s: The bonds, each with a 100 manat nominal value, will have a 7‑year term, monthly coupons of 1.25 manat and be placed on the Baku Stock Exchange via a mass‑offer method.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's Mortgage and Credit Guarantee Fund issues 50 million manat unsecured bonds
stories.s: The fund will place 50 000 bonds with a 1 000 manat nominal value, 3.25% annual interest and a 7 200‑day term via a mass offer on the Baku Stock Exchange, raising cash to finance sale‑to‑rent housing projects.

stories.h: Aqrarkredit to auction 7 non‑residential properties worth 2.49 million manat
stories.s: The auction starts on 9 Dec 2026 at 10:00 in Nizami district, with six properties in Xətai and one in Yasamal, initial prices ranging from 171,500 to 563,000 manat.

stories.h: PAŞA Kapital posts market‑leading trading volumes in first 10 months of 2026
stories.s: The investment firm executed 52,146 transactions, handling 49.85% of total market activity and topping volumes in government bonds, equities, CB notes and corporate bonds.

stories.h: US bank preferred securities portfolio of $22 billion faces steep losses
stories.s: Investors in a $22 billion pool of US bank preferred shares see the assets underperform even the riskiest junk bonds, with no clear exit strategy available.

stories.h: ECB expected to raise its key rate by 25 basis points in December
stories.s: A Reuters poll of 73 economists shows 64 (about 88%) anticipate the hike, moving the deposit rate from 2.50% to 2.75% as inflation hit 3.8% in September.

stories.h: CBAR publishes bank customer complaint index list
stories.s: The Azerbaijan Central Bank released the latest complaint index covering commercial banks' service usage, detailing the ranking of banks based on client grievances.

stories.h: Legion Financial places 1 million manat unsecured bond on Baku Stock Exchange
stories.s: The 10 000 bonds with 100 manat nominal each were fully subscribed by 52 investors in a single‑price auction, offering a 16% annual yield with monthly interest payments.

stories.h: PAŞA Yatırım Bankası posts 280 million lira net profit for Jan‑Sep 2026
stories.s: The profit is 36.8% lower than the same period last year, while pre‑tax profit fell 1.3% to 392 million lira and assets rose 25.3% to 17.83 billion lira.

stories.h: PAŞA Sığorta paid 31.503.421 manat in insurance claims over September and October 2026
stories.s: The insurer disbursed 15.737.87 manat in September and 15.766.334 manat in October, covering both voluntary and compulsory insurance obligations.

stories.h: Turkish Investment Fund allocates $10 million to Şekerbank for inclusive rural financing
stories.s: The fund joins a $170 million syndicated loan led by FMO, marking its first financing operation in Turkey, targeting micro, small and medium enterprises and women entrepreneurs.

stories.h: Turkish Investment Fund joins $170 million international credit facility
stories.s: The fund announced participation in a newly created credit line totaling $170 million to support its investment activities, according to Fed.az.

stories.h: Fransa naziri: Aİ 150 rusiya subyekti və 50 bank qarşısında sanksiya tətbiq edəcək
stories.s: Fransanın Avropa üzrə naziri Benjamin Haddad bəyan edib ki, Aİ bazar ertəsi paketi təsdiqləyəcək, əlavələrin əksəriyyətini isə Fransa təklif edir.
stories.he: EU to sanction 150 Russian entities and 50 banks, French minister says

stories.h: Binance Şimali Koreya ilə əlaqəli qrupa aid edilən haker hücumunda 6,3 milyard dollarlıq oğurluq barədə məlumat verib
stories.s: Hücum 'TraderTraitor' qrupuna aid edilib. Qrup işçi kompyuterini və daxili süni intellekt alətlərini istismar edərək cədlərə çıxış edib. Binance bildirir ki, 3 noyabra qədər təsirə məruz qalan aktivlərin 98%-i bərpa edilib.
stories.he: Binance reports $6.3 billion theft in hack attributed to North‑Korea‑linked group

stories.h: Qazaxıstan suveren varlıq fondu Samruk-Kazyna və dəmiryol operatoru KTZ-nin rəhbərlərini korrupsiya şübhəsi ilə saxlayıb
stories.s: Dövlət Təhlükəsizlik Komitəsi Nurlan Zhakupovun və Yelzhas Otynshiyevin noyabrın 11-də saxlanıldığını, istintaq tədbirlərinin davam etdiyini bildirib. Fond isə hüquq-mühafizə orqanları ilə tam əməkdaşlıq edəcəyini bəyan edib.
stories.he: Kazakhstan detains heads of sovereign wealth fund Samruk‑Kazyna and railway operator KTZ on corruption suspicion

stories.h: Liberal Economists Center head explains why Azerbaijani banks lower deposit rates
stories.s: Akif Nəsirli said banks cut rates when loan demand falls, liquidity is ample, and the central bank eases policy, reducing competition for deposits.

stories.h: AZIR interbank reference rate rose to 6.2361% on Oct 19
stories.s: The rate jumped 0.4384 percentage points from 5.7977% and remains 0.2639 points below the CBAR's 6.5% policy rate, with the lower corridor at 5% and upper at 7.5%.

stories.h: Turkish central bank lifts 2026 year‑end inflation forecast to 29.5% and 2027 forecast to 21%
stories.s: The forecast increase was attributed to effects related to the war in Iran, according to the bank’s announcement on Thursday.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's Business Development Fund allocated over 6 million manat in concessional loans to 110+ young entrepreneurs
stories.s: The fund, under the Ministry of Economy and announced by Deputy Minister Azər Bayramov, aims to support projects in industry, agriculture, services and tourism, plus training through the 4SIM centre.

stories.h: UNCTAD warns climate‑driven warming could cut global GDP by 10%
stories.s: The report says a 3 °C rise above pre‑industrial levels may erase 10 % of world GDP, up to 17 % in low‑income equatorial nations, and push temperature beyond the Paris 1.5 °C limit.

stories.h: Ruble and euro weaken against the Azerbaijani manat
stories.s: The latest market data shows the ruble and euro have depreciated relative to the manat, according to Fed.az on 2026-11-11.

stories.h: CBAR publishes daily rates: USD 1.7000, EUR 1.8832, RUB 2.0549 per manat
stories.s: The Central Bank of Azerbaijan's rates show the euro down 0.78% and the Russian ruble down 0.62% against the manat on 12 Nov 2026.

stories.h: Dentons advises international lenders on exiting AccessBank Azerbaijan
stories.s: The law firm is guiding the foreign shareholder group through the process of selling their stake in AccessBank, signalling a change in the bank's ownership structure.

stories.h: CME Group announces new physical uranium futures contract
stories.s: The launch follows a surge in nuclear power projects, aiming to provide market participants with a commodity-backed uranium product.

stories.h: David Rosenberg says a 50 bps Fed rate hike in December is possible but not certain
stories.s: Rosenberg, founder and President of Rosenberg Research, told Bloomberg the inflation report does not justify a firm 50‑basis‑point increase at the Fed's December meeting.

stories.h: EBRD plans $6 billion investment in Turkey renewable energy projects over five years
stories.s: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development will allocate the funds to solar, wind, grid upgrades, storage and equipment manufacturing as part of Turkey's REACT platform aiming for $300 billion by 2040.

stories.h: MKA warns of new "Azparking" phishing attacks targeting citizens
stories.s: Cybercriminals send fake "AZParking – Unpaid parking fee" messages with links to counterfeit sites that steal vehicle registration, phone and bank card details, MKA urges users to verify official domains and block cards if compromised.

stories.h: Qırğızıstan hökuməti Bars kurortunu sanksiyalara məruz qalmış rus qrupu Evrazia ilə əlaqəli QHT olan Edinstvo Naroda-ya satdı
stories.s: Jurnalistlər satışı təsdiqləyən torpaq qeydiyyat sənədlərini və Evrazia KG-dən 1,7 milyon dolların köçürüldüyünü, 2025-ci ildə isə demək olar ki, 8 milyon dollarlıq yardımın göstərildiyini əks etdirən vergi açıqlamalarını aşkar edib; bu, alıcıyı rus təsir kampaniyası ilə əlaqələndirir.
stories.he: Kyrgyz government sells Bars resort to Edinstvo Naroda, an NGO linked to sanctioned Russian group Evrazia

stories.h: Birbank Taksit cardholders can earn an extra 5% bonus on purchases in November
stories.s: From 1–30 November 2026, payments of 30 AZN or more with the Birbank Taksit card receive an additional 5% bonus, capped at 30 bonus points per customer, after registration on the campaign site.

stories.h: Sumqayıt‑Qərənfil ASC cancels 8,380 ordinary shares worth 16,760 manat
stories.s: The cancellation was approved at the shareholders' extraordinary meeting on 13 July 2026 and recorded under registration number AZL 001016646.

stories.h: Rusiya Mərkəzi Bankı Anatoly Levitinin müştərilərin broker hesablarından istifadə edərək obligasiya ticarətini manipulyasiya etdiyini müəyyən edib
stories.s: Levitan 2025-ci ildə öz və 11 müştərisinin hesablarında 18 milyon rubldən çox dəyərində 99 obligasiya əməliyyatı həyata keçirərək 470 min rubldən çox qazanıb. Ona cərimə kəsilib və növbəti pozuntulara yol verməkdən qadağan edilib.
stories.he: Bank of Russia finds Anatoly Levitin manipulated bond trading using clients' broker accounts

stories.h: Türkiyənin bank nəzarət orqanının sədri Şahap Kavcıoğlu Prezident Ərdoğanə istefa təqdim edib
stories.s: Kavcıoğlu bildirib ki, BDDK ilə bağlı ittihamlar və 400-dən çox şübhəli barəsində, ləğv edilmiş 131 fondla bağlı fond skandalı fonunda istefa verərək qurumu əlavə ziyanlardan qorumaq istəyib.
stories.he: Turkish banking watchdog chair Şahap Kavcıoğlu submits resignation to President Erdoğan

stories.h: Household loan placements in Azerbaijan near 20 billion manat
stories.s: By 1 October 2026, credit to households reached 19 billion 910 million manat, according to Banco.az.

stories.h: Azerbaijan proposes cash‑back on non‑VAT‑payer cashless purchases at 0.9%
stories.s: The Ministry of Economy’s State Tax Service deputy head Əvəz Quliyev announced the draft law would refund 0.9% of cashless payments made by consumers to non‑VAT‑registered entrepreneurs.

stories.h: Azerbaijan proposes tax exemption for domestic cargo carriers from VAT and profit tax
stories.s: The draft amendment to the Tax Code, presented by Deputy Head of the State Tax Service Evaz Guliyev, would allow carriers with turnover over 200,000 manat to choose an 8% simplified tax instead of VAT and profit tax, and extends tourism tax breaks for three years.

stories.h: Finance Minister Sahil Babayev says 2027 budget tax and customs exemptions will be based on economic and social criteria
stories.s: He announced the measures at a joint parliamentary committee meeting, emphasizing temporary, performance‑linked incentives to support the real sector and vulnerable groups.

stories.h: İpoteka Zəmanət Fondu adi ipoteka kreditləri üçün yeni limitlər ayırır
stories.s: Müraciətlər noyabrın 13-də 15:00-da Mygov portalı vasitəsilə, elektron imza ilə qəbul olunur; qalan limit müraciətləri cümə günləri 12:00-da qəbul edilir.
stories.he: Mortgage Guarantee Fund allocates new limits for ordinary mortgage loans

stories.h: Finance Minister Sahil Babayev says 2027 pension indexation will exceed inflation
stories.s: He noted current inflation at 5.6% and a 5.3% forecast, with pension indexation based on average wage growth expected to be higher, while a social package of about 1.6 billion manat will be funded from budget reserves.

stories.h: Turkey arrests former Takasbank CEO amid market‑manipulation probe
stories.s: Police detained the ex‑chief of Takasbank and several other financial executives as the investigation into a market‑manipulation scandal widens, reported by Anadolu Agency.

stories.h: Finance Minister Sahil Babayev says non‑oil revenue coverage rose to 90.1%
stories.s: He noted the ratio is 2.1 percentage points higher than in 2026 and aims for 100% by 2030, while non‑oil share in the budget reached 64.5%, up 1.5 points, with a 70.4% target for 2030.

stories.h: Maliyyə Nazirliyi Bakı Birjasında 200 milyon manatlıq 1080 günlük dövlət obligasiyalarının auksionunu keçirəcək
stories.s: Auksion 13 noyabr 2026-cı ildə 10:00-dan 11:00-a qədər keçiriləcək. Kupon dərəcəsi 7.0%, ISIN AZ0201270011, emisiya agent isə PAŞA Kapital İ.Ş.-dir.
stories.he: Ministry of Finance to auction 200 million manat 1080‑day state bonds on Baku Stock Exchange

stories.h: CBAR places a 40 million manat 28‑day discount note on Baku Stock Exchange
stories.s: The auction sold the full 40 million manat issue at an average price of 99,499.1404 manat (6.47% yield) with four investors submitting orders totaling 53.2 million manat nominal.

stories.h: Islamic Development Bank Group and OIC agree to draft a new memorandum of cooperation
stories.s: The groups plan to update their 2010 framework, focusing on infrastructure, trade and investment financing, with a target of $227 billion in financing by end‑September 2026.

stories.h: Azerbaijan expects 60.6% of 2027 budget revenues from the non‑oil sector
stories.s: The Ministry of Finance said the share of non‑oil revenues will rise to 60.6% in 2027, reflecting the government's diversification push.

stories.h: Fixed‑capital investments in Azerbaijan reached AZN 16.52 billion in Jan‑Oct, up 9.7% YoY
stories.s: The increase reflects a near‑10% rise in real terms compared with the same period last year, according to Report.az data.

stories.h: State Accounting Chamber recommends adopting a "green budget" mechanism
stories.s: Chairman Vüqar Gülməmmədov urged detailed budget forecasts, revised off‑budget definitions and inclusion of medical insurance payments during the joint committee session on the 2027 budget draft.

stories.h: Nakhchivan tax revenues rose 11% year‑to‑date to 231.7 million manat
stories.s: The State Tax Service under the Nakhchivan Ministry of Economy reported 231.7 million manat collected Jan‑Oct, 10.9% higher than the same period last year, with non‑state sector revenues up 18.5% and unemployment insurance contributions up 2% to 3.8 million manat.

stories.h: Azərbaycan CBAR nəzarətində elektron maaş ödəniş mexanizmini tətbiq edəcək
stories.s: Nazir müavini Zaur Əliyev bildirib ki, sistem Nazirliyin elektron informasiya sistemindən və CBAR tərəfindən təsdiqlənmiş ödəniş kanallarından istifadə edərək həqiqi maaş ödənişlərini izləyəcək və gizli və ya azaldılmış ödənişlərin qarşısını alacaq.
stories.he: Azerbaijan to introduce electronic salary‑payment mechanism overseen by CBAR

stories.h: Deputy Minister Azer Bayramov forecasts 4.4% annual growth for Azerbaijan's non‑oil sector 2027‑2030
stories.s: He said the sector's GDP share should reach 82% by 2030 and outlined new support measures such as state‑covered loan interest and higher credit guarantees.

stories.h: Deputy Economy Minister Azer Bayramov says non‑oil sector to grow 5.2% annually 2022‑2026, beating strategy target
stories.s: He made the comment at a joint parliamentary committee meeting discussing the draft 2027 state budget, noting the sector drives macro‑stability despite global uncertainty.

stories.h: Finance Minister Sahil Babayev says 32.5% of Azerbaijan's 2027 state budget is investment‑oriented
stories.s: He added that total budget expenditures equal 46.2% of non‑oil‑gas GDP, highlighting the budget's focus on investment projects.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's state budget surplus reaches AZN 4.8 billion in first ten months of 2026
stories.s: Revenues rose 2.1% to AZN 33.57 billion while expenditures grew 3.8% to AZN 28.76 billion, boosting the surplus by 21.3% year‑on‑year.

stories.h: World Bank discusses up to $1.2 billion of potential Middle Corridor investments with Azerbaijan
stories.s: Regional Director Rolande Pryce said projects are under preparation in Kazakhstan and Turkey, while no specific financing is committed to Azerbaijan yet, pending project preparation.

stories.h: FSB urges Turkey to strengthen crypto‑asset and stablecoin regulatory framework
stories.s: The Financial Stability Board’s peer review notes progress in Turkey’s crypto regulation but calls for a dedicated stablecoin regime, financial‑stability monitoring and tighter supervision.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's GDP grew 1.7% in January–October 2026
stories.s: Nominal GDP reached AZN 115.93 billion ($68.2 billion); non‑oil sector expanded 2.9% while oil and gas fell 0.9%, the State Statistics Committee reported.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's average annual inflation was 5.6% in the first 10 months of 2026
stories.s: The State Statistics Committee reported the figure, citing Report.az on 11 November 2026.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's external public debt fell to $4 billion 481.2 million as of Nov 1, about 8% lower year‑on‑year
stories.s: State Statistics Committee data show the debt dropped 7.7% from $4 billion 813.5 million a year earlier, with a $28.3 million decline in October alone.

stories.h: FINCA Azerbaijan to issue 5 million manat unsecured bond at 15% interest
stories.s: The micro‑finance institution will place 50 000 bonds of 100 manat each on the Baku Stock Exchange for 18 months, with quarterly interest payments, to fund SME and agricultural lending expansion.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's strategic foreign currency reserves rise to $88.55 billion, up 7.3% YoY
stories.s: The State Statistics Committee reported the reserves reached $88.55 billion as of November 1, marking a 7.3% increase from the previous year.

stories.h: ING forecasts Azerbaijan's economic growth to accelerate in 2027
stories.s: The Dutch bank's analysis projects a higher GDP growth rate for Azerbaijan next year, citing expected improvements in oil revenues and investment climate.

stories.h: ING Group forecasts Azerbaijan inflation at 6% in 2028
stories.s: The Dutch bank projects average annual inflation of 5.7% in 2026, 5.4% in 2027 and raises the 2028 estimate by 0.7 percentage points to 6%, unchanged for 2026‑2027.

stories.h: Canada reinstates sanctions on 11 Iranian entities including Bank Melli Iran Baku Branch
stories.s: The measures target banks, energy, finance and insurance firms after Tehran failed to meet nuclear‑non‑proliferation obligations, reversing a 2016 de‑listing

stories.h: CBAR publishes November 11 2026 official exchange rates
stories.s: The rates include $ at 1.7000 manat, € at 1.8981 manat, £ at 2.2693 manat and RUB 100 at 2.0422 manat, among others, with no buying or selling obligations.

stories.h: Brent crude rises to $92.55 per barrel and WTI to $86.76 on Nov 11
stories.s: Both benchmarks gained about 1% amid Middle‑East geopolitical tension and US weekly crude‑stock increase, with Brent up 1.08% and WTI up 1.02% from the previous close.

stories.h: ING forecasts Azerbaijan Central Bank will keep key rate unchanged in 2027
stories.s: ING's baseline scenario expects the CBAR to maintain its policy rate at current levels next year, citing strong currency and real rates, while neighboring Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan may ease cautiously.

stories.h: CBAR məcburi avtomobil sığorta şirkətləri üzrə şikayət indeksini və zəyan nisbətlərini açıqladı, Xalq Sığorta 1.43 ilə şikayətlər üzrə birincidir
stories.s: 2025-ci il 1 noyabr – 2026-cı il 31 oktyabr dövrünü əhatə edən məlumatlara görə, Meqa Sığorta (1.18) və PAŞA Sığorta (1.12) onu izləyir, Qala Sığorta isə ən aşağı şikayət indeksinə (0.65) malik olsa da, ən yüksək zəyan nisbətinə (118.86%) sahibdir.
stories.he: CBAR publishes complaint index, loss ratios for compulsory auto insurers, Xalq Sığorta tops complaints at 1.43

stories.h: Anthropic aims to raise up to $90.4 bn in IPO targeting $1.4 trillion valuation
stories.s: The AI firm plans to price the offering on Nov 18, offering 801.4 million new shares at $70‑78 each, with Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley among the 22 banks leading the deal.

stories.h: Ruble rises against the manat while euro weakens
stories.s: The Central Bank of Azerbaijan reported that the Russian ruble appreciated versus the manat and the euro depreciated, according to the latest exchange rates released on 2026-11-10.

stories.h: CBAR keeps USD at 1.7000 manat on 13 Nov 2026
stories.s: The Central Bank of Azerbaijan reported the official rates for 13 Nov 2026, with the euro at 1.8805 manat and 100 RUB at 2.0511 manat, while the dollar remained unchanged.

stories.h: US dollar strengthens against the euro, pound and other major currencies after inflation data
stories.s: The currency market showed the dollar gaining ground following the release of inflation figures, with the dollar index rising and bond yields adjusting accordingly.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's current account surplus projected to stay positive through 2031
stories.s: The forecast shows a $1.7508 billion surplus in 2027, dropping to $503 million in 2028, then rising to $902 million in 2029 and $1.3335 billion in 2030, with a positive balance expected until 2031.

stories.h: Georgia's Vice PM says Middle Corridor success needs infrastructure investment and border simplification
stories.s: Mariam Kvrivishvili told the GGFCI council in Antalya that the country seeks stronger cooperation with international financial institutions and private sector for climate financing.

stories.h: Kazakhstan to launch QR payment links with eight countries, including Azerbaijan
stories.s: The Kazakh Ministry of Digital Development announced the project will enable QR‑code based cross‑border payments, targeting rollout later this year across the selected partners.

stories.h: Managed Funds Association asks SEC and CFTC to slow 24/7 trading rollout
stories.s: In a letter to US regulators, the association urged the Trump administration to proceed cautiously with round‑the‑clock trading, citing market stability concerns.

stories.h: Fed Dallas President Logan says FOMC should raise rates at least two more times
stories.s: Logan told a conference in Houston that, given the outlook, the Fed needs to implement two additional 25‑basis‑point hikes.

stories.h: ECB Governing Council member Joachim Nagel says a December rate hike is “rather obvious”
stories.s: Nagel told Bloomberg Television in Riga that inflation remains too high, making a rate increase in December likely to tame price pressures.

stories.h: Carlyle's Thomas says Fed may raise rates by 50 bps in December
stories.s: Thomas cited hotter‑than‑expected U.S. CPI data and warned about AI investment risks while discussing the possible rate hike on Bloomberg Open Interest.

stories.h: AFB Bank leads consumer loan portfolio growth by 58.8% to 103.2 million manat in first nine months of 2026
stories.s: Bank VTB Azerbaijan posted a 47.3% rise to 163.9 million manat, while Bank of Baku added 30.2% reaching 911 million manat, according to Fed.az data comparing end‑2025 to September‑2026.

stories.h: Kapital Bank leads Azerbaijan consumer loan portfolio ranking with 3.5369 bn manat
stories.s: ABB holds the second‑largest portfolio at 2.2441 bn manat and Bank of Baku is third with 0.911 bn manat, according to data as of 30 Sept 2026.

stories.h: EU pushes for joint borrowing to finance Ukraine using frozen Russian assets
stories.s: The European Commission and several member states aim to expand joint borrowing to meet Ukraine's financing needs, despite delays caused by Belgium over the use of Russia's frozen central‑bank assets.

stories.h: CBAR caps guarantor debt‑to‑income at 70% for new consumer loans
stories.s: Effective 10 Nov, the rule signed by CBAR chair Taleh Kazımov requires guarantors' monthly debt payments not to exceed 70% of their income, applying to credit requests after that date.

stories.h: JPMorgan strategist says Fed should not raise rates by 50 bps
stories.s: David Kelly argued the half‑point hike is unnecessary after the CPI came in higher than expected, speaking on Bloomberg Surveillance.

stories.h: Bank of Korea Governor Hyun Song Shin appointed chair of BIS CPMI for three years
stories.s: He took office on 1 Nov 2026, succeeding Fabio Panetta, while Bank of Canada Governor Tiff Macklem’s CCA chair term was extended to 31 Mar 2027 and Argentina’s Santiago Bausili will assume the CCA chair role on 1 Apr 2027.

stories.h: Binance-in maliyyə direktoru Kaiser Ng 6,3 milyard dollarlıq hücumdan bir həftə sonra istefa verir
stories.s: Binance Airwallex-in keçmiş maliyyə vitse-prezidenti Justin Yek-i yeni maliyyə direktoru təyin edib; bu istefa, 6 milyard dollardan çox oğurlayan Şimali Koreya qrupuna aid edilən 29 oktyabr tarixli sızmadan sonra baş verib.
stories.he: Binance CFO Kaiser Ng resigns a week after $6.3 billion hack

stories.h: Fed Governor Christopher Waller discusses rates, market pricing and the US economy
stories.s: In a Bloomberg video, Waller provided his view on the current interest‑rate outlook and how markets are pricing future policy moves.

stories.h: PAŞA Sığorta (9 ay, 2026): xalis mənfəət 21,883 milyon manat (−10,65 %); aktivlər 539,947 milyon manat (+36,1 %); kapital 106,037 milyon manat (+1,1 %)
stories.he: PAŞA Sığorta reports 21.883 million manat net profit for Jan‑Sep 2026

stories.h: Latvia central bank governor Kazāks says further rate hikes may be needed if energy prices stay high
stories.s: He told Bloomberg TV that policy trade‑offs are becoming more nuanced as officials balance price stability with growth risks.

stories.h: Xalq Həyat Sığorta posts 2.145 million manat profit for Jan‑Sep 2026, up 10.3% YoY
stories.s: Revenue reached 11.684 million manat (15.2% higher) while expenses rose 14.8% to 9.251 million manat, and profit tax paid 288 thousand manat, 2.1 times more than a year earlier.

stories.h: Xalq Sığorta (9 ay, 2026): xalis mənfəət 5,74 milyon manat (+9 %); aktivlər 95,512 milyon manat (−2,4 %); kapital 61,782 milyon manat (−2,1 %)
stories.he: Xalq Sığorta reports 5.74 million manat net profit for Jan‑Sep 2026

stories.h: Qala Həyat Sığorta (9 ay, 2026): xalis mənfəət 7,88 milyon manat (+1 %); aktivlər 56,394 milyon manat (+8,65 %)
stories.he: Qala Həyat Insurance posts 7.88 million manat net profit for Jan‑Sep 2026

stories.h: Azerbaijan extends VAT exemption for domestically produced agricultural products until end‑2029
stories.s: The draft law amending the Tax Code, part of the 2027 budget package, also keeps wheat imports, flour and bread sales VAT‑free for the same period.

stories.h: SOCAR plans $7 billion Turkish petrochemical investment, including $70 million FEED for a new 850,000‑ton polyethylene complex
stories.s: The project will use UNIPOL PE technology from Univation Technologies and aims to finish FEED work by end‑2027, while a $120 million jet‑fuel unit at STAR refinery targets an extra 600 kton diesel output by Q1 2029.

stories.h: Meqa Həyat Sığorta (9 ay, 2026): xalis mənfəət 3,409 milyon manat (+40,5 %); aktivlər 45,851 milyon manat (+2,7 %); kapital 18,124 milyon manat (+19,75 %)
stories.he: Meqa Həyat Sığorta posts 3.409 million manat net profit for Jan‑Sep 2026

stories.h: Qala Sığorta (9 ay, 2026): xalis mənfəət 5,054 milyon manat (−54,1 %); aktivlər 96,98 milyon manat (+1,05 %)
stories.he: Qala Insurance net profit falls 54.1% to 5.054 million manat in Jan‑Sep 2026

stories.h: ECB chief economist Philip Lane says the ECB should not adjust bond run‑off or use crisis tools for France
stories.s: Lane told Bloomberg that any fixes must come from Paris, rejecting the use of ECB balance‑sheet measures to ease France's budget problems.

stories.h: Azərbaycanda maliyyə cərimələri ən azı 1 000 manata, bəyan edilməmiş vəsaitlərin 10%-inə qaldırılacaq
stories.s: Vergi Məcəlləsinin 76-1.1-ci maddəsinə edilən dəyişiklik uyğunsuz hesablarda saxlanılan məbləğin 10%-i səviyyəsində cərimə müəyyən edəcək, lakin bu 1 000 manatdan aşağı olmayacaq; mövcud 30% səviyyəsindən dəyişdiriləcək. Həmçinin, heç bir vəsaitin yox olduğu hesablar üçün cərimələr hər biri 400-1 000 manata qaldırılacaq.
stories.he: Azerbaijan to raise financial sanctions to at least 1,000 manat, 10% of undeclared funds

stories.h: Fed Governor Christopher Waller backs a December rate hike and says he could support a half‑percentage‑point increase
stories.s: Waller made the remarks at the Bank of England and Its Watchers event, warning that higher inflation could require more robust action by the FOMC.

stories.h: CBAR bans use of behavior‑model income forecasts in loan underwriting
stories.s: Effective 10 Nov, banks must rely only on documented or state‑verified borrower income and cannot use predicted income from behavior models, per the decision signed by CBAR Chairman Taleh Kazımov on 15 Sep.

stories.h: Azərbaycan Sənaye Sığorta ASC (ASS) (9 ay, 2026): xalis mənfəət 769 min manat; aktivlər 32,913 milyon manat (−7,55 % az); kapital 10,356 milyon manat (−4,85 % azalaraq)
stories.he: Azerbaijan Industry Insurance posts 769,000 manat net profit for Jan‑Sep 2026

stories.h: AzSığorta reports 458 000 manat net profit for Jan‑Sep, down 63.25% YoY
stories.s: Revenue fell 12% to 8.949 million manat and profit tax paid dropped 63% to 115 000 manat, while assets decreased 3.2% to 29.777 million manat.

stories.h: Unemployment insurance premiums will be paid only cashlessly in Azerbaijan
stories.s: The amendment to the Unemployment Insurance Law requires insurers to transfer the full monthly premium by non‑cash settlement by the 15th of the following month, per Labour Code article 175.

stories.h: Atəşgah Həyat Sığorta (9 ay, 2026): xalis mənfəət 12,911 milyon manat (+55,1 %); aktivlər 128,667 milyon manat (−10,8 %); kapital 21,594 milyon manat (+11,8 %)
stories.he: Atəşgah Həyat Sığorta posts 12.911 million manat net profit for Jan‑Sep 2026

stories.h: Azərbaycan qiymətli kağızın satış qiyməti ilə alış xərcləri arasındakı fərqi vergiləndirəcək
stories.s: 2027-ci il büdcə layihəsinə daxil edilən Vergi Məcəlləsinə edilən dəyişiklik qiymətli kağızın satışından əldə olunan gəlirlər, alış qiyməti və bağlı xərclər arasındakı fərqi vergi obyekti kimi müəyyən edir. Bu, əvvəllər yalnız birja üzrə səhmlərə tətbiq olunan qaydanı genişləndirir.
stories.he: Azerbaijan to tax the margin between bond sale price and purchase cost

stories.h: Azerbaijan's business loans top $10.8 billion as large firms stay dominant
stories.s: The latest data show total business lending reached $10.8 billion, with large enterprises accounting for the majority of the portfolio.

stories.h: İpək Yolu Sığorta posts 743,000 AZN net profit for Jan‑Sep 2026
stories.s: Net profit rose 52.9% year‑on‑year to 743 000 AZN, with revenues of 9.144 million AZN and expenses of 8.216 million AZN in the nine‑month period.

stories.h: Dövlət büdcə ehtiyat fondu payının yuxarı həddi 5%-dən 7%-ə qaldırılıb
stories.s: 2027-ci il büdcə layihəsinə daxil edilən dəyişiklik ehtiyat fondu ayrılımlarının yuxarı həddini büdcə gəlirlərinin 7%-inə qaldırır. Prezidentin ehtiyat fondu 300 milyon manat, büdcə ehtiyat fondu isə 110 milyon manat müəyyən edilib.
stories.he: Upper limit of state budget reserve fund share raised from 5% to 7%

stories.h: CBAR introduces new credit‑risk assessment rule for firms and individuals selling goods on credit
stories.s: The rule, signed by CBAR Governor Taleh Kazımov on 15 September, takes effect 10 November and requires banks to compare borrowers' reported sales‑portfolio data with credit‑bureau information, classifying loans as unsatisfactory if consistency falls below 90 %.

stories.h: Azerbaijan and Uzbekistan central banks hold a management‑experience exchange
stories.s: The two central banks met to share best practices on supervisory and operational matters, according to the joint statement released after the session.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's industrial lending falls to $6.8 million while short‑term foreign loans rise to $16.9 million
stories.s: The latest data show a decline in domestic industrial credit and a notable increase in short‑term foreign borrowing, according to the published figures.

stories.h: EU launches €623 million digital connectivity programme for South Caucasus and Central Asia
stories.s: The plan, presented at the High‑Level Platform meeting in Chisinau, targets 5G, satellite, AI and data‑centre infrastructure along the Middle Corridor.

stories.h: Coinbase receives final OCC approval to create a federal trust bank
stories.s: The OCC approved Coinbase National Trust Company on Nov 6, allowing the crypto exchange to hold digital assets for institutional clients under federal supervision, though it cannot take deposits or make loans like a traditional bank.

stories.h: EBA cuts data points for 2027 EU stress test by 55% and adds climate risk module
stories.s: The European Banking Authority released the final methodology, templates and guidance, streamlining reporting and introducing a dedicated climate‑risk module, with the exercise to start in January 2027 and results due by July 2027.

stories.h: Euro-zone governments consider ECB presidency plus two other jobs
stories.s: Ministers are reviewing candidates and aim to agree on a combined package for the ECB president role and two additional positions, according to Bloomberg.

stories.h: Mexico's annual inflation accelerates in October
stories.s: The rise exceeds expectations and may increase scrutiny of Banxico's recent rate cut despite ongoing price pressures.

stories.h: PNC launches pilot allowing corporate clients to receive USDC payments
stories.s: The pilot lets corporate customers receive Circle's USDC on Ethereum, automatically converting it 1‑to‑1 into dollars and depositing into PNC accounts, with no disclosed number of participants.

stories.h: Türkiyənin Ədalət naziri: Fond böhranıyla əlaqəli 464 şübhəli müəyyən edilib, 120-si saxlanılıb
stories.s: Aktiv idarəçiləri investorlara ödənişi geri qaytara bilmədikdən sonra başlatılan təhqiqat çərçivəsində həmçinin 262 nəfərə qarşı məhkəmə nəzarəti tədbirləri tətbiq edilib, 40 axtarış buğurması verilib, 386 şəxsin və 116 subyektin əmlakı hədəfə alınıb. TMSF-nin könüllü proqramı çərçivəsində 31,5 milyard TL qaytarılıb.
stories.he: Turkey's Justice Minister says 464 suspects linked to fund crisis, 120 detained

stories.h: Banks prioritize AI augmentation over automation to boost productivity
stories.s: Banks are focusing on AI tools that assist staff, such as C&R Software's Collector Assist, which can raise productivity by up to 14% and improve collections handling, while keeping human judgment for compliance and risk.

stories.h: EBA publishes consumer factsheet on white‑labelled financial products and services
stories.s: The factsheet explains how to identify the actual provider behind a branded product, what to check before purchase and how complaints are handled, aiming to boost transparency for online‑banking users.

stories.h: EIB acquires preferred shares in Bank Respublika after merger with AccessBank
stories.s: The European Investment Bank sold its ordinary shares in AccessBank for cash and received preferred shares in Bank Respublika, completing the merger that gave it a 17.39% stake in AccessBank and a strategic position in the combined entity.

stories.h: Major UK banks restrict AI agents from accessing customer accounts
stories.s: JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon warned of new risks, while Charles Schwab blocks AI-driven transactions for 10‑20 clients weekly, and several UK banks limit AI access following similar moves by US banks.

stories.h: Japan spends record $50.4 billion to support yen in a single‑day intervention
stories.s: The Finance Ministry reported a 7.98 trillion‑yen purchase on July 30, part of a total $97.2 billion bought over three days, the largest yen‑buying operation in history.

stories.h: US banks grapple with AI agent protocols, fintech CEO says six‑month timeline
stories.s: Socure CEO Johnny Ayers warned that banks lack clear rules for AI agents accessing accounts, citing blocks by JPMorgan, BofA and Citi and ongoing security concerns.

stories.h: AzerGold warns citizens of WhatsApp fraud attempts using fake employee profiles
stories.s: The company says scammers pose as AzerGold staff, sending messages to obtain personal and bank data, and advises not to respond or share information.

stories.h: Utility sector loans in Azerbaijan total $155.6 million in September 2026
stories.s: Trend News Agency reports that loans to the country's utility sector reached $155.6 million for September 2026.

stories.h: Electronic registration of local and foreign LLCs in Azerbaijan will be free
stories.s: The amendment to the State Fees Law removes fees for electronic state registration of LLCs with domestic and foreign investment, extending the previous exemption that applied only to legal entities.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's real estate loan portfolio grew 5.5% to $26.1 million by late September
stories.s: The increase was reported by Trend News Agency, reflecting a modest rise in credit exposure to the property sector.

stories.h: Trend News Agency publishes weekly review of the Azerbaijani currency market
stories.s: The report analyses manat exchange‑rate movements and market liquidity over the past week.

stories.h: Azerbaijan reviews draft Budget Package for 2027
stories.s: The government held a discussion on the upcoming 2027 budget documents, outlining fiscal priorities and spending plans for the next year.

stories.h: Azerbaijan will allocate $21.2 million to unemployment benefits for 2027
stories.s: The Ministry of Labour announced the funding in a press release, aiming to support job‑seekers amid a projected rise in unemployment next year.

stories.h: Azerbaijan earned $27.5 million from treasury account management over nine months
stories.s: The Ministry of Finance reported the earnings for the period ending September 2026, indicating the state treasury generated $27.5 million from managing its accounts.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's construction sector loan portfolio rose 82% in nine months
stories.s: The increase was reported by Trend News Agency, highlighting rapid credit expansion to construction firms over the period.

stories.h: Turkey arrests former deputy chairman of markets regulator in fund scandal
stories.s: Anadolu Agency said Turkish authorities detained the ex‑deputy chairman of the markets regulator as the fund probe widens, adding to the list of executives implicated.

stories.h: Bloomberg economist says strong US jobs data raises odds of a December Fed rate hike
stories.s: Anna Wong noted the October jobs report broadened hiring into white‑collar, manufacturing and transport sectors, bolstering the case for another rate increase.

stories.h: Global commodity, stock and currency indices close higher on 07 Nov 2026
stories.s: Brent rose to $98.32, WTI to $90.83, gold fell to $4,074.90, while major indices like the Dow and S&P 500 posted modest gains.

stories.h: FATF acknowledges effectiveness of U.S. AML/CFT system
stories.s: The Financial Action Task Force said the United States' anti‑money‑laundering and counter‑terrorist financing framework meets its standards, highlighting progress on illicit‑finance initiatives.

stories.h: U.S. Treasury severs MEXC Global’s access to the U.S. financial system
stories.s: The Department of the Treasury announced Operation Economic Outcast, blocking the crypto exchange MEXC Global from U.S. banks and payment networks, effectively cutting off its U.S. financial ties.

stories.h: US Treasury sanctions eight Canadian money‑services businesses for enabling Iran
stories.s: The sanctions, announced on 2026‑11‑06, target firms accused of facilitating transactions for the Iranian regime, restricting their access to US financial systems.

stories.h: Pimco economist says another Fed rate hike in March is possible
stories.s: Tiffany Wilding told Bloomberg Open Interest that the latest US jobs report does not alter her view that the Fed could raise rates again in March as part of a policy recalibration.

stories.h: Azərbaycan Qarabağ biznes kreditləri üçün 500 milyon manatlıq dövlət zəmanəti proqramını tətbiq etdi – zəmanət 90%-ə qədərdir
stories.s: Proqram 500 milyon manatlıq kredit portfeli yaradır; 450 milyon manata qədər dövlət zəmanəti kredit məbləğlərinin 90%-ini əhatə edir və 36 aya qədər müddətə illik 13%-lik faizin 50%-ini subsidiya edir.
stories.he: Azerbaijan launches 500 million manat state guarantee scheme for Karabakh business loans up to 90%

stories.h: Birbank Private named Azerbaijan’s Best Private Bank at Global Private Banking Awards
stories.s: The award was announced by the Global Private Banking Awards, recognizing Birbank Private’s performance among Azerbaijani banks.

stories.h: US Treasury yields fall as strong job growth fuels Fed rate‑hike expectations
stories.s: Traders priced in higher odds of a December rate increase after data showed an unexpected surge in US employment, pushing yields lower.

stories.h: Azər‑Türk Bank renames Asif Məhərrəmov branch after fallen employee Rauf Əliyev
stories.s: The bank's Supervisory Board approved the name “Şəhid Rauf Əliyev” for its branch at 99 Asif Məhərrəmov Street, with the ceremony attended by management and the employee’s parents.

stories.h: "GL" ASC placed 900,000 manat unsecured bonds on Baku Stock Exchange
stories.s: The 9,000‑unit issue with a 15% coupon and 7‑year term was auctioned on 06.11.2026, attracting 52 investors and fully subscribed at the initial price of 100 manat per bond.

stories.h: Unsecured business loans in Azerbaijan exceed 5 billion manat
stories.s: CBAR data shows unsecured loans represent 27.3% of the 18.44 billion manat business loan portfolio as of 30 Sept 2026, up 2.1 percentage points year‑on‑year.

stories.h: Central Bank of Azerbaijan publishes insurance attestation results for 2026
stories.s: The CBAR held a re‑attestation on 30 Oct 2026, with 2 candidates passing the 70‑question test and a detailed list of scores for 61 participants released.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's Ministry of Finance returned 296.7 million manat to individuals and businesses in Jan-Oct 2026
stories.s: The refunds covered VAT on retail, cultural, medical services and construction-related taxes, plus overpaid taxes, fees, interest and financial penalties, according to the ministry.

stories.h: Azerbaijan allocates about $4.3 billion from the state budget for investment expenditures
stories.s: The finance ministry announced the allocation on 2026-11-06, aiming to boost infrastructure and development projects across the country.

stories.h: CBAR meets S&P Global Ratings to discuss financial stability and banking reforms
stories.s: The meeting, reported by AzerNews and Trend News Agency, focused on sector issues and potential reforms but did not announce any concrete regulatory changes.

stories.h: Binance and the Central Bank of Azerbaijan discuss upcoming crypto legislation
stories.s: The two parties met to outline how new crypto regulations will be framed, with Binance seeking clarity on licensing and compliance requirements.

stories.h: TBC Bank Group reports 10% quarterly profit growth and announces a $19 million share buyback
stories.s: The Georgian bank said its profit rose by 10% year‑on‑year for the quarter and will repurchase $19 million of its own shares, according to the press release.

stories.h: Taiwan authorizes its National Financial Stabilization Fund to support the stock market after a sharp sell‑off
stories.s: The fund will intervene to buy equities and provide liquidity as the tech‑heavy index fell sharply, officials said.

stories.h: Draft law proposes 5‑year profit‑tax exemption for export revenues up to 25%
stories.s: The amendment would exempt export earnings of manufacturers and service providers from profit tax for five years, capped at 25% of total taxable income, excluding oil‑gas and finance sectors but including re‑insurance services.

stories.h: Finance Minister Sahil Babayev says Azerbaijan's inflation forecast is 5.3% for next year
stories.s: He noted that inflation over the first nine months this year was 5.7%, within the 4‑6% target range, and called the outlook fully acceptable.

stories.h: Unibank's Leobank wins gold at the Felis 2026 awards for its Leo Pride card campaign
stories.s: The award was presented on Nov 4 in Istanbul during Brand Week Istanbul, recognizing the ad’s creativity in the Consumer Service and B2B category.

stories.h: ECB reports EU credit institutions' assets rise 5.18% to €34.99 trillion in June 2026
stories.s: Total assets grew from €33.27 trillion in June 2025, while the non‑performing loan ratio edged up to 1.99% and ROE stood at 5.31% with a CET1 ratio of 16.43%.

stories.h: Finance Ministry forecasts tax benefits and exemptions to reach AZN 7.6 billion in 2027
stories.s: Deputy Head Asif Gasimov said the amount will be 5.4% of GDP, up 0.4 percentage points from 2026, with tax‑related benefits at AZN 4.2 billion and import‑related at AZN 3.4 billion.

stories.h: Azərbaycanın Vergi Xidməti 5 000 manata qədər borclar üzrə vergi ödəyicilərini maliyyə cərimələrindən qoruyan xidmətə başlayacaq
stories.s: Nicat İmanov bildirib ki, yeni mexanizm 5 000 manata qədər borclar üzrə öhdəlikləri avtomatik ləğv edəcək, 100 000 manatdan yuxarı borclar üzrə isə zəmanət tələblərini bir il müddətinə 10% ödənişə endirəcək.
stories.he: Azerbaijan's Tax Service to launch service shielding taxpayers from financial sanctions up to 5 000 manat debt

stories.h: TuranBank joins tree‑planting campaign on Victory Day, planting 1,250 trees
stories.s: The event on 4 Nov 2026 in Müşfiqabad saw participants plant 1,250 Eldar pines and olive trees on 2 ha, with CBAR and ABA officials attending.

stories.h: Azerbaijan Industry Insurance's auto‑insurance premiums fell 33% to 2,040.5 k manat in 2026
stories.s: Premiums dropped to 2,040.5 k manat from 3,043.8 k manat a year earlier, while claim payments rose 20.7% to 1,960.6 k manat versus 1,624.7 k manat in 2025.

stories.h: Tax Service head proposes halving interest on overdue tax liabilities
stories.s: Orxan Nəzərli told the parliamentary Economic Policy Committee that the change aims to spur export activity and speed up payment of financial sanctions.

stories.h: US equity markets lose about $3 trillion in a day as AI stocks plunge
stories.s: S&P 500 fell 4.36% to 7 353,73, Nasdaq down 5.52% to 24 315 and Dow Jones dropped 3.44% to 51 523,06, driven by AI‑sector concerns and election‑related risks.

stories.h: Azerbaijan ministry assigns fiscal risk ratings to 32 state entities
stories.s: The Ministry of Finance announced that fiscal risk ratings have been determined for 32 government institutions, outlining their credit risk profiles.

stories.h: Paraguay's Ueno Bank collapses, affecting about 3 million customers and prompting the central bank governor's resignation
stories.s: The Paraguay Central Bank declared Ueno Bank insolvent on Nov 2 after its financial health fell below half the legal minimum, freezing accounts of roughly 2.9‑3 million clients and leading Governor Carlos Carvallo to step down.

stories.h: Economist Rəşad Həsənov forecasts about 7% pension indexation for Jan 1 2027
stories.s: Based on a 7.2% rise in average monthly wages in the first nine months of 2026, he expects a 7‑8% increase for retirees and a possible 10% rise in the minimum pension to 350 manat.

stories.h: Azerbaijan will limit tax return revisions to three per filing
stories.s: The amendment to the Tax Code, reported by Banco.az, proposes capping corrected tax declarations at three submissions per taxpayer.

stories.h: CBAR publishes November 6 official exchange rates
stories.s: The rates list the USD at 1.7000 AZN, EUR at 1.9037 AZN, GBP at 2.2834 AZN and other currencies and metals for the day.

stories.h: OFAC adds new cyber‑related and transnational criminal organizations and Cuba to its sanctions list
stories.s: The U.S. Office of Foreign Assets Control announced designations of several cyber‑related groups, transnational criminal organizations, and new Cuba‑related entities, expanding existing sanctions measures.

stories.h: State Social Protection Fund reports 5.8% rise in mandatory social insurance contributions in Jan-Oct 2026
stories.s: Revenues grew by 311.3 million manat versus forecast, with budget entities up 109.1 million manat (6.3%) and non‑budget entities up 340.8 million manat (9.7%).

stories.h: Azərbaycanın xaric borcu 2025-ci ilin sonunda 9,3% azalaraq 12,327 milyard dollara düşüb
stories.s: Dünya Bankının 2026-cı il Beynəlxalq Borc Hesabatına görə, xaric borc 2015-ci ildəki 13,179 milyard dollardan azalıb. Dövlət borcu 11,041 milyard dollar, borcun ÜMD-ə nisbəti isə 17% təşkil edir.
stories.he: Azerbaijan's external debt fell 9.3% to $12.327 billion by end‑2025

stories.h: Baku Stock Exchange approves trading of Legion Financial ASC bonds worth 1,000,000 manat
stories.s: The BFB Listing Committee granted a “Trade Permission” for 10,000 unsecured interest‑bearing bonds with a 16% annual yield, to be auctioned on 12 November 2026 at an initial price of 100 manat each.

stories.h: Bank Respublika AccessBank-in 100%-lik satın alınması fonunda Cəfər Həmidovu CTO vəzifəsinə təyin edib
stories.s: 2025-ci ilin aprelindən AccessBank-in CTO-su olan Həmidov 2026-cı ilin oktyabrında yeni vəzifəsinə başlayır. Bank 2026-cı ilin 3 noyabrında elan edilən satın almanı tamamlayarkən iki bankı Bank Respublika brendi altında birləşdirməyi planlaşdırır.
stories.he: Bank Respublika appoints Cəfər Həmidov as CTO amid 100% acquisition of AccessBank

stories.h: Fuad Paşabəyli appointed IT Director of Ziraat Bank Azerbaijan after leaving Bank Respublika
stories.s: The former head of software development at Bank Respublika joined Ziraat Bank Azerbaijan's Information Technology Department as director, ending his two‑week tenure at Bank Respublika.

stories.h: Kəpəz BOKT to raise 6 million AZN via unsecured interest‑bearing bonds on Baku Stock Exchange
stories.s: The non‑bank credit organisation will issue 60 000 bonds with a 100 AZN nominal value each, underwritten by PAŞA Kapital Investment, to fund expanded lending activities.

stories.h: PAŞA Həyat Sığorta leads 2026 Q1‑Q3 insurance investment income with 39.7 million manat
stories.s: The insurer posted a 4.3% rise in interest and dividend earnings, capturing 39.6% of the market, while PAŞA Sığorta and AzRe Təkrarsığorta ranked second and third with 19.35 million and 9.09 million manat respectively.

stories.h: Bank of Canada renews framework, prioritising 2% inflation target
stories.s: The central bank announced the updated policy framework emphasizes price stability and confirms the 2% inflation goal as its top priority.

stories.h: White House reviews SEC proposal to change crypto broker rules
stories.s: The administration is examining the Securities and Exchange Commission's plan to alter how brokers handle digital assets, according to Bloomberg.

stories.h: International Bank of Azerbaijan named Azerbaijan’s best transaction bank 2026 by Euromoney
stories.s: Euromoney’s 2026 ranking lists Bank ABB as the top transaction bank in Azerbaijan, highlighting its performance in corporate and trade finance.

stories.h: CBAR and MFC discuss development of microfinance sector
stories.s: The Central Bank of Azerbaijan and the Microfinance Centre held talks on expanding microfinance services, aiming to improve access to credit for small enterprises.

stories.h: Federal Reserve terminates enforcement action against Allegiant United Holdings, Nano Financial Holdings and Nano Banc
stories.s: The Fed announced the termination effective October 21, 2026, ending the action that began with a written agreement dated February 24, 2021.

stories.h: Crédit Mutuel Arkéa reports hackers stole an estimated €118 million in cyberattack
stories.s: The bank said the funds were taken via a third‑party service provider, bypassed client accounts and were moved to other banks, with some amounts now blocked while recovery efforts continue.

stories.h: Former Fed Governor Stephen Miran calls September rate hike a mistake
stories.s: Miran said the hike was unnecessary and supports cutting back on forward guidance even if it raises the risk premium.

stories.h: World Bank says emerging economies' external debt hit $9.4 trillion in 2025
stories.s: The report highlights that poorest nations are now paying borrowing costs not seen since the 1980s, pushing overall debt to a record level.

stories.h: Kazakhstan's banking sector assets total $169.6 billion in September
stories.s: The figure was reported by Trend News Agency, reflecting the size of the sector at the end of the month.

stories.h: Kapital Bank and Birbank launch redesigned Ganja branch to boost digital inclusion
stories.s: The joint branch, opened in Ganja, features upgraded digital services and a modern layout aimed at increasing access for customers, according to the banks' statements.

stories.h: Birbank Biznes offers up to 5% discount on micro‑business loans
stories.s: From 29 Oct to 30 Nov 2026, entrepreneurs can apply online via the Birbank Biznes app and receive a discount of up to 5% on loans ranging from 500 to 50,000 manat, with no guarantor or collateral required.

stories.h: CBAR deputy governor Toğrul Əliyev meets microfinance centre chief Katarina Pavlak to discuss financial inclusion
stories.s: They reviewed steps taken by the Central Bank to develop microfinance, strategic priorities and the role of non‑bank lenders, emphasizing cooperation with international partners.

stories.h: Fed Cleveland President Beth Hammack says rates must stay restrictive to curb inflation
stories.s: Hammack warned that maintaining restrictive policy and more frequent moves are needed to keep inflation on target, emphasizing the risk of lagging behind economic developments.

stories.h: Kazakhstan seeks foreign firms to manage $1 billion oil fund assets
stories.s: The state-owned National Fund will involve Cerberus Capital, Brookfield Asset Management, Ashmore Group and Siguler Guff to boost returns and channel long‑term investments into sectors like tech and logistics.

stories.h: EBA publishes revised internal governance guidelines for EU banks
stories.s: The new guidelines implement CRD VI changes, adding proportionality, simplified duty mapping and clearer conflict‑of‑interest rules, especially for third‑country branches.

stories.h: PAŞA Bank took part in a tree‑planting campaign in Müşfiqabad on 8 Nov
stories.s: Bank’s Chief Operating Officer Farid Jafarov joined representatives of the Ministry of Ecology, the Central Bank of Azerbaijan and sector associations in the event tied to the 100‑year anniversary of Heydar Aliyev’s birth.

stories.h: Azerbaijan will allow individuals to deduct rental expenses from taxable rental income starting 2027
stories.s: The amendment to the Tax Code lets owners of residential or other property report expenses and pay income tax at the rate in Article 101.3 after filing a declaration, with withholding stopped from the following month.

stories.h: ABB Invest leads Baku Stock Exchange investment‑company turnover ranking with AZN 26.49 bn
stories.s: The exchange reported that ABB Invest posted a turnover of 26,490,887,232 manats for Jan‑Oct 2026, followed by PASHA Capital with 19,013,047,531 manats.

stories.h: Baku Stock Exchange turnover fell 32% YoY to 37.140439 billion manat
stories.s: From January to October 2026 the total value of closed trades was 37.140439 billion manat, 32% lower than the same period last year, while the number of trades rose 2.1 times to 52,540.
