stories.s: Lagarde said she will step down before the end of her eight‑year mandate, giving EU leaders time to choose a successor ahead of the French election next spring

stories.h: EBRD approves a $25 million loan to Uzbekistan's Davr Bank for young businesses
stories.s: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development will provide the funding to support financing for startups and small enterprises, according to the announcement on 2026-10-29.

stories.h: ECB President Christine Lagarde will step down on 7 February 2027
stories.s: The ECB announced the change alongside its decision to keep the benchmark rate at 2.5%, citing tighter financing conditions and rising inflation.

stories.h: CBAR sədri Taleh Kazımov bildirib ki, 2027-2030-cu illər üçün maliyyə sektorunun strategiyası demək olar ki, hazır olub və 2022-2026-cı illər üçün müəyyən edilmiş hədəflərin 85%-i yerinə yetirilib
stories.s: O, oktyabrın 29-da keçirilən mətbuat konfransında strategiya tezliklə illik icra hesabatları ilə birlikdə təqdim olunacağını, 2026-cı ilin ətraflı nəticələr hesabatının isə 2027-ci ilin I rübünə qədər təqdim edilməli olduğunu bildirib.
stories.he: CBAR chair Taleh Kazimov says 2027‑2030 financial sector strategy is nearly finished and 85% of 2022‑2026 targets have been met

stories.h: CBAR chair Taleh Kazimov says the bank is discussing payment‑system integration with foreign central banks
stories.s: At a press conference on Oct 29, Kazimov outlined plans for faster, cheaper cross‑border settlements, QR‑standard recognition and sandbox cooperation, including talks with Uzbekistan’s central bank.

stories.h: CBAR head says consumer loan overdue growth is not systemic risk
stories.s: Taleh Kazımov told a press conference on Oct 29 that reserve coverage exceeds twice the loan amount and overdue share stays below the 4‑5% alert level, deeming the situation acceptable.

stories.h: CBAR Chair Taleh Kazımov says card limits do not hinder legal activity
stories.s: At a press conference on interest‑rate corridor parameters, Kazımov explained customers can request higher limits or additional cards if justified, and that limits are not a prohibition for lawful users.

stories.h: CBAR imposes card‑to‑card transfer limits and credit‑card caps, cutting card volume by 3.9%
stories.s: Chairman Taleh Kazımov said monthly limits of 20,000 manat and daily five‑transaction caps were set to curb illegal use, after which credit‑card numbers fell to 2.035 million, 81,000 fewer than a year ago

stories.h: ECB Governing Council keeps deposit, refinancing and marginal rates unchanged at 2.50%, 2.65% and 2.90%
stories.s: The decision was announced on 29 October 2026, citing rising energy prices and tightened financing conditions as upside inflation risks and downside growth risks.

stories.h: EBRD finalizes new green framework for Azerbaijan's banking sector
stories.s: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development announced the completion of a green financing framework aimed at promoting sustainable lending among Azerbaijani banks, as reported by trend.az on 2026-10-29.

stories.h: CBAR chair Taleh Kazımov says up to $1 billion of foreign‑exchange purchases will continue through year‑end
stories.s: He told a press conference on Oct 29 that the bank will keep buying dollars without a fixed target, aiming to channel banks' free liquidity into lending as part of its stimulus effort.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's household bank deposits rose by 3.5 billion manat in the first nine months of 2026
stories.s: CBAR Chairman Taleh Kazımov said the increase reflects higher incomes and growing preference for manat savings, with both demand‑deposit and term‑deposit balances up 2.1 billion and 1.4 billion manat respectively.

stories.h: CBAR Chair Taleh Kazımov says banks account for 94‑95% of Azerbaijan's financial sector
stories.s: Speaking at a press conference on Oct 29, Kazımov noted the historic dominance of banks and highlighted high growth potential in insurance, capital markets and fintech.

stories.h: CBAR to continue tightening daily loan requirements, says Governor Taleh Kazimov
stories.s: At a press conference on Oct 29, Kazimov said additional restrictive measures will be applied this year, but the product will not be withdrawn from the market.

stories.h: CBA sets 0.3‑0.5% return target for securities‑lending operations
stories.s: Governor Taleh Kazımov said at an Oct 29 press conference the bank will allow up to 1 billion AZN in securities‑lending, aiming for a spread of 0.3‑0.5% after covering custodian costs.

stories.h: CBAR head Taleh Kazimov says tighter rules for daily BOKT loans expected in 2026
stories.s: At a press conference Kazimov announced plans to lower the profit ceiling and curb high‑interest short‑term loans, aiming to reduce consumer over‑borrowing and bring rates to more acceptable levels.

stories.h: Kristal Bakı ASC (il, 2025): xalis mənfəət 8 milyon 249 min manat; aktivlər 719 milyon 653 min manat (+7.6%); kapital -40 milyon 160 min manat
stories.he: Kristal Bakı ASC posts 8.249 million AZN profit in 2025 after 3.278 million AZN loss in 2024

stories.h: CB Governor Taleh Kazimov says Azerbaijan welcomes foreign banks
stories.s: Kazimov rejected claims of disinterest, saying foreign banks would boost competition, human capital, IT use and could also participate in capital markets and insurance, provided national interests are protected.

stories.h: CBAR says no additional interbank market measures needed as activity rises since Sep 23
stories.s: AMB Chairman Taleh Kazımov told a press conference on Oct 29 that existing monetary tools will continue to keep short‑term rates in target and liquidity sufficient, so no extra steps are planned.

stories.h: CBAR chair says banks have 4.6 billion manat of free liquidity for lending
stories.s: Taleh Kazımov told journalists that despite 4.6 billion manat of excess funds, demand for new borrowers is weak, leading banks to target existing clients and increase portfolio concentration.

stories.h: Mərkəzi Bank bank birləşmələrini dəstəkləyir, BTB-ABB aktiv ötürülməsi və Respublika-AccessBank səhmdarlığına istinad edir
stories.s: Mərkəzi Bankın sədri Taleh Kazımov bildirib ki, tənzimləyici sektorun möhkəmləndirilməsi üçün birləşmə və satınalmaları dəstəkləyir. O, son vaxtlar BTB-nin Azərbaycan Beynəlxalq Bankına aktivlərinin ötürülməsi və Respublika Bankının AccessBank səhmlərinin satınalınmasına istinad edib.
stories.he: CBAR backs bank consolidations, cites BTB‑ABB asset transfer and Respublika‑AccessBank share deal

stories.h: CBAR Governor Taleh Kazimov says broad money growth poses no inflation pressure
stories.s: At a press conference on Oct 29, Kazimov noted credit growth is not sharply rising and banks hold about 6 billion manat of free liquidity, which is not being fully used for lending.

stories.h: AMB Chairman Taleh Kazımov says it is too early to fully assess the Sep 23 interest‑corridor decision
stories.s: He noted interbank activity has risen but a month is insufficient to gauge effects, and no further measures are planned for now.

stories.h: Azerbaijan exempts income tax and VAT for digital nomads in four tech sectors
stories.s: The Innovation and Digital Development Agency announced that foreign‑earned income, cloud, platform and API services will not be taxed, and outlined a five‑step visa and residency process for eligible nomads.

stories.h: AFB Bank (9 ay, 2026): xalis mənfəət 3,6 milyon manat (+59,2%); aktivlər 574,4 milyon manat (+35,8%); kredit portfeli 413,4 milyon manat (+78,0%)
stories.he: AFB Bank reports 9‑month assets of 574.4 million manat and profit of 3.6 million manat

stories.h: ECB President Kristiina Laqard announces early resignation effective 7 February 2027
stories.s: Laqard will leave about nine months before her term ends, citing a formal notice to the ECB Governing Council and EU Council President Antonio Costa, with potential successor candidates named but not yet decided

stories.h: PAŞA Həyat Sığorta calls an extraordinary shareholders' meeting for Nov 26
stories.s: The meeting will be held at 10:00 at the company’s administrative building to present the Board‑approved 2027‑2029 Strategic Plan and discuss other matters, according to Banker.az.

stories.h: PAŞA Insurance paid nearly 16 million manat in claims in September 2026
stories.s: The insurer disbursed 10,169,191 manat for vehicle accidents, 157,008 manat for property incidents, and over 5 million manat for voluntary medical, travel and liability coverage.

stories.h: CBAR Governor supports consolidation of Azerbaijan's banking sector
stories.s: The governor expressed backing for merging banks to strengthen the sector, signaling possible future policy moves.

stories.h: CBAR governor says Azerbaijan imposes no limit on foreign‑currency purchases
stories.s: The statement was made by Governor Elmar Mammadyarov, indicating the regulator will not cap individuals or firms buying foreign currency, aiming to support market liquidity.

stories.h: BIS CPMI releases report on central banks' evolving role in payment systems
stories.s: The analysis outlines how technological innovation, new payment service providers and stablecoins reshape safety, efficiency and trust, urging holistic policy and international cooperation.

stories.h: ECB President Christine Lagarde will resign effective Feb. 7 2027
stories.s: Lagarde informed the Governing Council and European Council President António Costa of her resignation, announced by Bloomberg from Frankfurt.

stories.h: CBAR chair Taleh Kazımov says daily five card deposits for non‑entrepreneurs are abnormal
stories.s: He noted card‑to‑card turnover rose to 48 billion manat in August, highlighted sector‑wide limits of five daily deposits and 20,000 manat monthly, and said banks may adjust limits case‑by‑case.

stories.h: Yelo Bank launches "Yelo Hədəf" deposit offering extra 1% interest after reaching a savings goal
stories.s: Customers set a target amount; once reached, the deposit’s rate increases by 1% from the next day, with three saving types available via the Yelo App for Android users only

stories.h: CBAR Chair Taleh Kazımov says the bank's prudential requirements are softer than international standards
stories.s: Kazımov argued the standards encourage financing for SMEs, agriculture and export sectors and invited experts to review specific clauses, noting some consumer loan rules may be stricter

stories.h: Azerbaijan's social‑oriented budget expenditures rose by about 15%
stories.s: Report.az noted the increase, indicating higher allocations to health, education and social protection in the 2026 budget.

stories.h: CBAR Governor Taleh Kazimov announces payment tokenization via instant payment system from 2027
stories.s: The Central Bank of Azerbaijan will implement tokenized payments through its instant payment platform starting in 2027, as stated by Governor Taleh Kazimov.

stories.h: SOCAR Polymer exported $197 million of products in Jan‑Sept 2026
stories.s: The volume is $10 million (4.8%) lower than the same period in 2025, while Azerbaijan's total non‑oil exports rose 20.5% YoY to $3.2 billion.

stories.h: Azerbaijan repaid nearly 1.5 billion manats of debt in the first nine months of 2026
stories.s: The state budget spent 1.45 billion manats on debt service, including 397.2 million manats in domestic interest and 1.052 billion manats in external debt payments, per the Ministry of Finance.

stories.h: Dövlət Neft Fondu (9 ay, 2026): gəlirlər 12 milyard 341,4 milyon manat
stories.he: State Social Protection Fund reports 9‑month revenue of 6 369,5 million manat and expenses of 6 188,6 million manat

stories.h: CBA Chairman Taleh Kazimov says Mastercard and Visa will cut fees in Azerbaijan by year‑end
stories.s: Kazimov said the regulator is negotiating with both payment systems after recent price hikes that forced banks to raise their own fees, and expects progress before the end of 2026.

stories.h: CBA Governor says Finance Ministry's note placements do not affect monetary policy
stories.s: Taleh Kazimov noted that the Ministry spent 29 million manats on notes by Sep 20 and that placements are small relative to overall liquidity, emphasizing coordination with fiscal policy.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's state budget received 12.93 billion manats in oil and gas revenues Jan‑Sep 2026
stories.s: The amount exceeded the forecast by 625.5 million manats (5.1%) and 74.5% came from SOFAZ transfers, while 25.5% was collected through tax authorities.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's Central Bank says it will focus on developing non‑banking financial sectors
stories.s: The statement was released by the Central Bank of Azerbaijan, outlining its intent to support growth in areas such as micro‑finance, leasing and insurance, without detailing specific measures.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's household bank deposits increase while foreign currency demand falls
stories.s: Trend News Agency reports a rise in total household deposits in manat terms, noting a concurrent decline in demand for foreign‑currency accounts.

stories.h: Azerbaijan to introduce legislative incentives for startups and investors
stories.s: Farid Osmanov, chair of the Innovation and Digital Development Agency, said the amendments aim to expand private‑sector participation, attract investment and improve financing options for startups.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's non-oil and gas budget revenues hit 16.38 billion manats in first nine months of 2026
stories.s: The figure exceeds the forecast by 1% and is up 9.3% year‑on‑year, with tax authorities contributing 63% of the total, according to the Ministry of Finance.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's CBA may purchase $1 billion of foreign currency by year-end
stories.s: The central bank indicated the potential buyback to support the manat and market liquidity, according to Trend News Agency.

stories.h: CBAR chairman says September card-to-card transfers fell to 48 billion manat from 66 billion last year
stories.s: He warned that large volumes pose tax‑evasion and fraud risks, prompting banks to set 20 k manat monthly and five‑transaction daily limits, which can be raised on justified requests.

stories.h: Mərkəzi Bank bütün POS terminalları üçün AZQR standartını mütləq edir və interçeync haqlarına üst hədd qoyaraq QR-kod ödəniş tariflərini aşağı salır
stories.s: Mərkəzi Bankın sədri Taleh Kazımov bankların bütün POS terminalları vasitəsilə AZQR standartı üzrə ödənişləri qəbul etməli olduğunu və ticarət subyektlərinin xərclərini azaltmaq məqsədi ilə interçeync haqlarının üst həddinin müəyyən ediləcəyini açıqlayıb.
stories.he: CBAR mandates AZQR standard on all POS terminals and caps interchange fees to lower QR‑code payment tariffs

stories.h: CBAR develops a local payment instrument and begins testing
stories.s: The Central Bank of Azerbaijan announced it has created a domestic payment tool and is currently conducting trials to strengthen the national payment system.

stories.h: Visa and MasterCard raise fees for Azerbaijani banks
stories.s: The card networks announced higher transaction charges for local banks, prompting discussions among the banks about cost impacts and potential price adjustments for customers.

stories.h: Azerbaijan sees threefold increase in public dollar sales
stories.s: According to Fed.az, the volume of dollar sales by the population has tripled, indicating heightened demand for foreign currency.

stories.h: CBAR Governor Taleh Kazımov says Mastercard and Visa fees will be reduced by year‑end
stories.s: Kazımov told media the central bank is in talks with the card schemes to lower fees that have risen sharply, affecting banks' product costs, and hopes progress will be made before the end of 2026.

stories.h: CBAR chair Taleh Kazımov says card‑to‑card limits can be increased on request
stories.s: He noted daily limits of five deposits and monthly limits of 20,000 manat may be raised after justification, citing 48 billion manat card transfers Jan‑Sep 2026 and 66 billion manat in 2025.

stories.h: CBAR Chair Taleh Kazımov says the central bank supports Azerbaijani banks' expansion into foreign markets
stories.s: Kazımov told a press conference on Oct 29 that while no specific data exists for 2027, the regulator is ready to back initiatives that do not add undue risk to the sector's financial stability.

stories.h: CBAR governor Taleh Kazımov says no new restrictions for Bank Melli Iran in Azerbaijan
stories.s: He noted the bank's market share is near zero percent, it complies with CBAR requirements and has been operating without issues, so no measures are planned.

stories.h: CBAR chair says card-to-card limits can be raised on justified request, cites 48 bn AZN volume Sep 2026
stories.s: Taleh Kazımov told a monetary policy press conference that banks may increase monthly 20 000 AZN and daily five‑transaction limits for customers who justify the need, aiming to curb tax evasion and fraud.

stories.h: CBAR sığorta şirkətlərini Solvency I-dən Solvency II kapital qaydalarına keçirir
stories.s: CBAR-ın sədri Taleh Kazımov monetar siyasət mətbuat konfransında bu dəyişikliyi elan edərək, simulyasiyaların kapital çatışmazlığı göstərmədiyini və mətbuat üçün brifinqin keçiriləcəyini bildirib.
stories.he: CBAR to shift insurance firms from Solvency I to Solvency II capital rules

stories.h: CBAR Governor Azər Ələsgərov says money supply growth is not putting serious pressure on inflation
stories.s: He noted M0 rose 12.4%, M1 17% and M2 21.3% over the past year, while longer‑term deposit components grew faster, limiting inflation impact.

stories.h: National payment system turnover rose 46% to 862 billion manats in September, CBAR Chairman Taleh Kazimov said
stories.s: Cashless transactions made up 69% of domestic card volume, with card transactions reaching 64.6 billion manats (+8% YoY) and overall cashless activity hitting 80 billion manats (+11.7% YoY).

stories.h: CBA Executive Director Azer Alasgarov says money supply growth is not driving inflation
stories.s: Alasgarov noted M0 rose 12.4%, M1 17% and M2 21.3% over the past year, with reserve coverage rising from about 51% to 60%, and sees no significant inflationary pressure.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's FX reserves rise to $89.4 bn, enough for 40 months of imports
stories.s: Governor Taleh Kazimov said the reserves increased by $4.3 bn and far exceed the three‑month international benchmark, providing a substantial financial cushion.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's Central Bank says no additional interbank market measures are needed
stories.s: The regulator indicated that current liquidity conditions are stable and no further interventions will be introduced at this time.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's Central Bank says it is too early to assess rate corridor decision
stories.s: The central bank indicated that it needs more data before evaluating any changes to the policy rate corridor, according to trend.az.

stories.h: CBAR may purchase up to $1 billion of foreign currency in the next two months
stories.s: The move was announced by Taleh Kazımov, the bank's deputy governor, aiming to support manat stability and market liquidity.

stories.h: CBAR Chair Taleh Kazımov says no risk from rising consumer loans
stories.s: Kazımov told media that while consumer loan volumes are increasing, the growth is not systemic and poses no economic risk, urging more active credit expansion.

stories.h: CBAR head Taleh Kazımov urges banks to direct free funds to each other instead of the central bank
stories.s: Kazımov said banks currently place funds at the CBAR for a 5% return, but should prefer inter‑bank lending, especially when credit demand is high, though he could not quantify the benefit.

stories.h: CBAR Governor Taleh Kazimov says the central bank has reduced its participation in the interbank market
stories.s: Kazimov noted the move follows last year's rate cuts and liquidity management, with activity in the interbank market increasing and no further measures planned

stories.h: ECB expected to keep interest rates unchanged amid inflation and energy risks
stories.s: Bloomberg reports the European Central Bank will hold borrowing costs steady as it assesses bond‑market turmoil in France and rising energy prices.

stories.h: CBAR says 52.5% of September's 5.5% annual inflation came from foreign price increases
stories.s: CBAR Governor Azər Ələsgərov told a press conference on Oct 29 that external price hikes accounted for about 52.5% of the year‑over‑year inflation rate, which fell to 5.5% in September, within the 4±2% target band.

stories.h: Parliament committee drafts law restricting income sources for officials
stories.s: The draft, discussed by the Law Policy and State Building and Defense, Security and Anti‑Corruption committees, bars officials from tax‑exempt or preferential regimes and from earnings on securities in designated jurisdictions, with exceptions for scientific and creative work.

stories.h: CBAR Chair Taleh Kazımov says credit demand must rise to boost lending
stories.s: He noted 4.6 billion manat of free funds available and said lowering rates alone isn’t enough, urging higher demand while monitoring interbank activity.

stories.h: CBAR director Azər Ələsgərov says M0, M1, M2 aggregates rose 12.4%, 17% and 21.3% in a year
stories.s: He noted that demand deposits grew 23% and term deposits 37.7%, indicating faster expansion of longer‑term money components

stories.h: CBAR chair Taleh Kazımov says demand fell sharply while supply rose in cash and non‑cash FX markets
stories.s: He noted non‑cash auctions saw $70 million of offers but only $5 million of demand, and cash market supply exceeded demand by $759 million, while dollarisation of resident deposits fell to 25.7% and non‑resident deposits to 54.6%.

stories.h: CBAR Chair Taleh Kazımov says no plans to relax currency trading rules
stories.s: At a press conference on monetary policy, Kazımov confirmed existing strict controls remain and noted occasional miscommunication at exchange points may cause confusion.

stories.h: CBAR says no sharp rise in household borrowing, consumer credit up 10.7% YTD
stories.s: CBAR Governor Taleh Kazımov told a press conference that while consumer credit grew 10.7% in the first nine months, it remains well below the 20‑22% levels of previous years and no sharp borrowing surge is seen.

stories.h: CBAR chair Taleh Kazımov says business‑credit prudential rules will stay softer than consumer rules
stories.s: He told an APA‑Economics press conference that upcoming November changes will include some easing for SMEs, agriculture and export‑oriented lending, while consumer credit will tighten to lower risk.

stories.h: AMB chair Taleh Kazımov says the central bank may buy up to $1 billion in foreign currency by year‑end
stories.s: He told an APA‑Economics press conference that additional purchases of $500 million‑$1 billion could be made, noting no fixed target for reserves and that inflation impact of manat issuance will be assessed.

stories.h: Russia's antitrust agency drafts second anti-cartel bill with higher fines
stories.s: FAS Deputy Head Ruslan Dzhaliukov said the draft expands powers, adds operational-search transfers and a tiered penalty where the second reporter faces 70% and the third 85% of the total fine.

stories.h: CBAR Chair Taleh Kazımov forecasts 1.3% GDP growth for 2026
stories.s: He said non‑oil GDP will grow 2.8% this year and 4.3% next year, with tourism, trade and communications driving the increase.

stories.h: Azerbaijan allocates nearly 520 million manat from reserve funds over nine months
stories.s: The Ministry of Finance announced the disbursement, indicating a significant boost to public‑sector liquidity.

stories.h: Uzbekistan proposes three cooperation areas for CIS antitrust authorities
stories.s: Director Olimjon Zhumayev outlined priorities on digital platforms, exchange trading monitoring and cross‑border supply oversight at the CIS antimonopoly council meeting.

stories.h: CBAR leaves key interest rate at 6.5%
stories.s: The Central Bank of Azerbaijan announced that the key policy rate remains unchanged at 6.5% in its latest monetary policy meeting.

stories.h: Azerbaijan records $759 million surplus in cash foreign‑currency purchases
stories.s: The Central Bank reported a net surplus of $759 million in cash foreign‑currency purchases for the latest reporting period, indicating inflows exceeding outflows.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's foreign exchange reserves can cover 40 months of imports, says Taleh Kazimov
stories.s: Kazimov, a senior official, stated that the current reserve levels are sufficient to finance imports for the next 40 months, highlighting strong external liquidity.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's Central Bank net bought $759 million in cash currency
stories.s: The Central Bank of Azerbaijan reported that its cash currency purchases exceeded sales by $759 million, indicating a net inflow to the market.

stories.h: Central Bank of Azerbaijan reports cash FX purchases outpacing sales by $759 million in Jan‑Sep 2026
stories.s: The CBA said supply outweighed demand in both cash and cashless FX markets, dollarization fell to 25.7% and reserves rose 33.4% to $15.4 billion over the nine‑month period.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's banking sector liquidity surplus hits 6.2 billion manats, 2.2‑fold increase YoY
stories.s: The Central Bank of Azerbaijan says the surplus, defined as its liabilities to banks minus claims on the system, rose to 6.2 billion manats by end‑September 2026, up from December 2025, while the AZIR rate averaged 5.99% in the same period.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's central bank reports excess banking sector liquidity of AZN 6.2 billion
stories.s: The Central Bank of Azerbaijan disclosed that total excess liquidity in the banking system has reached AZN 6.2 billion, according to its latest data release.

stories.h: CBAR projects annual inflation at 5.9% for both 2026 and 2027
stories.s: The baseline scenario assumes unchanged state‑regulated prices and tariffs, revising earlier forecasts of 6.1% in 2026 and 5.8% in 2027, the bank said.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's non-oil exports reach $3.2 billion in Jan‑Sep 2026, up 20.5% YoY
stories.s: Exports rose from about $2.6 billion in the same period of 2025, with September alone up 50.2% to $372.8 million; Russia remained the top market at $881.4 million.

stories.h: CBAR reports 6.2 billion manat excess liquidity in the banking system at end‑September
stories.s: The central bank said the structural liquidity surplus is 2.2 times the level recorded in December 2025 and excludes mandatory reserves, which can be mobilised via deposit auctions and short‑term notes.

stories.h: CBAR says demand for foreign currency fell to $15 million while supply was $170 million this year
stories.s: Chairman Taleh Kazımov told a press conference that in October five of seven FX auctions had no demand and the other two attracted only $4‑5 million each, with cash market supply exceeding demand by $759 million.

stories.h: CBAR's foreign‑currency purchases raise reserves 33.4% to $15.4 bn in Jan‑Sep 2026
stories.s: The central bank bought dollars as demand fell, adding about $3.9 bn to reserves, while cash FX sales exceeded purchases by $759 m and resident dollar deposits fell to 25.7%.

stories.h: Unibank held a financial literacy training for 30 schoolchildren
stories.s: The event, supported by the Azerbaijan Bankers Association, taught students aged 6‑7 about deposits, credit, budgeting and savings through games and a bank branch visit.

stories.h: CBAR reports resident deposit dollarisation fell to 25.7% in September 2026
stories.s: Chairman Taleh Kazımov said non-resident deposit dollarisation also dropped to 54.6% and cash foreign‑currency transactions exceeded $759 million in September, per the central bank press conference.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's reserve fund allocated nearly 518 million manat this year
stories.s: The allocation was reported by APA on 2026-10-29, indicating the amount used for reserve fund purposes so far in 2026.

stories.h: Mərkəzi Bankın sədri Taleh Kazımov: Azərbaycanın strateji valyuta ehtiyatları 89,4 milyard dollara çatıb
stories.s: Kazımov 4,3 milyard dollarlıq artımı qeyd edərək, ehtiyatların 40 aylıq idxal maliyyələşməsini təmin etdiyini, bu göstəricinin isə beynəlxalq üç aylıq normadan xeyli yüksək olduğunu bildirib.
stories.he: CBAR chair Taleh Kazımov says Azerbaijan's strategic FX reserves rose to $89.4 billion

stories.h: CBAR chair reports total demand of $4.5 million in October currency auctions and reserves hit $15.4 billion
stories.s: Taleh Kazımov said five of seven auctions had no demand, two attracted $4.5 million, and cash‑market supply exceeded demand, with dollarisation of deposits falling to 25.7% for residents and 54.6% for non‑residents.

stories.h: Finance Ministry allocates about 1.8 billion manat for reconstruction of liberated territories in first nine months of 2026
stories.s: Of the total, 891.8 million manat is earmarked for water, drainage, heating, transport and municipal infrastructure, 692.5 million for education, health and culture projects, and 177.1 million for defence and law‑enforcement facilities, according to APA‑Economics citing the ministry.

stories.h: CBA forecasts average oil price of $92.8 per barrel for 2026
stories.s: Governor Taleh Kazimov announced the projection at the Oct 29 monetary policy press conference, up from the July outlook of $87.7.

stories.h: CBAR lifts 2026 GDP growth forecast to 1.3%
stories.s: Governor Taleh Kazimov announced the upward revision at a press conference, also projecting 2.3% growth for 2027 and higher non‑oil sector gains.

stories.h: CBAR keeps refinancing rate at 6.5% and corridor unchanged
stories.s: The Management Board cited inflation dynamics, FX market developments and liquidity conditions as reasons for holding the rate steady through the year.

stories.h: U.S. dollar weakens to DXY 101.77 as Treasury yields fall and tech stocks slide
stories.s: The decline was driven by lower yields on 10‑ and 30‑year U.S. Treasuries and a sharp drop in Alphabet shares, while the yen rose to 157.115 and other majors edged higher.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's micro‑business loan portfolio reaches 8.2808 billion manat, up 13.6% YoY
stories.s: CBAR data shows micro‑business loans grew 19.7% to 4.0907 billion manat, while total business loans rose 18.6% to 18.44 billion manat in September 2026.

stories.h: CBAR bought over $759 million of cash foreign currency in the first nine months of 2026
stories.s: The purchases lifted reserves by 33.4% to $15.4 billion amid falling demand and rising supply, while resident individuals' dollarisation fell to 25.7% in September.

stories.h: Expressbank (III rüb, 2026): kredit portfeli 592 milyon 364 min manat (+42 milyon 651 min manat və ya 7,8%)
stories.he: Expressbank's loan portfolio reached 592.364 million manat as of 30 September 2026

stories.h: PAŞA Sığorta pays 101.665 manat for auto‑shop damage caused by heavy rain
stories.s: The insurer covered the loss after Leysan rains damaged the premises, highlighting the role of property insurance for natural‑hazard losses.

stories.h: CBAR reports currency purchases and sales exceeded $759 million in the latest period
stories.s: The central bank noted that demand in the foreign‑exchange market significantly outpaced supply, with transactions topping $759 million, according to its data.

stories.h: CBAR 2026-cı il üçün inflyasiya proqnozunu 5,9%-ə endirib, 2027-ci il üçün gözləntini isə 5,9%-ə qaldırıb
stories.s: Mərkəzi Bank 2026-cı ilin sonu üçün inflyasiya gözləntisini 6,1%-dən 5,9%-ə endirib, 2027-ci il üçün proqnozu isə 5,8%-dən 5,9%-ə qaldırıb. Bank bunun səbəbi olaraq sabit tənzimlənən qiymətləri və xarici qiymət risklərini göstərir.
stories.he: CBAR lowers 2026 inflation forecast to 5.9% and raises 2027 outlook to 5.9%

stories.h: Azerbaijan's balance of payments surplus rose 70% to $830.5 million in Jan‑Sep 2026
stories.s: The Central Bank reports the surplus reached $830.5 million, up from the same period last year, as high export prices and strong non‑oil trade boosted the figure.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's Central Bank forecasts a $8.5 billion current‑account surplus for 2026
stories.s: The forecast, announced in the 29 Oct 2026 monetary policy press release, raises the 2026 surplus from $6.1 billion and expects a $5.4 billion surplus in 2027, citing high export prices and strong non‑oil trade.

stories.h: KredAqro BOKT appoints TuranBank board member Cavadzade Sədrəddin as new supervisory board member
stories.s: Cavadzade Sədrəddin, an independent TuranBank ASC supervisory board member appointed for three years in August 2024, replaces Oksana Rurenko on KredAqro's board; the microfinance firm saw its capital rise to 23.79 million manat and posted a 2.23 million manat profit in 2025.

stories.h: CBAR keeps USD at 1.7000 manat and EUR at 1.8945 manat
stories.s: The Central Bank of Azerbaijan published its 29 Oct 2026 rates, also listing GBP 2.2645, CHF 2.0518, RUB 2.1118 per 100, TRY 0.0341, GEL 0.6554, CNY 0.2552, CAD 1.2156, AUD 1.1988 and metal prices.

stories.h: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh says he watches South Korea's economy closely
stories.s: Warsh highlighted Korea's tech exports as vital feedstocks and a leading indicator for global supply chains, noting a task force will issue balance‑sheet recommendations early next year.

stories.h: Federal Reserve leaves interest rates unchanged
stories.s: The Fed kept rates steady and reiterated its inflation‑containment stance but gave no clear guidance on a possible December hike, ahead of U.S. mid‑term elections.

stories.h: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh says inflation remains too high as rates stay unchanged
stories.s: Warsh told a press conference the Federal Reserve will continue to deliver price stability despite holding rates steady.

stories.h: Fed keeps policy rate unchanged at 3.75‑4% in October
stories.s: The Federal Open Market Committee voted 10‑2 to hold rates, with two members supporting a 0.25% hike, and gave no clear guidance for December.

stories.h: Bank of Canada raises overnight rate to 2.50%
stories.s: The central bank also lifted the bank rate to 2.75% and deposit rate to 2.45% amid high energy prices and strong Q3 growth forecasts.

stories.h: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh says monetary 'medicine' is starting to work as the Fed leaves rates unchanged
stories.s: Warsh made the comments at a news conference after the FOMC decision, noting no firm conclusions yet on policy direction

stories.h: Former Fed Vice Chairman Clarida predicts a rate hike in December 2026
stories.s: Clarida told Bloomberg Surveillance the Fed will raise rates in December and could hike again in March, outlining the expected monetary‑policy path.

stories.h: Azerbaijan’s instant payment transactions surged sevenfold in September
stories.s: The Central Bank of Azerbaijan reported the jump, signalling rapid growth in digital‑payment usage during the month.

stories.h: Fed keeps federal funds rate target range at 3-3/4 to 4 percent
stories.s: The FOMC voted 10‑2 to maintain the range, with Lisa D. Cook and Beth M. Hammack dissenting for a 1/4‑point hike, citing strong economic activity and elevated inflation.

stories.h: Fed keeps benchmark rate in 3.75%-4% range, votes 10-2
stories.s: The Federal Open Market Committee left rates unchanged while upgrading growth outlook to "strong" and warning inflation remains elevated, hinting at possible hikes later this year.

stories.h: Fed keeps benchmark rate at 3.75%-4% as two governors dissent
stories.s: The FOMC voted 10-2 to hold the federal funds rate unchanged, with Governor Lisa Cook and Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack dissenting, Bloomberg reports.

stories.h: Goldman Sachs economist says Fed may hike rates in December
stories.s: David Mericle told Bloomberg that while the Fed is expected to hold rates steady in October, a rate increase could come in December, according to economists' forecasts.

stories.h: Visa card transaction volume in Azerbaijan grew 6.6% in September
stories.s: The increase was reported by Trend News Agency, reflecting higher consumer spending on Visa‑branded cards during the month.

stories.h: Karabakh and East Zangazur deposits rose 17.7% and 1.7‑fold
stories.s: The latest figures show deposits in Azerbaijan's Karabakh region increased by 17.7% while those in East Zangazur grew 1.7 times, according to Trend News Agency.

stories.h: Bloomberg previews the Fed interest rate decision and earnings from Alphabet and Microsoft
stories.s: The Bloomberg Surveillance program will discuss the upcoming Fed rate move and corporate results, featuring analysts Jonathan Ferro, Lisa Abramowicz and Annmarie Hordern.

stories.h: Bank Saderat Iran raises startup lending by 69% over six months
stories.s: The Iranian lender reported a 69% increase in loans to startups compared with the previous six‑month period, according to Trend News Agency.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's money velocity rose 2.03% month‑over‑month
stories.s: The latest data shows a 2.03% increase in the velocity of money compared with the previous month, according to Trend News Agency.

stories.h: CBAR to issue AI governance guidelines for financial sector by year‑end
stories.s: Director Elmir Hasanli said the guidance, developed with banks, will address model drift, bias and explainability in AI‑driven lending and will be accompanied by a data governance document in November.

stories.h: U.S. Treasury sanctions facilitators of DPRK IT worker fraud targeting U.S. businesses
stories.s: The Treasury announced sanctions against entities and individuals that enabled North Korean IT workers to commit fraud against U.S. companies, adding them to the Specially Designated Nationals list.

stories.h: AzFina board member Eynar Abdullayev calls for more lending to underserved small businesses
stories.s: Speaking at the 12th Investment and Sustainable Development in Microfinance Conference, Abdullayev said Azerbaijan’s loan portfolio of about 27–30 billion manats still leaves a large segment of informal earners and micro‑businesses without access, and urged non‑bank credit institutions and fintechs to fill the gap.

stories.h: Azərbaycan Maliyyə Monitorinq Xidmətinə əsasən beynəlxalq sanksiyalar siyahısını yeniləyib
stories.s: Güncəlləmə Hədəfli Maliyyə Sanksiyaları haqqında Qanunun 5.2-ci maddəsinə və İD və "Əl-Qaidə" haqqında BMT Təhlükəsizlik Şurasının qərarına uyğundur. Siyahıya əmlakı dərhal dondurulmalı olan yeni şəxslər və subyektlər əlavə edilib.
stories.he: Azerbaijan updates its international sanctions list per Financial Monitoring Service

stories.h: Azerbaijan Cabinet amends rules for refunding overpaid taxes and mandatory social insurance contributions
stories.s: Prime Minister Ali Asadov signed the amendment, extending oversight to incorrectly paid taxes, interest and financial sanctions, including the excise tax portion paid to the compulsory medical insurance fund under Tax Code article 191.5.

stories.h: Azerbaijan proposes new fines up to 8,000 manat for telecom and public service violations
stories.s: The draft amendment to the Criminal and Administrative Offences Code sets fines of 500‑1,000 manat for individuals and 1,000‑2,000 manat for legal entities in telecom, 250‑1,050 manat for public service breaches, and up to 8,000 manat for environmental report delays.

stories.h: AzFina official says Azerbaijan's 27‑30 billion manat credit market has large untapped segment of informal earners
stories.s: Eynar Abdullayev told the AMFA conference that micro‑finance should target self‑employed and people without formal salaries, as most existing loans go to clients with official income.

stories.h: Bank of Canada raises benchmark rate by 25 basis points to 2.5%
stories.s: The hike, the first since July 2023, was announced by Governor Tiff Macklem who said it could curb inflation risks from higher energy prices.

stories.h: Bank of Russia sets new macroprudential limits for long-term auto and consumer loans starting Q1 2027
stories.s: The limits cap target auto loans over 7 years at 20% and non‑target consumer loans secured by vehicles over 5 years at 1%, aiming to curb debt‑load manipulation, while other macroprudential parameters remain unchanged.

stories.h: Azerbaijan cuts government‑guaranteed debt by 24% in H1 2026
stories.s: The reduction was reported for the first half of 2026, reflecting a sharp decline in state‑backed liabilities, according to PLAT.AZ.

stories.h: CBAR ilin sonuna qədər süni intellekt idarəçiliyi metodologiyasını, noyabrda isə məlumat idarəçiliyi üzrə təlimatı yayımlayacaq
stories.s: CBAR Məlumatatəminatı şöbəsinin direktoru Elmir Həsənli 12-ci Mikrofinans Investisiya və Davamlı İnkişaf konfransında süni intellekt metodologiyasının banklarla birgə hazırlandığını və ilin sonuna qədər yayımlanacağını bəyan edib. Məlumat idarəçiliyi üzrə təlimatlar isə noyabrda nəzərdə tutulub və bankları, bank olmayan kredit verənləri və analitikləri əhatə edəcək.
stories.he: CBAR to issue AI governance methodology by year‑end and data‑management guidance in November

stories.h: Azerbaijan's broad money supply rose 16.7% YoY to $32.95 billion
stories.s: The central bank reported the increase for the year, indicating faster growth in liquidity.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's Cabinet amends rules to include excise tax refunds in mandatory health insurance fund payments
stories.s: Prime Minister Ali Asadov signed the amendment to the "Rules for refunding paid taxes, compulsory state social insurance, unemployment insurance and mandatory health insurance fees, interests and financial sanctions," adding that incorrectly paid excise tax portions will now be directed to the compulsory health insurance fund per Tax Code article 191.5.

stories.h: İpoteka və Kredit Zəmanət Fondu to use SİMA digital signature biometric technology for mortgage applications
stories.s: The fund announced that applicants can now confirm requests with the biometric "SİMA İmza" function, improving security and transparency and reducing fraud risk; guidance is posted on the MyGov portal and a call centre (1549) is available for questions.

stories.h: AzeriCard launches new scoring product to analyze borrowers' payment behavior
stories.s: Deputy chairman Zakir Ahmadov announced the tool at the 12th Microfinance Investment and Sustainable Development Conference, saying it will let banks and non‑bank lenders refine credit scoring and enable remote customer identification.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's total business loan portfolio grew 18.6% to 18 440.0 million manat in September 2026
stories.s: The portfolio rose from 15 544.6 million manat a year earlier, with large business loans up 4.8% to 10 159.3 million manat and micro‑business loans increasing 4.2% to 4 090.7 million manat, while small business loans fell 1.25% to 1 835.3 million manat.

stories.h: UK Chancellor John Healey proposes an extra 3% tax on banks, raising the surcharge to 6%
stories.s: The measure was announced in the first budget of Labour's Andy Burnham government as part of broader fiscal discipline efforts.

stories.h: Turkey to start interim payments up to TL 1 million in extraordinary fund liquidations on Oct 30
stories.s: Vice President Cevdet Yılmaz said payments will be made through Işbank and Ziraat Bank, covering 38 remaining funds after 131 were liquidated, with TL 68 billion already paid to 71,899 accounts.

stories.h: CBAR data chief Elmir Hasanli says banks increasingly use alternative data for decisions
stories.s: Speaking at the 12th Microfinance Investment and Sustainable Development Conference, he noted the need for accurate data and warned of misuse risks, emphasizing better regulatory resource allocation.

stories.h: National Cybersecurity Agency head Sanan Valizada stresses cross‑sector info sharing to curb cyberattacks
stories.s: Speaking at the 12th Investment and Sustainable Development in Microfinance Conference, Valizada said sharing data across sectors helps identify threats early and avoid unassessed risks.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's Mortgage and Credit Guarantee Fund bans borrowers from using both rent‑to‑own and state mortgage loans simultaneously
stories.s: The rule also requires electronic applications using SİMA İmza facial‑recognition technology to improve transparency and prevent third‑party interference, the fund said.

stories.h: Azerbaijan bank deposit portfolio reaches 46,789.6 million manat, up 12.1% year‑on‑year
stories.s: The portfolio grew 1.6% month‑on‑month, with 50.3% (23,536.3 million manat) held by non‑financial entities, while household deposits rose 19.3% to 18,840.2 million manat and financial‑institution deposits rose 19.5% to 4,413.2 million manat.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's Ministry of Finance abolishes one of its statutory duties
stories.s: The Finance Ministry announced that a specific function previously assigned to it has been removed, altering its operational scope.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's M3 money supply reached 56.0081 billion manat on Oct 1, up 1.9% month‑on‑month
stories.s: The Central Bank reported M3 grew 12.3% since the start of the year and 16.7% versus Oct 1 2025; M2, M1 and M0 also showed double‑digit annual gains.

stories.h: Expert Farid Mirzayev warns of personal data protection challenges in online lending
stories.s: Speaking at the 12th Investment and Sustainable Growth in Microfinance Conference, Mirzayev highlighted storage, security and regulatory compliance concerns for digital loan agreements.

stories.h: CBAR deputy director urges banks to regularly test cyber resilience
stories.s: Abid Alasgarzada said audits are insufficient and that Category 1 entities must have annual ISMS audits, while Category 2‑3 entities need assessments at least every two years, with backup restoration tests twice a year.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's Chamber of Accounts and 4SIM sign cooperation protocol
stories.s: The protocol was signed by Chief of Staff Tamerlan Yusifzade and 4SIM Executive Director Fariz Jafarov to develop joint training, AI initiatives and digital‑transformation projects.

stories.h: İpoteka və Kredit Zəmanəti Fondu icarəçilər olmayan şəxslərin əsas kredit alan kimi ipoteka krediti almasına imkan verən qaydaları dəyişib
stories.s: Dəyişiklik Fondla əlaqəli icarə müqaviləsində qeydə alınmayan şəxsin ipoteka krediti almasına imkan verir, həmçinin müraciətlər üçün SIMA elektron imzasının biometrik təsdiqləməsini tətbiq edir. Məqsəd şəffaflığı artırmaq və fırıldaqçılığın qarşısını almaqdır.
stories.he: Azerbaijan's Mortgage and Credit Guarantee Fund changes rules allowing non‑tenants to obtain mortgage loans as primary borrowers

stories.h: CBAR data chief says Azerbaijan's financial sector lacks a single reliable data source
stories.s: Elmir Hasanli noted that while data access has improved, institutions still face fragmented and inconsistent information, hindering sound decision‑making.

stories.h: Former Fed President Patrick Harker says the Fed will likely hold rates steady on Wednesday
stories.s: Harker warned the central bank may need to signal further tightening later, despite expecting no change now, according to Bloomberg.

stories.h: Azerbaijan joins the OIC Makkah Convention on anti‑corruption law‑enforcement cooperation
stories.s: Prosecutor General Kamran Aliyev said the accession was signed at the Baku meeting on Oct 27‑28 and will be ratified soon, aligning with Azerbaijan’s upcoming OIC chairmanship.

stories.h: CBAR deputy director Abid Alasgarzada sets 4‑hour initial cyber‑incident reporting deadline for financial institutions
stories.s: He announced at the 12th Investment and Sustainable Development in Microfinance Conference that an initial notification must be submitted within four hours, with a detailed report due within five days, and warned that delays breach regulations.

stories.h: Micro‑finance institutions lack budget and staff for cyber‑security, says AKTA
stories.s: AKTA director Rauf Cabarov reported at the 12th Micro‑Finance Investment and Sustainable Development Conference that over 50 micro‑finance entities operate, but only about 20% have been audited, highlighting limited finances and shortage of qualified experts despite CBAR's cyber‑security mandate.

stories.h: UK OFSI issues General Licence INT/2025/7895596 for Lukoil Bulgaria entities
stories.s: The Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation (OFSI) published a continuation licence allowing Lukoil Bulgaria entities to maintain business activities under existing sanctions rules.

stories.h: Azerbaijani manat's nominal effective rate rises to 105.7 points on Oct 1, 2026
stories.s: The rate increased 0.8 points month‑on‑month, 3.2 points since the start of the year and 3.1 points year‑on‑year, while the real effective rate reached 116.9 points, up 1.2 points MoM and 1.8 points YoY.

stories.h: Azerbaijan’s Karabakh and East Zangezur loan portfolio grows 16.5%
stories.s: The increase was reported by Trend News Agency, indicating higher lending activity in the two regions.

stories.h: CBAR mandates cybersecurity standards for Azerbaijan microfinance institutions
stories.s: AKTA Executive Director Rauf Jabarov said the new rule forces institutions to conduct audits and establish information security systems, highlighting funding and specialist shortages across an estimated 50 firms.

stories.h: OECD confirms Azerbaijan fully complies with country-by-country reporting standards
stories.s: The OECD’s ninth annual review found Azerbaijan meets all international requirements under BEPS Action 13, issuing no recommendations for improvement, according to the State Tax Service.

stories.h: PASHA Capital CEO says 10 million manat bond placed with Mortgage and Credit Guarantee Fund support
stories.s: Isi Mustafayev noted the guarantee could cut yields from around 15% to 12% and enable longer‑term securities, attracting more investors.

stories.h: ASA Executive Abas Miskarli says Azerbaijani insurers will limit risky assets to 2–3% of portfolios
stories.s: Speaking at the 12th Investment and Sustainable Development in Microfinance Conference, Miskarli warned insurers are unlikely to invest heavily in mortgage‑backed bonds despite collateral, citing conservatism and past US crisis lessons.

stories.h: ASA chief says insurers lack suitable investment instruments in Azerbaijan
stories.s: Executive Director Abas Miskarli warned that despite having funds, insurers cannot invest heavily in government bonds or parent bank assets due to diversification rules and rating requirements.

stories.h: Islamic finance expert urges legal and tax reforms to boost sector in Azerbaijan
stories.s: Abdurashid Ustaz Jorayev, Sharia board chairman, said at the AMFA micro‑finance conference that new instruments like ijara, salam and musharaka and changes to the Civil Code and tax rules are needed.

stories.h: AKTA expert raises data protection questions for remote lending in Azerbaijan
stories.s: Farid Mirzayev told the 12th Microfinance Investment and Sustainable Development Conference that digital contracts and video recordings create new challenges for storing and safeguarding client data.

stories.h: Russia faces 24,000–31,000 international sanctions, the highest globally
stories.s: According to Banker.az citing TASS, Iran, Syria, North Korea and Belarus follow with 4,500–5,500, 2,600–2,900, 2,100–2,200 and 1,400–1,900 sanctions respectively, based on counting methods.

stories.h: Kapital Bank leads Q3 2026 Azerbaijan bank RoE ranking with 29.45%
stories.s: AccessBank placed second with 25.27% RoE and Bank Respublika third at 23.46%, according to Banker.az data for the third quarter.

stories.h: Economist Claudia Sahm says there is a strong economic argument for a quarter‑point rate hike today
stories.s: Sahm, chief economist at New Century Advisors, highlighted confusion over the Fed's communication strategy on Bloomberg Surveillance

stories.h: EBRD says Azerbaijan's bank credit to GDP ratio of 35% shows scope for expanded green financing
stories.s: EBRD regional head Mixail Grechixo told a Sustainable Development Goals dialogue in Baku that banks can boost energy efficiency and eco‑projects through three financing channels, with support in manat and long‑term loans.

stories.h: Russia leads world with 24,000–31,000 international sanctions, according to TASS data
stories.s: The tally also places Iran, Syria, North Korea and Belarus among the most sanctioned nations, with ranges of 4,500–5,500; 2,600–2,900; 2,100–2,200; and 1,400–1,900 sanctions respectively.

stories.h: Foreign tourist card transactions in Azerbaijan reached 1.27 billion manat in Jan‑Sep 2026
stories.s: The volume rose 11.4% YoY to about 1.27 billion manat, with September alone seeing 181.7 million manat, a 14.7% increase over 2025, driven by Mastercard cards up 42.7%.

stories.h: Manat velocity rose to 3.02 points on Oct 1, up 0.06 points from Sept 1
stories.s: The Central Bank of Azerbaijan said the increase is 0.18 points versus the start of the year and 0.39 points lower than Oct 1 2025, with the 21‑year low at 2.68 points in Jan 2015 and a high of 15.72 points in 2005.

stories.h: PAŞA Kapital CEO says state guarantee on corporate bonds could cut yields to around 12%
stories.s: He cited Azərmaş Group's 10 million manat unsecured bond placed with the Mortgage and Credit Guarantee Fund and warned that guarantee systems may lower repo rates from about 15% to 12% and extend bond terms.

stories.h: Expert proposes Azerbaijan create securities market backed by microcredits
stories.s: Piotr Korynski suggested microfinance institutions hold loans for three months then sell 80% to a pool issuing bonds, urging a pilot and risk assessment before launch.

stories.h: Embafinans places 4 million manat of 13% unsecured bonds, fully subscribed by 151 investors
stories.s: The 400,000‑unit, 10 manat nominal issue was auctioned on the Baku Stock Exchange on 28 Oct 2026, with PAŞA Kapital Investment Company acting as underwriter, and the bonds will pay quarterly interest over a 12‑month term

stories.h: CBAR places 50 million manat 28‑day discount notes on Baku Stock Exchange
stories.s: The auction sold the full 50 million manat issue at an average price of 99,501.9956 manat (6.43%) with eight investors submitting orders totaling 102.1 million manat nominal.

stories.h: Banco.az publishes Q3 2026 rankings of Azerbaijani banks by profit, assets and loan portfolios
stories.s: The portal lists top banks for profit, assets, deposits, credit, mortgage and consumer loans, plus ROE and ROA rankings, linking to detailed data for each category.

stories.h: Azər Türk Bank (il, 2026): kredit portfeli 944 milyon 912 min manat (+20%); kredit portfeli 424 milyon 71 min manat (+35%)
stories.he: Azər Türk Bank's consumer loan portfolio grew 35% year‑on‑year to 424.071 million manat

stories.h: Banks must verify identity for cash FX trades over $500 sale or $10,000 purchase
stories.s: Under current law, customers receiving more than $500 in cash foreign currency or buying over $10,000 must present ID, and banks need enhanced AML procedures for transactions above 20,000 manat per year.

stories.h: ADB pledges continued support for Azerbaijan's microfinance sector, says Country Director
stories.s: The Asian Development Bank announced it will maintain its assistance programmes for micro‑finance institutions in Azerbaijan, aiming to expand credit access for small enterprises.

stories.h: AIA Executive Director says insurers avoid higher‑risk assets for only a 4‑point return gain
stories.s: Abas Miskarli highlighted limited investment options, liquidity needs and loan‑portfolio diversification as key factors shaping insurers' choices, at the 12th Microfinance Investments conference.

stories.h: Micro‑finance expert suggests establishing a securitisation market for micro‑credits in Azerbaijan
stories.s: Pyotr Korinski of the Azerbaijan Micro‑Finance Association said local currency funding and securitisation could reduce default risk and integrate micro‑finance into the broader financial system.

stories.h: ASA says Azerbaijani insurers may allocate only 2-3% of investment portfolios to risky assets
stories.s: Executive Director Abas Miskərli told the 12th Microfinance Investment and Sustainable Development conference that even with collateral, insurers will keep risky exposure minimal, citing past US financial crises.

stories.h: ASA executive Abas Miskərli says lack of investment instruments hampers Azerbaijani insurers
stories.s: Speaking at the 12th Microfinance Investment and Sustainable Development conference, Miskərli noted that insurers have free funds but limited suitable financial tools, restricting effective portfolio diversification.

stories.h: Qala Sığorta records 118.86% loss ratio in compulsory auto‑insurance, highest among peers
stories.s: The insurer's September 30 2026 report shows loss ratio fell from 126.62% a year earlier but remains top, while PAŞA Sığorta’s market share rose to 50% and overall premiums grew 12.5% to 151.59 mln manat.

stories.h: Azerbaijan adopts new law limiting officials' outside activities to prevent conflicts of interest
stories.s: The draft, part of the "Conflict of Interests" bill, bars officials from representing third parties and taking additional jobs without approval, with a two‑year post‑service restriction, except for scientific, pedagogical and creative work.

stories.h: EBRD says Azerbaijani banks are key to financing the green energy transition
stories.s: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development highlighted the importance of local banks in supporting Azerbaijan's shift to renewable energy projects, urging greater involvement from the sector.

stories.h: Microfinance institutions in Azerbaijan issued 65 million manat of bonds on the exchange
stories.s: At the 12th Microfinance Investment and Sustainable Development Conference, AKBA chair Orkhan Bagirov said the sector's total portfolio is 1.6 billion manat, with only about 20 % potentially financed via bonds, highlighting the market’s limited size.

stories.h: Islamic finance experts call for removal of tax barriers in Azerbaijan
stories.s: At the 12th Microfinance Investment and Sustainable Development Conference, Sharia Board Chair Abdurashid Ustaz Jorayev urged legislative changes to eliminate double taxation and adapt civil code provisions for Islamic finance tools.

stories.h: ASA executive director Abas Miskerli says liquidity requirements limit insurers' willingness to take higher‑risk investments
stories.s: He told the 12th Microfinance Investment and Sustainable Development Conference that insurers can earn only a 4% extra return, so they prefer short‑term liquid assets, citing limited investment tools and non‑bank credit organisations' needs.

stories.h: Azerbaijani BOKTs' credit portfolio grew over 58% to 1 billion 376.2 million manat in Jan‑Sep 2026
stories.s: Banco.az reported the portfolio reached 1 billion 376.2 million manat, marking a 58%+ increase compared with the previous period.

stories.h: Number of BOKT branches in Azerbaijan fell to 268 by September 2026, down 21 units (7.3%) from March
stories.s: The Central Bank of Azerbaijan reports that branch count dropped from 289 on 31 March 2026 to 268 on 30 September 2026, a 32‑unit (11%) decline compared with September 2025.

stories.h: Fed expected to hold rates steady at October meeting, says AG Capital strategist
stories.s: Casey Sprake noted the Fed's shift after the September hike and cited Kevin Warsh's changed view, speaking to Bloomberg ahead of the decision.

stories.h: Turkey's regulator cancels Tera Yatirim Menkul Degerler's brokerage licence and suspends its stock trading
stories.s: The decision is part of a broader dismantling of the brokerage, which has been at the centre of Turkey's ongoing fund crisis, according to Bloomberg.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's external state debt totals $4.5095 billion, with $1.3873 billion in Eurobonds
stories.s: The Ministry of Finance reports 86.3% of the debt is USD‑denominated, 48.8% floating‑rate, and 31% of the debt is Eurobonds, including $310.7 million due 2029 at 5.125% and $1.0766 billion due 2032 at 3.5%.

stories.h: Insurance firms limit investment in BOKT bonds despite 10‑15% yields, says ASA executive director
stories.s: Abas Mişkarlı noted that insurers' portfolios earn about 7‑8% and must keep sufficient liquid assets, so risk assessment and liquidity needs curb buying higher‑yielding BOKT securities.

stories.h: Capital of Azerbaijan's non‑bank credit organisations rose 52% over two years, assets up 60% to 1.6 billion manat
stories.s: CBAR supervision director Xəyyam İsmayılov said staff grew 30% to 4,500, bond issuance approached 100 million manat and liabilities rose 65%, reflecting growing trust in BOKTs.

stories.h: CBAR BOKT biznes kreditləri üçün rezerv tələblərini yumşaldır
stories.s: CBAR-ın direktoru Xəyyam İsmayılov 12-ci Mikrokreditləşdirmə, İnvestisiya və Davamlı İnkişaf Konfransında bu dəyişikliyi elan edib. Biznes kreditləri üçün daha yumşaq rezerv tələbləri tətbiq edilir, istehlak kreditləri üçün isə daha sərt qaydalar qorunur.
stories.he: CBAR relaxes reserve requirements for BOKT business loans

stories.h: Kazakhstan's microfinance portfolio reaches 1.7 trillion tenge (≈$3.723 billion)
stories.s: Chair Yerbol Omarxanov said 214 licensed micro‑finance institutions hold a total portfolio of 1.7 trillion tenge and a credit portfolio of 1.5 trillion tenge, underscoring the sector's growing importance.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's outstanding Eurobonds total $1.3873 bn unchanged since start of year
stories.s: The Ministry of Finance says the 31% share of external debt in Eurobonds remains at $1.3873 bn, with $310.7 mn at 5.125% maturing in 2029 and $1.0766 bn at 3.5% maturing in 2032.

stories.h: EBRD Azərbaycanda Mərkəzi Bankla birlikdə Yaşıl Enerji Effektivliyi Çərçivəsini təqdim edəcək
stories.s: EBRD-nin bank və maliyyə institutları üzrə regional rəhbəri Mikhail Grechko çərçivəni Bakıda keçirilən 9-cu Bəhrəli İnkişaf Məqsədləri Dialoqunda açıqlayıb. Çərçivə Mərkəzi Bank (CBAR) və dövlət orqanları ilə əməkdaşlıq çərçivəsində kapital cəlb edilməsi və imtiyazlı kreditlər vasitəsilə yaşıl maliyyəyə yönəlib.
stories.he: EBRD will launch a Green Energy Efficiency Framework in Azerbaijan with the Central Bank

stories.h: Azerbaijan's Ministry of Finance releases nine‑month 2026 state‑debt report
stories.s: The report, prepared by the State Debt and Financial Obligations Management Agency, covers the period up to September 2026 and details the country's public‑debt figures.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's domestic public debt stands at 16.23 billion manats as of Oct 1, 2026
stories.s: The debt level is just over 16.23 billion manats, roughly $9.55 billion, according to the latest data released on Oct 28, 2026.

stories.h: Azerbaijan drafts new "On Conflict of Interest" law
stories.s: The draft law aims to regulate conflicts of interest for officials and entities, and is being prepared by the relevant state body for parliamentary consideration.

stories.h: CBAR director says Azerbaijan's non‑bank leasing portfolio stands at 50 million manat
stories.s: Xəyyam İsmayılov told the 12th Micro‑Finance Investment and Sustainable Development Conference that the portfolio could grow after the new law’s adoption, citing Kazakhstan’s $520 million example.

stories.h: Expressbank launches cash consumer loan with minimum 8.5% annual rate
stories.s: Customers can borrow up to 100,000 manat for up to 59 months with commissions starting at 0% and repayment of the principal beginning after two months, the bank said.

stories.h: Aqrarkredit non-bank credit organization auctions two non‑residential properties worth 1.6875 million manat
stories.s: The properties, located in Baku's Xətai district, will be auctioned on 25 Nov 2026 at 11:00 at the auction venue on Xəlil Rza Ulutürk St., with initial prices of 237,500 manat and 1.45 million manat respectively.

stories.h: Azerbaijani court rejects bank's request to place a temporary ban on guarantor's cars
stories.s: Shirvan Commercial Court ruled the bank provided no concrete evidence of risk, stating that mere loan default does not justify a provisional asset freeze.

stories.h: Kazakhstan President Tokayev proposes higher taxes for wealthy individuals
stories.s: Tokayev said the time has come to discuss increased tax rates for high‑net‑worth citizens, tasking the government and parliament to draft proposals, though no rates or thresholds were disclosed.

stories.h: CBAR director Xeyyam Ismayilov announces risk‑based supervision system for non‑bank credit organisations
stories.s: Speaking at the 12th Microfinance Investment and Sustainable Development Conference, he said the new framework will assess risks and set criteria to make BOKTs more investment‑friendly.

stories.h: PAŞA Bank launches “Invite a Friend” bonus miles program for Miles&Smiles cards
stories.s: Existing cardholders can share their TK number to earn extra miles when friends apply, while new customers receive up to 3 000 Welcome Miles depending on card type.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's total public debt fell by about 2 billion 91.2 million manat in the first nine months of 2026
stories.s: The Ministry of Finance said the debt stood at 23,896.3 million manat on 1 Oct, an 8% drop from the start of the year, with external debt down 304 million USD and domestic debt down 1,574.4 million manat.

stories.h: Bond issuance by non‑bank credit organisations (BOKT) in Azerbaijan nears 100 million manat, roughly double the level two years ago
stories.s: CBAR’s Department of Supervision of Non‑Bank Credit Organisations director Xəyyam İsmayılov said the rise reflects stronger investor confidence and that sector obligations grew about 65% over the same period, data up to 30 September.

stories.h: Crypto sector loses about $2.9 billion in 2026 due to cyber‑attacks, CertiK reports
stories.s: CertiK data shows 730 incidents by end‑October 2026 resulted in roughly $2.9 billion stolen, with over 230 protocols suffering losses above $50 k each.

stories.h: CBAR plans regulatory changes to let non‑bank credit organisations offer new payment and leasing services
stories.s: CBAR's Non‑Bank Credit Organisations Supervision Department director Xəyyam İsmayılov said the draft law would permit account opening, money transfers, payment acceptance and cash services, aiming to expand BOKT revenue and grow the financial‑leasing portfolio beyond the current ~50 million manat.

stories.h: Average maturity of Azerbaijan's circulating government bonds rose to 3.64 years in Q3 2026
stories.s: The Ministry of Finance reported the figure increased by 0.34 years from the end of 2025, with 56% of the 7.7662 billion manat issue maturing within five years.

stories.h: Azerbaijan paid about 2.7 billion manat on government bonds in the first nine months of 2026
stories.s: The Finance Ministry says 2 billion 297.2 million manat went to principal repayment and 397.1 million manat to interest and discount, compared with 5.6836 billion manat paid in 2025.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's state-guaranteed debt fell 24% to 7.886 billion manat in the first nine months of 2026
stories.s: The Ministry of Finance said the drop was driven by the repayment of $2 billion worth of foreign-currency bonds guaranteed by the South Gas Corridor QSC, reducing external debt to 4.8578 billion manat (61.6%) and domestic debt to 3.0282 billion manat (38.4%).

stories.h: Azerbaijan's external sovereign debt totals $4.5095 bn as of 1 Oct 2026
stories.s: The Ministry of Finance reports 69.2% of the debt is loan‑based and 30.8% eurobonds, with 51.2% fixed‑rate and 86.3% denominated in USD; the debt fell $304 m (6.3%) since the start of 2026, representing 5.6% of GDP.

stories.h: Microfinance Center (MFC) pledges support for a new Azerbaijani micro‑finance model
stories.s: MFC executive director Katarjina Pavlak said at the 12th Microfinance Investment and Sustainable Development Conference in Baku that the initiative, developed with the Azerbaijan Central Bank, is moving from discussion to joint implementation.

stories.h: Fed meeting set for Oct 28 with ~92% chance of holding rates at 3.75‑4%
stories.s: CME FedWatch shows market expects the Fed to keep rates in the 3.75‑4% range, while some participants look for signals of future hikes; decision due at 14:00 EST (22:00 Baku time).

stories.h: Azerbaijan's MasterCard transaction volume fell 2.1% YoY to 4.2725 billion manat in Jan‑Sep 2026
stories.s: Visa volumes rose 6.6% to 8.3988 billion manat, while total card transactions dropped 268.9 million manat versus the same period last year, according to Fed.az data.

stories.h: CBA announces new prudential rules for non‑bank credit organisations
stories.s: Chairman Jalal Aliyev of AMFA said the regulator is tightening credit risk management, capital sustainability and consumer‑protection standards for NBCOs at the 12th Microfinance Conference in Baku.

stories.h: ADB partners with the Central Bank of Azerbaijan to strengthen micro‑finance regulatory framework
stories.s: ADB will provide technical assistance, policy advice and financing to AccessBank and other regional lenders to expand credit to SMEs and women‑owned businesses, building on the 2025 micro‑finance strategy.

stories.h: CBAR politika faiz dərəcəsini 6,5% səviyyəsində saxlayır, koridor 5%-7,5%
stories.s: İdarə Heyəti 29 oktyabr 2026-cı ildə politika faiz dərəcəsini 6,5% səviyyəsində saxlamaq, koridorun aşağı və yuxarı sərhədlərini isə müvafiq olaraq 5% və 7,5% səviyyəsində qorumaq qərarına gəlib. Qərarın əsas səbəbi kimi inflyasiya dinamikası və likvidlik şəraiti göstərilib.
stories.he: CBAR keeps policy rate at 6.5% with corridor 5%-7.5%

stories.h: ADB pledges continued support for Azerbaijan's micro‑finance sector development
stories.s: ADB country director Sunniya Durrani‑Jamal said the bank will work with the Central Bank of Azerbaijan on financial‑inclusion strategies and regulatory framework upgrades for micro‑finance, including credit mechanisms for local institutions.

stories.h: Microfinance Centre says Azerbaijan's microfinance sector remains resilient amid crises
stories.s: Executive Director Katarzyna Pawlak told the XII Azerbaijan Microfinance Conference that the sector has continued to develop despite the global financial crisis, COVID‑19 and other uncertainties, highlighting AMFA's initiatives on transparency and client rights.

stories.h: IFC sees potential for product certificates to expand agricultural financing in Azerbaijan
stories.s: IFC Azerbaijan representative Aliya Ezimova told the XII Azerbaijan Microfinance Conference that the draft law under parliamentary review could enable new tools, linking farmers, buyers and lenders and attracting more investors.

stories.h: Staff in non-bank credit organisations (BOKT) rose to 4,548 in September 2026
stories.s: The number grew from 3,831 in September 2025, an increase of 717 people or 18.7% year‑on‑year, and up 319 (7.5%) from March 2026, according to the Central Bank of Azerbaijan.

stories.h: Bank Melli Iran Baku branch leads Q3 2026 Azerbaijani bank RoA ranking with 3.67%
stories.s: AccessBank placed second with 3.20% RoA, ABB third at 2.92%, while Kapital Bank and Bank VTB ranked fourth and fifth at 2.84% and 2.78% respectively.

stories.h: Azerbaijan plans to join the Mecca Anti‑Corruption Convention
stories.s: Prosecutor General Kamran Aliyev announced the intention at an OIC anti‑corruption officials meeting, noting the country has already ratified UNCAC and related UN and Council of Europe conventions.

stories.h: CBAR to approve strategic framework for Azerbaijan microfinance sector
stories.s: Jalal Aliyev, AMFA chairman, said the framework will focus on financial inclusion, responsible lending, long‑term funding, digitalisation and impact measurement, urging cooperation of state bodies and investors.

stories.h: CBAR deputy chair Toğrul Əliyev says digital transformation expands financing for small entrepreneurs
stories.s: Speaking at the 12th Microfinance Investment and Sustainable Development Conference in Baku, he highlighted lower service costs, better credit assessment and new cyber‑risk challenges for banks and micro‑finance institutions.

stories.h: CBAR announces work to improve BOKT operations and align them with corporate values
stories.s: CBAR is enhancing prudential rules, credit‑risk management and other norms for non‑bank credit organisations, aiming to strengthen capital resilience and consumer protection, said AMFA chair Jalal Aliyev at the micro‑finance conference.

stories.h: Financial Monitoring Service chief Zaur Fətizadə says Azerbaijan's legislation aligns 90-95% with international standards
stories.s: He made the comment at the 12th Microfinance Investment and Sustainable Development conference in Baku, noting a 91% rating in international assessments and stressing the need to boost implementation effectiveness.

stories.h: CBAR deputy governor Toğrul Əliyev announces upcoming legislative changes for BOKTs
stories.s: At the 12th Microfinance Investment and Sustainable Development Conference, he said BOKT assets grew 2.3‑fold and their sector share rose to 2.4%, prompting a package of charter‑capital and corporate‑governance reforms.

stories.h: XII International Microfinance Conference held in Baku to attract investment
stories.s: Organised by the Azerbaijan Microfinance Association, the event gathered state officials, international finance institutions, banks, BOKTs, insurers and investors to discuss funding, regulatory mechanisms and digital transformation in microfinance.

stories.h: CBAR to amend charter‑capital requirements for BOKTs
stories.s: Deputy Governor Toğrul Əliyev announced at the 12th Microfinance Investment and Sustainable Development Conference that the regulator will introduce a package of changes to boost BOKT capital and corporate‑governance standards.

stories.h: Voluntary insurance payments in Azerbaijan rose 30.8% to 756.9 million manat in Jan‑Sep 2026
stories.s: The increase outpaced premium growth, which rose 12.6% to 992.87 million manat, indicating higher compensation payouts by insurers.

stories.h: IFC outlines three priority areas for Azerbaijan's micro‑finance sector
stories.s: IFC country representative Aliye Azimova presented the priorities at the 12th Micro‑finance Investment and Sustainable Development conference organized by the Azerbaijan Micro‑finance Association.

stories.h: Maliyyə Monitorinqi Xidməti chair Zaur Fətizadə calls for risk‑based supervision of financial operations
stories.s: Speaking at the XII Azerbaijan Microfinance Conference, he said low‑risk activities should have simplified measures while high‑risk operations need stronger oversight, stressing balance between financial inclusion and safety.

stories.h: CBAR deputy chairman Toğrul Əliyev urges attracting alternative financing to micro‑finance sector at conference
stories.s: He highlighted the need for transparent reporting, strong corporate governance, reliable risk assessment and a clear regulatory framework, and stressed digital transformation to lower costs and expand access.

stories.h: CBAR deputy chair Toğrul Əliyev says a legislative package to reform non‑bank credit organisations is being drafted
stories.s: He announced the initiative at the XII Azerbaijan Micro‑Finance Conference, noting it aims to strengthen institutional foundations, attract investors and expand alternative financing channels.

stories.h: Goldman Sachs Vice Chairman Robert Kaplan says the Fed can wait to hike rates
stories.s: Kaplan, former Dallas Fed chief, argues the Fed could skip a meeting and keep rates unchanged while assessing economic data, Bloomberg reports.

stories.h: Fed expected to keep rates unchanged on Wednesday despite hotter September inflation
stories.s: Bloomberg forecasts the Federal Reserve will hold interest rates steady on the decision day, even though September inflation data came in above expectations.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's small payments clearing volume rose 28% in September
stories.s: Trend News Agency reported the increase, indicating higher activity in the domestic payments system for the month.

stories.h: CBAR will announce its policy rate decision on October 29
stories.s: The Central Bank of Azerbaijan confirmed the date for its next monetary policy meeting, signalling when the new rate will be disclosed.

stories.h: AZIPS transaction volume in Azerbaijan rose 36% year‑on‑year
stories.s: The interbank payment system reported a 36% increase in transaction volume compared with the same period last year, according to Trend News Agency.

stories.h: OFAC reaches settlement with Extreme Networks, Inc.
stories.s: The U.S. Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control announced a settlement agreement with networking equipment maker Extreme Networks, Inc., resolving alleged sanctions violations.

stories.h: Ripple receives OCC unconditional charter to launch a national trust bank
stories.s: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency granted Ripple final approval, allowing it to offer fiduciary digital‑asset custody, manage RLUSD reserves and act as a collateral trustee, while BNY and Robinhood expand partnership for tokenized assets.

stories.h: Rabitəbank marks the first anniversary of its Rabita Junior app and Kartmane Junior Visa card
stories.s: The bank held an event with ten selected children and parents at its head office, showcasing the products' features and gathering feedback, while distributing gifts and cutting a celebratory cake.

stories.h: Goldman Sachs' Robert Kaplan warns Fed of structural inflation pressures
stories.s: Kaplan says high diesel prices and other structural factors are driving inflation and cautions that aggressive rate hikes could hurt weak sectors, urging a slower policy pace.

stories.h: EU securities watchdog chair says SEC‑Lite plan unlikely to match US scope in her lifetime
stories.s: The outgoing chair warned that stronger market oversight will depend on governance reforms that enable swift regulator action, but she doubts the EU can achieve parity with the US SEC soon.

stories.h: CFTC plans to publish Commitments of Traders report twice weekly by year‑end
stories.s: The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission said it will increase the frequency of its widely followed report to twice a week, aiming to implement the change before the end of 2026.

stories.h: Azerbaijan banking sector net income rose by almost 19%
stories.s: The latest figures show a near‑19% increase in net income across the sector, according to PLAT.AZ.

stories.h: Azerbaijan International Bank launches second phase of bond issuance worth AZN 15 million
stories.s: The bank offered two tranches: AZN 5 million 12‑month bonds at 8.5% coupon and AZN 10 million 24‑month bonds at 9% coupon, with monthly coupon payments and a two‑week subscription period.

stories.h: Azerbaijan Ministry of Finance auctions AZ0201240097 state bonds on Baku Stock Exchange
stories.s: The 720‑day bond with ISIN AZ0201240097 was offered in an auction on 27 October at the Baku Stock Exchange, according to the Ministry of Finance.

stories.h: Fitch Solutions forecasts a gradual decline in Azerbaijan's policy rate through 2028
stories.s: The forecast was published by Fitch Solutions on 27 Oct 2026, projecting a step‑down in the central bank's key rate over the next two years.

stories.h: Azerbaijan central bank announces tomorrow's dollar exchange rate
stories.s: The announcement was published on Fed.az on 2026-10-26, providing the official rate for the next day.

stories.h: Atəşgah Həyat Sığorta Şirkəti ASC (9 ay, 2026): xalis mənfəət 12.91 mln. manat (+55.1%)
