stories.he: Atəşgah Həyat insurer's investment portfolio reaches 98.05 mln AZN, deposits share rises to 66.7%

stories.h: Turkish insurer Turkiye Sigorta shares plunge after two top executives are arrested in a fund manipulation probe
stories.s: Local media say the arrests are part of a sweeping investigation into alleged market manipulation in Turkish investment funds, raising concerns over the company's governance and market confidence.

stories.h: Azerbaijan’s non-bank credit institutions post a 2.55‑fold rise in net profit
stories.s: The sector’s net profit surged to 2.55 times the previous period, according to the latest figures released on 27 Oct 2026.

stories.h: Maliyyə Nazirliyi 200 milyon manatlıq 720 günlük kuponlu obligasiyanı auksionda yerləşdirib
stories.s: AZ0201240097 identifikatorlu obligasiya orta qiyməti 98,1774 manat (6,9923% gəlirlilik) səviyyəsində satılıb. Yerləşdirilmiş həcm 49,909,400 manat təşkil edib, auksionda 12 investor iştirak edib.
stories.he: Azerbaijan's Ministry of Finance auctions 200 million manat 720‑day coupon bond

stories.h: Azerbaijan payment cards reach 23.38 million, up 9.5% YoY
stories.s: The number of payment cards in Azerbaijan grew to 23.38 million, a 9.5% increase compared with the previous year, according to Trend News Agency.

stories.h: Fitch Solutions forecasts Central Bank of Azerbaijan will cut key interest rate to 6% in 2026
stories.s: The prediction was published by Fitch Solutions, citing the Central Bank, but no official decision has been announced yet.

stories.h: Fitch Solutions forecasts AMB's policy rate to fall to 6% by end‑2026
stories.s: The forecast says the rate will drop to 6% in 2026, then to 5.88% in 2027, 5.44% in 2028 and 5.66% in 2029, citing easing inflation and regional supply‑chain risks.

stories.h: Draft law proposes fines of 250‑1,000 manat for state‑service notification breaches and up to 3,000 manat for illegal court‑expertise activi
stories.s: The bill, examined by the parliament's Legal Policy and State Building Committee, outlines penalties ranging from 250 to 1,000 manat for various failures to inform service users and 2,000‑3,000 manat for unauthorized court‑expert work, with additional fines for influencing experts.

stories.h: CBAR yeni qayda təqdim etdi: sənədləşdirilmiş gəlir yoxlaması tələb olunur, zəmanətçilərin borc yükü aylıq nəzərə alınan gəlirin 70%-i ilə məhdudlaşdırılır
stories.s: 9 noyabr 2026-cı ildən qüvvəyə minən qayda davranış modeli əsaslı gəlir qiymətləndirmələrindən istifadəyi qadağan edir və zəmanətçilər üçün borc/gəlir nisbəti limitini 70% səviyyəsində müəyyən edir. Qayda bütün istehlak krediti qiymətləndirmələrinə aiddir.
stories.he: CBAR introduces new rule requiring documented income verification and limiting guarantor debt load to 70% of net monthly income

stories.h: Azerbaijan Business Development Fund reports assets of about $950 million
stories.s: Fund director Mikayıl Əliyev said the fund can invest up to $20 million per project and typically holds up to 30% minority stakes for 5–7 years, focusing on food, pharma, construction materials and green energy.

stories.h: Cashless payments in Azerbaijan grew 0.9% YoY in September 2026, while electronic commerce payments fell 0.7%
stories.s: The number of payment cards rose to 23.388 million, up 9.5% year‑on‑year, with debit cards up 11% and credit cards down 3.9%; POS‑terminal payments jumped 12.3% to 1.22 billion manat.

stories.h: KollektA ASC's 1 million manat unsecured bond listed on Baku Stock Exchange
stories.s: The BFB Listing Committee approved the bond (ISIN AZ2002028671) for the Standard Market segment after a auction on 27 Oct 2026, issuing 10,000 units at 100 manat each with a 16% monthly coupon for 18 months, attracting 51 investors.

stories.h: Overdue loans in Azerbaijan increased 42.8% year-on-year
stories.s: The latest data shows a sharp rise in non-performing loans across the banking sector, highlighting growing credit risk pressures.

stories.h: 51 investors placed 52 orders for 1 million AZN of KollektA's 18‑month 15% bonds on Baku Stock Exchange
stories.s: The auction offered 10 000 bonds with a 100 AZN nominal value each, underwritten by Unicapital and Troni Investment firms, and was fully subscribed.

stories.h: PAŞA Həyat Sığorta reports 769.5 million manat assets in Q3 2026, topping the market
stories.s: According to Banco.az, the insurer leads the Azerbaijani insurance sector with assets of 769.5 million manat for January‑September 2026, as disclosed by researcher Gülnar Əhmədli.

stories.h: Parliament proposes fines of 3,000‑5,000 AZN for punishing corruption whistle‑blowers
stories.s: The draft amendment to the Criminal and Administrative Offences Code would also fine 800‑1,300 AZN for intimidation or harassment of whistle‑blowers or their relatives, according to the committee meeting.

stories.h: Average credit‑card interest rate in Azerbaijan rose to 27% in September 2026
stories.s: CBAR data shows credit‑card rates increased from 25% at end‑2025 to 27% by 30 Sept 2026, while auto loan rates rose to 14% and other consumer loan rates fell to 20% or 25% for appliances.

stories.h: Azerbaijani banks earned 3.38 bn AZN in credit interest income Jan‑Sep 2026, up 17% YoY
stories.s: The Central Bank says interest income rose by 493 m AZN from 2.887 bn AZN in the same period of 2025, while interest expenses reached 1.548 bn AZN, mainly on deposits.

stories.h: Business credit portfolio reaches 18.44 billion manat, micro‑enterprise loans rise by 530.6 million manat
stories.s: CBAR data shows total business loans up 14.9% YoY to 18.44 bn manat, with the micro‑enterprise segment increasing by 530.6 mn manat (22.2% share) and other segments also growing.

stories.h: PAŞA Bank (9 ay, 2026): xalis mənfəət 133,8 milyon manat (+0,7%); aktivlər 9,99 milyard manat (+11,8%); faiz gəlirləri 441,6 milyon manat (+11,3%)
stories.he: PAŞA Bank shares rise 5.2% to 55 AZN, reaching IPO price as Q3 profit jumps to 66 million AZN

stories.h: Azerbaijani banks earned 3.3797 bn manat in loan interest and paid 1.130 bn manat in deposit interest in Jan‑Sep 2026
stories.s: Interest income rose 17.1% YoY to 3.3797 bn manat, while deposit‑interest costs increased 20.4% to 1.130 bn manat, according to the Central Bank data cited by Banco.az and Banker.az.

stories.h: Azərbaycan banklarının gecikmiş kreditləri 754,3 milyon manata çatdı — illik artım 35,3%
stories.s: Mərkəzi Bankın məlumatına görə, sentyabrın sonunda ümumi gecikmiş kredit portfeli 754,3 milyon manata çatıb — bu, il başına nisbətən 196,8 milyon manat artım deməkdir. Gecikmiş kreditlərin payı isə 1,86%-dən 2,24%-ə yüksəlib.
stories.he: Azerbaijan banks' overdue loans rose to 754.3 million manat, up 35.3% YoY

stories.h: CBAR reports September 2026 bank sector assets at AZN 63.6217 bn, liabilities AZN 55.783 bn
stories.s: The sector saw 1.8% asset growth, 1.9% liability rise and a 1.1% increase in balance‑sheet capital, with credit portfolio up 2.6% to AZN 33.6847 bn.

stories.h: Azerbaijani banks earned 344.4 million manat in commissions Jan‑Sept 2026, up 8.2% YoY
stories.s: The Central Bank says commission income rose by 26 million manat from 318.4 million manat a year earlier, with July the peak month at 43.2 million manat and January the low at 33.3 million manat.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's securities market volume fell 32% YoY to 34.9047 billion manat in Jan‑Sep 2026
stories.s: The drop is based on CBAR data, with primary market transactions of 5.9317 billion manat up 4.2% and secondary market at 28.973 billion manat down 36.5%; 49,622 deals were closed, 2.1 times the previous year.

stories.h: HSBC (III rüb, 2026): xalis mənfəət 9,6 milyard dollar (+32%)
stories.he: HSBC reports 32% rise in Q3 pre‑tax profit to $9.6 bn, shares slip about 6%

stories.h: AFC and Munich Re agree to share $1 billion of African trade‑finance risk
stories.s: AFC CEO Samaila Zubairu said the partnership will expand African growth and productivity by transferring the risk to Munich Re, according to Bloomberg.

stories.h: Azerbaijan banks' credit portfolio reached 33.6847 billion manat by end‑September, 12% up YoY
stories.s: The Central Bank reports the portfolio grew from 30.063 billion manat at year start, with monthly average new credit of 402.4 million manat; business, consumer and mortgage loans all rose markedly.

stories.h: Bank staff count rises to 903 employees
stories.s: The bank announced its workforce grew to 903 employees, up from the previous level, according to Fed.az.

stories.h: Kartdan-karta limit fondu sayəsində ödəniş kartlarının sayı sentyabrın sonuna qədər 1,8% artaraq 23,388 milyona çatıb
stories.s: Mərkəzi Bankın (CBAR) məlumatlarına görə, ödəniş kartlarının sayı avqustun sonuna nisbətən 414 min artıb. Bu, avqustda 0,8% olan artım tempinin sürətlənməsi deməkdir.
stories.he: Card-to-card limit fund spurs 1.8% rise in payment cards to 23.388 million by end‑September

stories.h: Meqa Sığorta ASC (9 ay, 2026): xalis mənfəət 2,78 milyon manat (−7,5%); gəlirlər 28,1 milyon manat (+8,4%)
stories.he: Meqa Insurance's compulsory car insurance loss ratio jumps to 106.77% in first nine months of 2026

stories.h: Mortgage fund disbursed 370.7 million manat in Q1‑Q3 2026, up 4.6% YoY
stories.s: The figure exceeds the 354.4 million manat in the same period of 2025; September alone saw 107.8 million manat, 4.3 times August and 2.2 times September 2025, according to CBAR data.

stories.h: Parlament İcra Qanununa sənədli qiymətli kağızların dərhal müsadirəsinə imkan verən dəyişiklik qəbul edib
stories.s: Dəyişiklik icra orqanlarının əməkdaşlarından müəyyən edilmiş qiymətli kağızları müsadirə edib eyni gün mərkəzi depozitara, emitentə və sahibə məlumat verməsini tələb edir; tənzimlənən bazar üzrə təkliflər və satışlar üçün təfərrüatlı qaydalar nəzərdə tutulur.
stories.he: Parliament adopts amendment to the Execution Law allowing immediate seizure of documented securities

stories.h: Payment cards in circulation reached 23.388 million in September 2026
stories.s: The figure rose by 414,000 from August, a 9.5% year‑on‑year increase, with debit cards up 11.0% and credit cards down 3.9%, according to the Central Bank of Azerbaijan.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's credit unions posted a net loss of 1.5 million manat in the first nine months of 2026
stories.s: The sector's revenue fell 5.9% to 1.6 million manat and expenses dropped 10% to 0.9 million manat, while reserves rose 3.7‑times, and balance sheet capital fell 20.4% to 8.2 million manat.

stories.h: Azərbaycanın bankdan kənar kredit təşkilatları 2026-cı ilin yanvar-sentyabrında 153,4 milyon manat xalis qazanc əldə edib, bu, əvvəlki ilə nisbətən 2,55 dəfədir
stories.s: Azərbaycan Mərkəzi Bankının məlumatına görə, sektorda əməliyyat gəlirləri 62,9% artaraq 538,2 milyon manata çatıb, aktivlər isə illik 49,3% artımla 1,5587 milyard manata yüksəlib.
stories.he: Azerbaijan's non‑bank credit organisations posted a net profit of 153.4 million manat in Jan‑Sep 2026, 2.55‑times the previous year

stories.h: Domestic cashless payments in Azerbaijan reached 8.977 billion manat in September 2026
stories.s: According to the CBAR statistics bulletin, 7.755 billion manat were from e‑commerce, 1.220 billion from POS terminals and about 2 million from ATMs, with e‑commerce accounting for 86.4% of September’s volume.

stories.h: Yapı Kredi Bank Azərbaycan (9 ay, 2026): xalis mənfəət 9,25 milyon manat (+19,9%); aktivlər 1,009 milyard manat (+27,3%)
stories.he: Yapı Kredi Bank Azerbaijan posted 9.25 million manat net profit in the first nine months of 2026, assets topped 1.009 billion manat

stories.h: Azerbaijan's banking sector net profit rose 18.8% YoY to 1.082 billion manats in Jan‑Sep 2026
stories.s: Operating income reached 5.734 billion manats, up 13.65%, while expenses grew 9.75% and special reserves rose 36.9%, according to the Central Bank of Azerbaijan.

stories.h: Overdue loans in Azerbaijan reached 754.3 million manat as of Oct 1, up over 4% in the past month
stories.s: Banco.az reports that the amount of past‑due credit grew by more than 4% in the last month, bringing the total to 754.3 million manat.

stories.h: ABB, PAŞA and Kapital Bank rank top three in Q3 2026 business loan portfolios
stories.s: ABB led with 3.8 billion manat in business loans, PAŞA Bank followed with 3.7 billion, and Kapital Bank placed third with 2.3 billion manat, according to Q3 data published by Banco.az.

stories.h: Bank sector employment in Azerbaijan reached 27,775 staff at end of September 2026
stories.s: The figure rose from 27,773 at end‑August and 26,872 in the same period last year, an increase of 903 staff year‑on‑year, according to the Central Bank of Azerbaijan.

stories.h: State Mortgage and Credit Guarantee Fund lent 371 million manat in nine months
stories.s: The fund issued 370.7 million manat of new mortgage loans, 4.6 % up YoY, while refinancing fell 5.6 % to 289.3 million manat; bond‑raised funds dropped 27.3 % to 400 million manat and budget allocations rose 33.4 % to 63.9 million manat.

stories.h: Azerbaijan Central Bank to announce its next policy rate decision on Oct 29
stories.s: The board will present the new interest corridor parameters, after keeping the base rate at 6.5% and lowering the lower corridor limit to 5% in its previous decision.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's banking sector assets reached 63.6217 billion manats, up 13.3% YoY as of Oct 1
stories.s: The Central Bank of Azerbaijan reports total assets of 63 billion 621.7 million manats, with liabilities at 55 billion 783 million manats and balance‑sheet capital of 7 billion 838.7 million manats; net foreign assets rose 22.6% YoY to 32.7848 billion manats.

stories.h: Azərbaycanda icbari həyat sığortası premiyaları 2026-cı ildə 46,731 milyon manata düşərək, illik 34,9% azalıb
stories.s: Azərbaycan Mərkəzi Bankının məlumatına görə, premiyalar keçən ilin 71,811 milyon manatından 25,080 milyon manat azalıb, sığorta ödənişləri isə 3,102 milyon manata enərək, 2025-ci ildən 27% aşağı olub.
stories.he: Compulsory life insurance premiums in Azerbaijan fell to 46.731 million manat in 2026, a 34.9% drop year‑on‑year

stories.h: Azerbaijan's central bank explores risk‑based auto‑insurance tariffs
stories.s: Ramin Cəfərov said the initiative will use digital tech and AI to assess drivers' personal risk profiles, but no decision on changing rates for all drivers has been announced yet.

stories.h: September figures for pension, monthly allowance and presidential scholarship recipients released
stories.s: The latest counts of individuals receiving pensions, monthly benefits and the President's scholarship for September were published, though specific numbers were not disclosed in the source.

stories.h: Azerbaijan insurers paid 882.7 million manat in claims Jan‑Sep 2026, up 29.1% YoY
stories.s: The Central Bank reports total claims of 882,723 million manat, with PAŞA Life leading at 548,526 million manat, representing about 86.9% of market payouts.

stories.h: Tax authority clarifies that foreign subcontractors under HPBS pay only 5% withholding tax, not an additional 10%
stories.s: The State Tax Service confirmed that the 5% tax applies regardless of the subcontractor's registration in a preferential tax jurisdiction, rejecting the need for an extra 10% levy.

stories.h: Expressbank cuts maximum annual deposit rates by up to 0.5 percentage points
stories.s: The bank lowered the top rates for its Extra Digital, Classic, Mücrü and Ürsət products, with maximum yields now ranging from 9% to 9.5% instead of 10% to 11%, affecting customer earnings.

stories.h: CBAR publishes official manat exchange rates for Oct 26 and Oct 27
stories.s: The Central Bank of Azerbaijan released the daily rates for the Azerbaijani manat on 26 Oct and 27 Oct, as reported by Anews.az and Trend News Agency.

stories.h: Bank Respublika secures a $40 million loan from the Asian Development Bank to support regional entrepreneurship
stories.s: The loan, signed with ADB, will target rural firms, farmers and women entrepreneurs across Azerbaijan, according to the bank and development agency.

stories.h: Türkiyənin tənzimləyici orqanı fondların likvidasiyası ilə bağlı araşdırma çərçivəsində Tera Portföy və Pusula Portföy-ün bazar fəaliyyətini dayandırıb
stories.s: Kapital Bazarları Şurası (SPK) 131 fondun bağlanması üçün işarələnmasından sonra iki şirkətin bütün kapital bazarı əməliyyatlarının müvəqqəti dayandırılmasına qərar verib və fondlarının likvidasiyasının nəzarət altına alınması üçün Işbank və Ziraat Bank-ı təyin edib.
stories.he: Turkey's regulator halts market activities of Tera Portföy and Pusula Portföy amid fund liquidation probe

stories.s: The latest data shows a decline in collected premiums and a sharp increase in claim payments, indicating pressure on insurers' profitability.

stories.s: The European Investment Bank expressed support for the corridor while requesting detailed information on funding sources and risk mitigation measures, according to AzerNews.

stories.h: PASHA Bank co-hosts event to support SMEs' import and export operations
stories.s: The event, organized by PASHA Bank, aims to help small and medium enterprises improve their cross‑border trade capabilities, according to Trend News Agency.

stories.h: Oliver Wyman warns legal uncertainty for first Russian diesel shipment under Trump-Putin deal

stories.s: CBAR Governor Tarlan Rasulov led a delegation at the first Capital Markets Development Forum, where regulators from 11 CAREC states and ADB set up a framework and strategy for 2027‑2031 to boost regional bond markets.

stories.h: Kapital Bank's Q3 expenses total $575 million, topping the Azerbaijan ranking
stories.s: The bank reported $575 million in expenses for the third quarter, the highest among Azerbaijani banks, according to Trend News Agency.

stories.h: Bank VTB Azerbaijan will hold an extraordinary shareholders' meeting
stories.s: The meeting, announced by the bank, will address dividend payments for 2026 and the distribution of the bank's profit, according to the notice published on Fins.az and Fed.az.

stories.h: S&P says Turkey's policy shift supports BB- rating but banking risks remain significant
stories.s: Analysts Karen Vartapetov and Regina Argenio note disinflation progress and tight policy aid the rating, while high financing costs and fund liquidation pose manageable banking risks.

stories.h: Bank of Baku's deposit portfolio reaches 1,059,090,000 manat, up 43.1% YoY
stories.s: The bank's legal‑entity deposits doubled, rising by 318,834,000 manat, while individual deposits grew to 913,942,000 manat, compared with year‑end 2025 figures.

stories.h: Head of Operations Teymur Ağakişiyev leaves AccessBank amid pending merger with Bank Respublika
stories.s: Ağakişiyev, who joined AccessBank in April 2025 and became a board member in December, said the timing was right as the bank prepares for new shareholders and structure following the approved merger terms with Bank Respublika.

stories.h: Meta's AI spending pushes 5‑year CDS to record 119.3 basis points
stories.s: Bloomberg data shows the credit‑default swap hit 119.3 bps on Oct 22, the highest since trading began, as AI investment plans raise debt‑service concerns.

stories.h: Bank of Russia keeps key rate at 14.00% amid persistent inflation pressures
stories.s: The Board decided on 23 Oct 2026 to hold the rate unchanged, noting inflation expectations remain high and price growth stays at 5‑6% annually.

stories.h: Azerbaijan attracted about $49 billion in foreign investment from 2020‑2025, Deputy Minister Samad Bashirli says
stories.s: Bashirli told a UN‑partnered dialogue in Karabakh that $36 billion was FDI, the economy grew 3.4% annually, non‑oil sector expanded 6% and exports doubled over the period.

stories.h: Karabakh region GDP rose from 1.548 bn to 6 bn manats between 2020 and 2025
stories.s: MP Vugar Bayramov said industrial output in Aghdam hit 1 bn manats in 2025, 17.4 times last year, while East Zangazur grew to 4 bn manats, reflecting reconstruction efforts.

stories.h: Uzbekistan central bank delegation visits Azerbaijan's CBA for experience exchange
stories.s: The CBU team met CBA staff who presented on risk‑based audit plans, quality control, automation, reporting and audit‑recommendation follow‑up.

stories.h: Azərbaycan sığorta şirkətlərinin xalis qazancı 2026-cı ilin III rübündə 7% artaraq 130,72 milyon manata çatdı
stories.s: 15 sığorta və resurs şirkətlərinin birləşdirilmiş xalis qazancı bir il əvvəlki 122,68 milyon manata nisbətən artaraq 130,72 milyon manata çatdı; PAŞA Life, AzRe Reinsurance və PAŞA Insurance şirkətləri 88,79 milyon manat töhfə verərək paylarını 67,9%-ə çatdırdı.
stories.he: Azerbaijani insurers' net profit rises 7% to 130.72 million manat in Q3 2026

stories.h: Deposit Insurance Fund outlines compensation steps for bank insolvency cases
stories.s: The Fund says a court decision triggering liquidation or moratorium triggers a seven‑day public notice and compensation process, with follow‑up announcements, for protected deposits only.

stories.h: AzerGold plans to invest at least $100 million in Uzbekistan's Akba gold deposit
stories.s: The company will allocate $7.8 million for preparatory work and geological exploration, with a final investment decision expected in 2028, potentially creating up to 200 jobs.

stories.h: ECB consumer inflation expectations rise to 3.6% in September
stories.s: Median perceived inflation over the past 12 months increased to 3.6% from 3.5% in August, while 12‑month inflation expectations rose to 3.1% from 3.0%, according to the ECB survey.

stories.h: PAŞA Sığorta launches "Optimal KASKO" auto insurance with coverage up to 30,000 AZN
stories.s: The product offers four annual premium tiers from 500 to 3,000 AZN, with coverage ranging from 5,000 to 30,000 AZN, plus optional add‑ons and service packages.

stories.h: ECB Supervisory Board member Patrick Montagner outlines expanded scope of stress testing at ESRB workshop
stories.s: In his keynote in Kraków, Montagner said stress tests will now cover geopolitical and cyber risks and highlighted limits of current models, urging banks to integrate results into strategy and macro‑prudential oversight.

stories.h: Xalq Bank SOCAR Türkiyə üçün 1,6 milyard dollarlıq sindikat kreditinə qoşuldu
stories.s: Bank, First Abu Dhabi Bank və Mizuho Bank tərəfindən təşkil olunan, ümumilikdə 22 bankdan ibarət sindikata qoşularaq, SOCAR Türkiyənin mövcud kredit öhdəliklərini daha yaxşı şərtlərlə refinanslaşdırmaqda iştirak edib.
stories.he: Xalq Bank joins $1.6 billion syndicated loan for SOCAR Turkey

stories.h: Azerbaijan parliament ratifies updated Radio‑Telegraphy Regulation and tightens corporate liability for terrorism financing
stories.s: The amendments, adopted in the third reading, impose criminal liability on legal entities whose officials commit terrorism‑financing offenses due to inadequate oversight, regardless of the entity's benefit.

stories.h: Kazakhstan's National Bank cuts base rate to 15.75% from 16.25%
stories.s: The reduction, announced on Oct 23, continues the country's monetary easing as inflation fell to 9.3% in September, still above the 5% target.

stories.h: Azerbaijan Parliament adopts electronic contract rule for certain legal entities' public procurements
stories.s: The final reading approved amendments to the State Procurement Law, adding article 3.2.8-1 and 3.10-1 to require electronic signing of contracts, except when the supplier is a non‑resident, and defining a new category of entities exempt from the law’s scope.

stories.h: Swiss National Bank announces cooperation framework with Azerbaijan
stories.s: The SNB disclosed details of a new partnership aimed at enhancing financial sector collaboration, as reported by Trend News Agency on 23 Oct 2026.

stories.h: PAŞA Bank co-hosts forum on customs facilitation and financing for SMEs
stories.s: The event, organized with AFChamber and Deloitte Azerbaijan, discussed customs rules, digitalisation, logistics and financing options like factoring and letters of credit for import‑export operations.

stories.h: Remittances from Azerbaijan to Georgia fell 15.72% to $2.86 million in September
stories.s: The Georgian National Bank said outbound transfers from Azerbaijan dropped to $2.86 million, while inbound flows from Georgia rose to $7.06 million, up 9.29% year‑on‑year.

stories.h: AccessBank's credit portfolio grows by 87 million 427 thousand manat (6.6%) to 1 billion 421 million 626 thousand manat
stories.s: The portfolio reached 1 billion 421 million 626 thousand manat as of 30 Sept 2026, up from the end of 2025, with consumer loans at 315 million 208 thousand manat, business loans at 1 billion 74 million 36 thousand manat and real‑estate loans at 32 million 382 thousand manat.

stories.h: Rabitəbank launches micro‑credit up to AZN 100,000 for entrepreneurs
stories.s: The loan offers 15‑28% annual interest, terms of 3‑36 months and a six‑month grace period, with collateral required, according to the bank’s official information.

stories.h: Azerbaijan raises Mandatory Medical Insurance Fund budget share to 2.6% of state spending in 2027
stories.s: The 2027 state budget will allocate 1.1 billion manat, or 2.6% of expenditures, to the fund – a 22.2% increase over the 2026 forecast, according to the draft law on the 2027 budget.

stories.h: PAŞA Həyat Sığorta (III rüb, 2026): xalis mənfəət 41.15 mln. manat
stories.he: PAŞA Həyat Sığorta posted a profit of 41.1 million manat in Q3 2026, the highest among insurers

stories.h: State-owned companies raise expected dividends by 17 million manat
stories.s: The government announced that dividends from state enterprises will increase by 17 million manat, reflecting higher profitability across the sector.

stories.h: Azərbaycanın 2027-ci il büdcə qanunu bütün 67 şəhər və rayonlara köçürmələri nəzərdə tutmur
stories.s: 2027-ci il dövlət büdcəsi haqqında qanun layihəsində 67 belediyyədən hər birinin xərclərini öz gəlirləri hesabına ödəyəcəyi, mərkəzi subsidiyaların isə ayrılmasının nəzərdə tutulmadığı qeyd olunur.
stories.he: Azerbaijan's 2027 budget law omits transfers to all 67 cities and districts

stories.h: Global commodity, index and currency prices posted for 23 Oct 2026
stories.s: Brent rose to $113.95 per barrel, the Dow‑Jones reached 52,867.98 points and the USD/EUR rate held at 1.1210, among other market moves reported by Report.az.

stories.h: 2027 state budget reduces Nakhchivan subsidy by over 6% to 0.5% of total spending
stories.s: The allocation will fall to 198 million manat, a 6.4% cut from the 2026 forecast, representing 3.6% of overall state expenditures, according to the draft law.

stories.h: Azerbaijan submits draft 2027 state budget to parliament forecasting 39.254 bn manats revenue and 42.4 bn manats expenditure
stories.s: The draft law projects centralized revenue of 38.518425 bn manats and local revenue of 735.575 m manats, with centralized spending of 41.664425 bn manats and local spending of 735.575 m manats.

stories.h: Azerbaijan will allocate 410 million manats to reserve funds in 2027, equal to 1% of the state budget
stories.s: The draft 2027 State Budget law sets the President's reserve fund at 300 million manats and the budget reserve fund at 110 million manats, matching the 2026 allocation, while projected revenues reach 39.254 billion manats and expenditures 42.4 billion manats.

stories.h: Azərbaycan 2027-ci ildə dövlət zəmanətləri üçün yuxarı həddi 6 milyard manata qədər ikiqat artırır
stories.s: «2027-ci il Dövlət Büdcəsi haqqında» qanun layihəsi daxili borclanma limitini 2,5 milyard manat, xarici borclanma limitini isə 6 milyard manat səviyyəsində saxlayır, zəmanət limiti isə 6 milyard manata qədər ikiqat artırılır.
stories.he: Azerbaijan doubles the upper limit for state guarantees to 6 billion manats in 2027

stories.h: Azerbaijan's Ministry of Finance to auction 200 million manat medium‑term state bonds on Baku Stock Exchange
stories.s: The auction will run on 27 Oct 2026 from 10:00 to 11:00, with a 6.0% coupon, 720‑day term and PAŞA Kapital İ.Ş. as underwriter; non‑competitive orders may not exceed 20% of the issue size.

stories.h: Moody's reports Azerbaijan's banking assets have grown 11% annually since 2021
stories.s: The rating agency's analysis shows a consistent double‑digit increase in total banking sector assets over the past five years, highlighting strong growth momentum.

stories.h: U.S. Treasury proposes rule to implement the Comprehensive Outbound Investment National Security Act
stories.s: The Department of the Treasury released the proposal on 2026-10-22, aiming to tighten oversight of U.S. investments abroad for national security reasons.

stories.h: EU sanctions envoy says alumina from Ireland's Aughinish refinery fuels Russian weapons production
stories.s: David O’Sullivan warned that up to half of the alumina shipped to Rusal’s Russian smelters is used in the military‑industrial complex, urging the EU to address the issue despite current trade rules allowing alumina exports.

stories.h: Azerbaijan extends tax and social insurance incentives for tech park residents to 20 years
stories.s: The amendments, signed by President Ilham Aliyev, apply from Jan 1 2027 and cover income tax, dividends, property, 0% employee income tax and VAT benefits for startups paying foreign service providers.

stories.h: Fitch Solutions forecasts Iran's 2026/27 GDP to shrink 11% amid sanctions and conflict
stories.s: The analyst expects a 10.1% annual drop in Q1 2026/27, with oil‑gas output down 26.4% and inflation near 84%, while a possible Gulf of Oman deal has a 40% chance in early 2027.

stories.h: Ipoteka Bank of Uzbekistan reports nine-month profit of $173 million, a 20‑fold increase
stories.s: The bank said the surge reflects strong loan growth and higher interest margins, according to its latest financial statement released on Oct 22, 2026.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's State Accounting Chamber delegation discusses strengthening supreme audit institutions' independence in Bishkek
stories.s: The delegation led by Vüqar Gülməmmədov attended an international dialogue marking the 30th anniversary of Kyrgyzstan's State Accounting Chamber, sharing Azerbaijan's experience in external state financial oversight.

stories.h: ING forecasts Azerbaijan inflation at 5.7% for 2026
stories.s: The Dutch bank's economic outlook projects consumer price growth of 5.7% in Azerbaijan for the year 2026, according to its latest report.

stories.h: Azerbaijan central bank announces tomorrow's USD/AZN rate
stories.s: The Central Bank of Azerbaijan published the official USD to manat rate that will apply on the next business day.

stories.h: Turkey's central bank cuts the one‑week repo rate to 36% and overnight rates to 39% and 34.5%
stories.s: The Monetary Policy Committee, chaired by Governor Yaşar Fatih Karahan, said weaker domestic demand and decelerating inflation justify the tighter stance, while noting upside risks from energy prices.

stories.h: PAŞA Bank Georgia posted L6.469 bn (Manat4.205 bn) net profit for Jan‑Sep 2026
stories.s: The profit is 5.6 times the same period in 2025; pre‑tax profit rose 2.9 times to L6.178 bn (Manat4.016 bn) and assets grew 3.8 % to L662.054 bn (Manat430.335 bn).

stories.h: ING forecasts Azerbaijan's nominal GDP to reach 138.4 bn manats ($81.4 bn) in 2026
stories.s: The forecast projects the figure rising to 150.3 bn manats ($88.4 bn) in 2027 and 162.2 bn manats ($95.4 bn) in 2028, with per‑capita GDP climbing to $9,032 by 2028.

stories.h: Baku Stock Exchange approves trading permission for "GL" ASC unsecured bonds
stories.s: The BFB Listing Committee authorized the issue of 5,000 unsecured, interest‑bearing bonds with a face value of 100 manat each, total issuance 500,000 manat, 15% annual yield and a 7‑year term, to be traded via a mass auction.

stories.h: Atəşgah Həyat Sığorta Şirkəti ASC (9 ay, 2026): xalis mənfəət 12 milyon 911 min manat (+55%); aktivlər 128 milyon 667 min manat; kapital 13 milyon 13 min manat
stories.he: Atəşgah Həyat Insurance posted a 55% rise in Q3 net profit to 13 million manat

stories.h: CBAR to hold mobile public outreach meeting in Hajigabul on 2 November 2026
stories.s: The Central Bank will address consumer and investor queries in Shirvan, Bilasuvar, Neftchala and Hajigabul districts, with support via its hotline and WhatsApp number.

stories.h: ING forecasts Azerbaijan's 2026 foreign trade profit near $12 billion
stories.s: The Dutch bank projects the country's export‑import surplus will reach about $12 billion this year, according to its latest outlook.

stories.h: Central Bank of Azerbaijan says information security is a priority
stories.s: The regulator highlighted the importance of protecting data and systems in the banking sector, urging institutions to strengthen cyber‑risk controls.

stories.h: ING forecasts Azerbaijan's 2026 current account surplus at $9 billion, 11% of GDP
stories.s: The Dutch banking group projects export revenues of $29.1 billion and imports of $17.4 billion for 2026, with the surplus falling to $4.9 billion in 2027 and $4.3 billion in 2028 as oil prices normalize.

stories.h: ING says Azerbaijan remains the most resilient sovereign borrower in the Caucasus and Central Asia
stories.s: The report cites strong reserve assets, low public debt and a solid trade balance, but notes declining oil output and limited private investment as growth constraints.

stories.h: ING cuts Azerbaijan's 2027 inflation forecast to 5.4%
stories.s: The Dutch bank revised its outlook by 0.2 percentage points, citing recent data showing 5.6% inflation in 2025 and 5.7% in Jan‑Sep 2026.

stories.h: ING projects Azerbaijan's public debt at 20.9% of GDP in 2026
stories.s: The ING Group forecasts the debt-to-GDP ratio will stay below 21% in 2026, with external debt reaching $15.2 billion, and budget surplus of 3.4% of GDP.

stories.h: ING forecasts non-oil sector will drive Azerbaijan's economy over the next three years
stories.s: The Dutch ING Group says the non‑oil and gas sector will outpace oil growth through 2028, becoming the main engine of economic activity.

stories.h: World central banks bought over 79 tonnes of gold in August 2026, with China purchasing about 25 tonnes
stories.s: Goldman Sachs data shows the monthly average rose to 85 tonnes in the last three months, while the Netherlands moved 86 tonnes to London and France swapped 129 tonnes from New York for European gold

stories.h: International Bank of Azerbaijan leads domestic banks with $9.5 billion in assets, CBAR says
stories.s: The Central Bank of Azerbaijan reported that IBA’s total assets reached $9.5 billion, making it the largest bank in the country.

stories.h: CBAR publishes official manat exchange rates for Oct 21-23
stories.s: The Central Bank of Azerbaijan released the daily official rates for the Azerbaijani manat on October 21, 22 and 23, as reported by Anews.az and Trend News Agency.

stories.h: ING forecasts Azerbaijan Central Bank's forex reserves will hit $18.6 billion in 2026
stories.s: The estimate, cited by Banker.az and Report.az, shows reserves at $15.363 billion as of 30 Sept, up 33.4% year‑on‑year, with a projected decline to $15.6 billion by 2028.

stories.h: Qala Həyat Sığorta ASC (III rüb, 2026): xalis mənfəət 7.9 milyon manat (+79 min manat); depozitlər 25,8 milyon manat (+5,8 milyon manat)
stories.he: Qala Həyat Insurance posts net profit of 7.9 million manat for Q3 2026

stories.h: Barclays Q3 profit rises 12% to £2.3 bn and it plans to cut 5% of staff
stories.s: Reuters reports the profit matched forecasts, investment‑banking revenue fell to £3.1 bn, and the bank aims to lay off about 5 000 employees now with another 4 000 by the end of Q4.

stories.h: Xalq Sığorta ASC (III rüb, 2026): xalis mənfəət 5 milyon 740 min manat; aktivlər 95 milyon 512 min manat; depozitlər 31 milyon 900 min manat (+15 milyon 400 min manat)
stories.he: Xalq Sığorta insurer’s Q3 2026 deposits rise to 31.9 million manat, profit reaches 5.74 million manat

stories.h: Meqa Həyat Sığorta ASC (il, 2026): xalis mənfəət 3,4 milyon manat (+983 min manat); depozitlər 21,2 milyon manat
stories.he: Meqa Həyat Sığorta's net profit rises to 3.4 million manat in Q3 2026

stories.h: Turkish central bank cuts key policy rate by 100 basis points to 36%
stories.s: The decision was made at the Monetary Policy Committee meeting on 22 Oct 2026, also lowering overnight lending to 39% and borrowing to 34.5%, citing easing inflation and confirming market expectations.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's Ministry of Finance expands results‑based budgeting framework
stories.s: Ilham Karimov, head of the Results‑Based Budget Policy Department, said the mechanism, now in its eighth year, will be further adapted to local conditions and aims to boost reforms and transparency.

stories.h: Azərbaycan Sənaye Sığorta ASC (9 ay, 2026): xalis mənfəət 769 min manat; aktivlər 32,9 milyon manat; kapital 10,4 milyon manat
stories.he: Azerbaijan Industry Insurance posts AZN 0.769 million profit for Jan‑Sep 2026 after a AZN 1.5 million loss in same period 2025

stories.h: Finance Ministry urges budget-funded institutions to prioritize long‑term sector development
stories.s: Ilham Karimov, head of the Results‑Based Budget Policy Department, said at a Baku conference that organisations should define results, set targets and aim for 100% digitalised expenditures.

stories.h: Financial Monitoring Service launches internal AI system for confidential data
stories.s: Fuad Aliyev, director of the Department for Cooperation and Analysis of Beneficial Owners, said the system verifies information, detects errors and alerts experts, while final decisions remain human-made.

stories.h: Consumer credit volume grew 5.4% to 8.9 billion manat in H1 2025
stories.s: The Central Bank's stability report shows a 5.4% rise, with average rates of 26% for appliance loans and 13% for auto loans, highlighting credit's role in sales of appliances, electronics and cars.

stories.h: Yelo Bankın kredit portfeli 2026-cı ilin 30 sentyabrına qədər 5,6% artaraq 1,150291 milyard manata çatıb
stories.s: Banco.az-ın məlumatına görə, 2025-ci ilin sonuna nisbətən artım 61,220 milyon manat təşkil edir. Artım istehlak kreditlərində 0,5%, biznes kreditlərində 7% və ipoteka kreditlərində 12,9% artımla əlaqədardır.
stories.he: Yelo Bank's loan portfolio grew 5.6% to AZN 1.150291 billion by 30 September 2026

stories.h: CBAR revokes T‑Kredit LLC's licence following its liquidation announcement
stories.s: The Central Bank’s Board of Directors cancelled licence BKT‑51 issued on 28.07.2026, allowing creditors to submit claims to the former address in Sabail for two months

stories.h: Baku Stock Exchange economist Emin Aliyev calls for subsidiary-company mechanism to enable Islamic finance
stories.s: At the 3rd Islamic Finance Forum, Aliyev said the mechanism would attract Gulf investments and require clear investor rights, tax rules and prospectus templates.

stories.h: Over 1,000 Azerbaijani state institutions integrated into the Chamber of Accounts system
stories.s: Zaur Valiyev, head of the performance audit department, said more than 5,000 reports have been entered and initially processed, enabling data evaluation based on risk criteria.

stories.h: Azerbaijan will integrate private companies into the state e‑document management system
stories.s: Ministry of Finance head Nurlan Soltanov said the move aims to speed up procedures and give faster information access, extending electronic contracts and invoices to businesses from next year.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's Financial Monitoring Service reports 3,376 entities registered in the STMS
stories.s: Director Fuad Aliyev said the system, integrated with 15 state databases, receives about 1,000 data parameters daily and processes roughly 25,000 entries each month.

stories.h: PAŞA Həyat Sığorta ASC (9 ay, 2026): xalis mənfəət 41 milyon 147 min manat (+989 min manat və ya 2.5%); gəlirlər 651.15 milyon manat (+123.30 milyon manat)
stories.he: PAŞA Həyat Sığorta posts 41.147 million manat net profit in first nine months of 2026

stories.h: AccessBank launches cash loans up to 50,000 AZN with rates from 9.5%
stories.s: The loan term ranges from 6 to 48 months, commission 0–3%, and the minimum effective annual rate is 15%; applications can be made online via the bank’s calculator.

stories.h: Azerbaijan approves three-year digital development acceleration plan covering AI, innovation and cybersecurity
stories.s: Deputy Chairman Shahin Aliyev of IDDA said the plan aims to integrate government systems and later extend integration to the private sector, with IT firms developing AI solutions for full digitization of internal processes.

stories.h: CBA ödəniş sistemləri üçün 24/7 onlayn monitorinqi tələb edib
stories.s: Ödəniş Sistemləri və Məhsul İnkişafı İdarəsinin direktoru Afgan Abbasov bildirib ki, yeni tələb nağdsız ödənişlərin artması fonunda informasiya təhlükəsizliyini gücləndirməyə və riskləri vaxtında aşkar etməyə yönəlmişdir.
stories.he: CBA mandates 24/7 online monitoring for payment systems

stories.h: CBA Executive Director Shahin Mahmudzada says Islamic finance will be integrated into banks' risk‑management systems
stories.s: He announced that after recent legislative amendments, the next step is to embed Islamic financing models into risk frameworks, expecting a strong rise in related loans and deposits over five years and noting sandbox tests by two banks.

stories.h: CBAR director Afqan Abbasov says payment system participants must conduct 24/7 online risk monitoring
stories.s: Speaking at the Digital Finance Ecosystem event, Abbasov highlighted the shift from offline to continuous online monitoring and urged participants to meet the minimum requirements set in the new guideline.

stories.h: CBAR İslam maliyyəsi üçün Vergilər Məcəlləsinə və müştəri vədlərinin sığortalanması haqqında qanuna dəyişikliklər təklif edir
stories.s: İnkişaf İdarəsinin rəhbəri Nargiz Şirəliyeva bildirib ki, dəyişikliklərin məqsədi İslam depozitləri üzrə ikiqat vergiləndirməni aradan qaldırmaq və sığorta əhatəsini İslam depozitlərinə genişləndirməkdir; qəbuldan sonra əlavə prudensial dəyişikliklərin planlaşdırılması nəzərdə tutulur.
stories.he: CBAR proposes amendments to tax code and deposit‑insurance law for Islamic finance

stories.h: Ministry of Finance says some electronic contracts are now signed within 10 hours
stories.s: Nurlan Soltanov, head of Modern Technologies at the ministry, announced the rollout of the Digital State Finance system that speeds up contract signing and integrates other ministries' IT systems.

stories.h: Finance Minister Sahil Babayev says the Ministry prioritises transparency in state finances
stories.s: Speaking at the Digital Finance Ecosystem conference in Baku, Babayev outlined reforms, training and a new Treasury guide aimed at standardising procedures across government bodies.

stories.h: Vice Chairman Servet Bayındır stresses need for strong Islamic finance legislation in Turkey and Azerbaijan
stories.s: Speaking at the 3rd Islamic Finance Forum in Baku, Bayındır said existing global finance tools have reached limits and called for new compatible instruments and standards, citing AAOIFI and Turkey's Participation Banks Association.

stories.h: Azerbaijan signs over 3 billion manats in e‑procurement contracts
stories.s: Finance Minister Sahil Babayev said about 7,500 contracts were signed electronically since the e‑contract system launched in April 2026, boosting speed and transparency.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's Ministry of Finance aims to finish digitalisation within 1–2 years
stories.s: Nurlan Soltanov, head of the modern technologies and innovations department, said the plan was outlined at a Baku conference and involves data exchange with 20 state bodies.

stories.h: Finance Minister Sahil Babayev says treasury payments will be cut to two hours by next year
stories.s: He noted that payments now average up to 10 hours and that a new treasury module and digital accounting system have been fully deployed to support the change.

stories.h: Azerbaijan to launch pre‑filled tax declaration system for micro‑entrepreneurs
stories.s: State Tax Service head Samir Khaligov announced the system at the "Digital Finance Ecosystem" conference, saying it will auto‑populate forms using existing data and later allow mobile submission.

stories.h: A-Qroup Sığorta (III rüb, 2026): xalis mənfəət 1,27 milyon manat; aktivlər 25,58 milyon manat
stories.he: A-Qroup Sığorta reports Q3 2026 net profit of 1.27 million manat

stories.h: PAŞA Sığorta reports 21.9 million manat net profit for the first three quarters of 2026
stories.s: Revenue rose to 294.7 million manat, up 42.4 million year‑on‑year, while total assets grew to 539.9 million manat and capital increased to 106 million manat.

stories.h: Barclays announces £500 million share buyback as BOE rate outlook clouds over energy uncertainty
stories.s: Barclays disclosed a £500 million share repurchase plan while analysts note the Bank of England's interest‑rate path beyond November is uncertain due to volatile energy markets.

stories.h: AzSığorta ASC (9 ay, 2026): xalis mənfəət 458 min 247 manat (−787 min 459 manat); aktivlər 29,8 milyon manat (−984,6 min manat)
stories.he: Azsığorta reports 458 k₼ net profit for Jan‑Sep 2026, down 787 k₼ from same period 2025

stories.h: ABA executive director Yunus Abdulov calls for Islamic finance mechanisms inside banks
stories.s: At the 3rd Islamic Finance Forum in Baku he urged banks to set up separate accounting, fund segregation and Sharia audits, and cited 3 million people reached by financial‑literacy programmes this year.

stories.h: Finance Minister Sahil Babayev says over 3 billion manat of state contracts have been digitised
stories.s: The new electronic contract system, active since April, has formalised 7 500 contracts and enabled bank guarantees to be processed online, cutting processing time from 5–10 days to one day.

stories.h: IMF cuts Azerbaijan's 2026 growth forecast to 1.7% and 2027 to 2.3%
stories.s: The International Monetary Fund lowered its projections by 0.5 percentage points for 2026 and 0.2 points for 2027, citing oil production limits and reduced fiscal stimulus, while expecting inflation to stay stable.

stories.h: Atəşgah Sığorta Şirkət ASC (9 ay, 2026): xalis mənfəət 1 milyon 89,4 min manat; aktivlər 80,7 milyon manat (+14,8 milyon manat (22,5%)); kapital 18,2 milyon manat (+0,9 milyon manat (5%))
stories.he: Atəşgah Insurance posts AZN 1.0894 million net profit for Q3 2026

stories.h: CBAR AÖS-də ani ödənişlərin emal müddətini qısaltmağı hədəfləyir
stories.s: Konfransda Ödəniş Sistemləri və Məhsulların İnkişafı Şöbəsinin rəhbəri Afqan Abbasov bankın tranzaksiya gecikmələrinə nəzarət edərək onları saniyələrə və ya millisaniyələrə qədər azaldacağını, xəta dərəcələrini isə aşağı salacağını bildirib. Gündəlik tranzaksiyaların həcmi 1 milyon səviyyəsində qalarkən, aylıq həcm 2 milyard manatı aşır.
stories.he: CBAR aims to cut processing time of instant payments in the AÖS

stories.h: Finance Minister Sahil Babayev says over 40 state firms will pay about 900 million manats in dividends to the 2027 budget
stories.s: He noted the new reporting portal, now fully operational, gathered reports from 1,113 enterprises, enabling dividend forecasts for 885 firms and confirming budget reports for 950 companies for 2026.

stories.h: Azerbaijan tax authority pilots electronic monitoring system allowing voluntary correction of violations
stories.s: The system sends electronic notices of detected breaches, gives taxpayers a set period to fix them before penalties, and aims to boost preventive compliance, said Samir Xalıqov, acting head of the Tax Risk Management Department

stories.h: Azerbaijan's State Tax Service to use AI for proactive tax risk detection
stories.s: Deputy Head of Tax Risk Management Samir Khaligov said the AI tools will assess taxpayer risk levels and send automatic alerts, with a pilot electronic monitoring system already operating in one region.

stories.h: State Tax Service to allow mobile filing of tax returns in Azerbaijan
stories.s: Deputy head of the Tax Risk Management Department Samir Xalıqov said the app will help micro‑entrepreneurs and enable pre‑filled returns, reducing administrative burden.

stories.h: Birbank app adds SİMA İmza for faster transfer confirmation
stories.s: The new option lets Birbank customers confirm payments with SİMA İmza, eliminating the need for a one‑time SMS code, while other users continue using the existing 3D security code method.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's Ministry of Finance to unify procurement, accounting and treasury codes in a single digital system
stories.s: Ministerial official Nurlan Soltanov announced at the "Digital Finance Ecosystem" conference that the integration will link customs, procurement and accounting classifications to streamline public‑finance processes and improve efficiency.

stories.h: Finance Minister Sahil Babayev announces rapid, comprehensive digitalisation steps for public services and finances
stories.s: He said the president approved a state programme and action plan and a council led by First Vice‑President Mehriban Aliyeva will coordinate digitalisation across all sectors, with electronic accounting already rolling out in over 260 agencies.

stories.h: IMF projects Azerbaijan's GDP growth at 2.5% in 2031
stories.s: The International Monetary Fund forecasts real GDP expansion of 2.5% for Azerbaijan in 2031, according to Report.az.

stories.h: IMF forecasts Azerbaijan's external position will improve faster in 2026
stories.s: The IMF says the acceleration is driven by higher oil revenues and continued fiscal consolidation, and expects similar trends for Kazakhstan.

stories.h: Finance Minister Sahil Babayev says 60% of Azerbaijan's state budget will be forecast digitally within three years
stories.s: At a conference on the Digital Financial Ecosystem, Babayev announced the rollout of a Digital Public Finance Information System and training for over 260 agencies, aiming to register more than 2 million inventory units electronically by year‑end.

stories.h: Xalq Həyat Sığorta ASC (III rüb, 2026): xalis mənfəət 2,15 milyon manat; aktivlər 31,09 milyon manat (+619,3 min manat)
stories.he: Xalq Həyat Insurance posted Q3 net profit of 2.15 million manat, up 10.4% YoY

stories.h: AzRe Təkrarsığorta reports Q1‑Q3 2026 net profit rise to 25.8 million manat
stories.s: Revenue reached 95.8 million manat, up 28.6 million from 2025, while net profit grew from 17 million to 25.8 million manat, with assets at 238.8 million manat as of 30 Sept.

stories.h: Unibank manat müddətli depozit dərəcələrini endirir: 6 aylıq dərəcə 8%-ə, 12 aylıq 9%-ə düşür
stories.s: Sistemik əhəmiyyətli bank illik dərəcələri 0.5 faiz punktuna endirərək USD/EUR dərəcələrini dəyişməz saxladı və maksimum manat müddətli depozit gəlirini 10.5%-dən 10%-ə endirdi.
stories.he: Unibank cuts manat term deposit rates, 6‑month rate to 8% and 12‑month to 9%

stories.h: Qala Sığorta (9 ay, 2026): xalis mənfəət 5 milyon 54 min manat (−54%); aktivlər 96 milyon 980 min 204 manat (+2,1%)
stories.he: Qala Insurance's net profit for the first three quarters of 2026 fell 54% to 5.054 million manat

stories.h: CBA İslam maliyyəsi üzrə beş əsas məhsulu əhatə edən qanunvericilik paketini təqdim etdi
stories.s: İcraçı direktor Şahin Mahmudzada bildirib ki, üç aktiv əsaslı və iki passiv əsaslı alətdən ibarət olan paket hökumətə təsdiq üçün təqdim edilib.
stories.he: CBA unveils Islamic finance legislative package with five core products

stories.h: Ministry of Finance hosts conference on digital finance ecosystem in Baku
stories.s: The event, co‑organized with the Public Council and APFM, covered digitalisation of state finance, AI use, tax digital transformation and payment system development.

stories.h: Meqa Sığorta (9 ay, 2026): aktivlər 60 milyon 390 min 674 manat (+3 milyon 258 min 277 manat)
stories.he: Meqa Sığorta's Q3 net profit falls 7.5% to 2.78 million manat

stories.h: Azerbaijan‑Kyrgyzstan Development Fund doubles its charter capital
stories.s: The fund's charter capital has been increased two‑fold, according to Report.az, marking a major capital boost for the bilateral development vehicle.

stories.h: OFAC issues General License HH for Iranian transactions
stories.s: The Office of Foreign Assets Control published General License HH under the Iranian Transactions and Sanctions Regulations, allowing specified activities previously prohibited.

stories.h: Black Sea Bank disbursed €711.9 million in Azerbaijan
stories.s: The bank’s total disbursements in the country reached €711.9 million, according to Trend News Agency, highlighting its active lending role.

stories.h: OFAC issues General License No.1 under Russian Harmful Foreign Activities Sanctions Regulations
stories.s: Published on 2026-10-21, the license authorises certain transactions that were previously prohibited under the sanctions regime.

stories.h: U.S. Treasury launches Operation Economic Outcast targeting Iran's shadow fleet networks
stories.s: The Treasury announced the new sanctions operation aimed at disrupting Iran's illicit maritime activities, citing concerns over funding of prohibited programs.

stories.h: FDIC Chair Travis Hill says AI agents could shift deposit landscape
stories.s: Hill highlighted concerns about customers delegating deposit decisions to AI agents and noted current guidance doesn’t cover generative or agentic AI, while banks like JPMorgan block such agents.

stories.h: JPMorgan Chase plans to cease operations of its Turkey securities unit
stories.s: The bank announced the closure of its securities activities in Turkey, citing strategic reasons, with the unit expected to wind down operations in the coming months.

stories.h: SOCAR Türkiyə 22 beynəlxalq bankdan 1,6 milyard dollarlıq beşillik refinanslaşdırma əldə edib
stories.s: First Abu Dhabi Bank və Mizuho Bankın rəhbərliyi ilə aparılan sövdələşmə SOFR + 230 bps faiz dərəcəsi təklif edir və mövcud borcları daha əlverişli şərtlərlə əvəz etməklə qrupun likvidliyini artırmağı hədəfləyir.
stories.he: SOCAR Turkey secures $1.6 billion five‑year refinancing from 22 international banks

stories.h: PASHA Bank will finance the launch of Azerbaijan's largest regional energy storage project
stories.s: The bank announced the funding plan for the new storage facility, marking a major investment in the country's energy infrastructure.

stories.h: Azerbaijan banks ranked by loan portfolio in Q3 2026
stories.s: Trend News Agency published the ranking, showing which banks hold the largest loan books for the third quarter of 2026.

stories.h: PAŞA Kapital signs MoU with the State Innovation Center to boost financial literacy and investment culture
stories.s: The agreement was signed by PAŞA Kapital CEO İsi Mustafayev and Innovation Center director Vüsal Rüstəmov, outlining joint training, seminars and mentorship programs for the public.

stories.h: QTIB finances over €450 million of projects in Azerbaijan
stories.s: QTIB announced it has provided financing for projects in Azerbaijan totaling more than €450 million, according to PLAT.AZ.

stories.h: CBAR conducts media briefing on insurance sector's role in financial stability
stories.s: The session covered regulatory reforms, digitalisation, AI use, climate risk and answered journalists' questions, aiming to boost sector knowledge.

stories.h: IFC plans to explore new investment projects in Azerbaijan’s water, energy and transport sectors
stories.s: In an interview, an IFC senior official said the institution is assessing opportunities and aims to mobilize financing to support infrastructure development, pending further feasibility studies.

stories.h: SOFAZ will transfer $8.52 billion to Azerbaijan's state budget for 2025
stories.s: The State Oil Fund of Azerbaijan announced the planned transfer, reflecting its contribution to fiscal financing for the upcoming year.

stories.h: Azerenerji and World Bank review progress of the AZURE renewable energy project
stories.s: Chairman Baba Rzayev met World Bank Country Manager Sacha Backes to assess completed work, results and upcoming activities, and to discuss grid integration and future cooperation

stories.h: Kapital Bank (9 ay, 2026): xalis mənfəət 297 mln. manat (+29,6%); aktivlər 13,92 mlrd. manat (+15,4%); depozitlər 10,31 mlrd. manat (+18,9%)
stories.he: Kapital Bank's loan portfolio reaches 6.39 bn AZN, net profit rises 29.6% to 297 mn AZN in nine months 2026

stories.h: Azerbaijan and Portugal agree to strengthen cooperation in the banking sector
stories.s: The two countries announced a joint initiative to enhance collaboration between their financial institutions, though specific projects and timelines were not disclosed.

stories.h: AzerGold CJSC establishes its first overseas subsidiary, AzerGold Uzbekistan, to develop the Akba gold deposit
stories.s: The new LLC, registered in Uzbekistan, will conduct geological exploration of the Akba deposit in Kashkadarya, with licences pending and a 18‑month work plan, following a framework agreement signed on 17 June 2026.

stories.h: Central Bank of Azerbaijan delegation visits Bank of Portugal to discuss financial stability mechanisms
stories.s: The CBA team exchanged views on Portugal's early‑intervention and resolution tools while presenting Azerbaijan's legal framework and stability network roles

stories.h: U.S. OCC releases final rule implementing the GENIUS Act for payment stablecoins
stories.s: The rule, effective Jan. 18, bans direct yield payments to stablecoin holders but allows case‑by‑case review of third‑party reward arrangements, and will be complemented by a separate AML/ sanctions rule.
stories.l: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency

stories.h: CBAR’s 25 million manat 28‑day discount note auction attracted 91.2 million manat of orders
stories.s: The auction held on the Baku Stock Exchange saw nine investors place a total nominal demand of 91,200,000 manat, with the notes fully allocated at an average price of 99,506.6079 manat (6.38%).

stories.h: İpək Yolu Sığorta ASC (9 ay, 2026): xalis mənfəət 742 929 manat (+53% (256 845 manat))
stories.he: İpək Yolu Sığorta reports AZN 742,929 net profit for Q3 2026, up 53% YoY

stories.h: Bank VTB (Azerbaijan) offers retirees up to 100,000 AZN unsecured cash loans
stories.s: The loan carries interest starting at 9.9% annually for up to 59 months and can be up to 26 times the pension income, with no guarantor required.

stories.h: Intesa Sanpaolo plans risk‑transfer deals to hedge over €5 billion in assets
stories.s: The Italian bank aims to shift more than €5 billion ($6 billion) of credit risk, showing continued appetite for higher‑risk instruments despite market concerns about debt and geopolitics.

stories.h: India's RBI rejects all bids in treasury bill auction amid bond selloff
stories.s: The Reserve Bank of India turned down every bid on Wednesday's federal treasury bill sale as a sharp bond market selloff drove borrowing costs to multi-year highs, according to Bloomberg.

stories.h: Kapital Bank establishes a new company
stories.s: The state-owned, systemically important Kapital Bank announced the creation of a new legal entity, according to a Fed.az report published on 20 Oct 2026.

stories.h: Ziraat Bank Azerbaijan launches micro‑credit campaign up to AZN 250,000
stories.s: The programme, running until 20 December 2026, offers 0% commission, up to AZN 50,000 unsecured financing and interest rates starting at 14% per annum for terms up to 59 months.

stories.h: EIB is studying investment in Azerbaijan's Nakhchivan railway and other connectivity projects
stories.s: Head of EIB South Caucasus representation Stella Renita said the bank is evaluating the railway, Black Sea digital link and Caspian‑Black Sea green energy corridor at the EU‑Azerbaijan Business Forum in Baku.

stories.h: Azərbaycan Beynəlxalq Bankının müştəri depozitləri portfeli 11 milyard manata yaxınlaşır, illik artım 20,4%
stories.s: Portfel 2026-cı ilin 30 sentyabr tarixinə 10 milyard 704 milyon 492 min manat həcmində olub. Bu, 2025-ci ilin sonuna nisbətən 1 milyard 811 milyon 611 min manat artım deməkdir. Artımın əsasını fərdi müştərilərdən 4 milyard 145 milyon 81 min manat və hüquqi şəxslərdən 6 milyard 559 milyon 411 min manat təşkil edir.
stories.he: Azerbaijan International Bank's deposit portfolio nears 11 billion manat, up 20.4% YoY

stories.h: EBRD plans to increase maritime transport investments in Azerbaijan
stories.s: Nataly Mouravidze, head of the EBRD office in Azerbaijan, said at the EU‑Azerbaijan Business Forum that the bank will expand financing for dry‑cargo vessels and related corridor projects as milestones are met.

stories.h: CBAR to expand electronic data‑base access for property insurance underwriting
stories.s: Ramin Jafarov, head of the CBAR Insurance Intermediaries Supervision Department, said the move aims to develop voluntary insurance products and improve compulsory insurance coverage by allowing insurers to retrieve property records electronically.

stories.h: ABB attracted the largest public deposits in Q3 2026 with AZN 4.1 billion
stories.s: Banco.az’s research by Gülnar Əhmədli shows the Azerbaijani public placed AZN 4.1 billion in deposits at Azərbaycan Beynəlxalq Bankı, the highest among local banks in the third quarter.

stories.h: ECB's Piero Cipollone discusses Pontes and Appia projects to unlock opportunities for banks
stories.s: In a speech, Cipollone highlighted how the Pontes and Appia initiatives could create new financing avenues for banks, emphasizing potential benefits for the sector.

stories.h: Azərbaycanın yeni yük daşınması qanunu məcburi sığorta müddəalarını nəzərə almır
stories.s: AB Biznes İqlimi Hesabatının tərtib qrupunun rəhbəri Aytan Akhundova daşıyıcıların indi tam ziyan riskini öz üzərinə götürməli olduğunu diqqətə çatdıraraq, qanunun sığorta tələbini əks etdirməsi və beynəlxalq konvensiyalarla uyğunlaşdırılması üçün təkmilləşdirilməsini təklif edib.
stories.he: Azerbaijan's new freight forwarding law omits mandatory insurance provisions

stories.h: Mərkəzi Bank yeni sığorta sinifləri, elektron məcburi avtomobil sığortası və risk əsaslı qiymətləndirmə islahatlarını elan edib
stories.s: Mərkəzi Bankın Sığorta Vasitəçiliyi Nəzarəti İdarəsinin rəhbəri Ramin Cəfərov islahatların ixtiyari sığorta üçün birləşdirilmiş qaydaları, borc alanlar üçün həyat sığortası məhsullarını, məcburi avtomobil sığortasının tam elektron emalını və əmlak sığortasında risk əsaslı premiuma keçidi əhatə etdiyini bildirib.
stories.he: CBAR announces new insurance classes, electronic compulsory auto insurance and risk‑based pricing reforms

stories.h: Azerbaijan International Bank wins The Digital Banker’s Best AI-Powered Retail Bank award
stories.s: The award recognises ABB’s AI-driven solutions, including personal finance managers AI‑nur and AI‑khan, as judged by an international panel of experts from KPMG, Bain & Company and Accenture.

stories.h: CBA outlines plan to boost financial stability of insurance firms in 2027‑2030 strategy
stories.s: Ramin Jafarov, head of the insurance intermediaries supervision department, said the strategy will strengthen market infrastructure, expand online sales, and enhance prudential regulation and risk management.

stories.h: Expressbank (9 ay, 2026): xalis mənfəət 9 milyon 942 min manat (+3 milyon 920 min manat və ya 65%); aktivlər 725 milyon 447 min manat (+58 milyon 707 min manat və ya 8,8%); kredit portfeli 592 milyon 364 min manat (+42 milyon 651 min manat və ya 7,7%)
stories.he: Expressbank posted a net profit of 9.942 million manat for Jan‑Sep 2026, up 65% YoY

stories.h: Bank Indonesia holds its benchmark rate and cuts reserve requirements
stories.s: The central bank kept the policy rate unchanged while lowering banks' reserve requirement ratios to support the rupiah amid volatility from MSCI's downgrade threat, Bloomberg reports.

stories.h: UK inflation hits 11‑month high, raising pressure on the Bank of England to raise rates
stories.s: The latest data shows consumer prices rising faster than expected, prompting analysts to anticipate a possible rate hike at the BoE's next meeting.

stories.h: A‑Qroup Insurance launches “FORS‑MAJOR EX” corporate medical insurance covering up to 8,000 AZN per employee
stories.s: The voluntary program offers 24/7 emergency care, surgeries, hospitalisation, dental aid, vaccinations and free preventive check‑ups, targeting over 300 local and international corporate clients.

stories.h: Kapital Bank leads consumer loan market with AZN 3.5 billion portfolio
stories.s: According to Banco.az, Kapital Bank's consumer loans total AZN 3.5 billion, ABB follows with AZN 2.2 billion, and Bank of Baku ranks third with AZN 911 million for Jan‑Sep 2026.

stories.h: AFB Bank leads Azerbaijan banks with 41.3% credit portfolio growth to 413.4 million manat in nine months 2026
stories.s: The bank’s portfolio rose from 292.5 million manat at end‑2025 to 413.4 million manat by 30 September 2026, outpacing peers such as Bank of Baku (28.7%) and VTB Bank (24.8%).

stories.h: EBRD's credit portfolio in Azerbaijan reaches €879 million as of 30 Sept 2026
stories.s: The portfolio grew by €2 million (0.23%) since end‑August, with 40% allocated to the private sector and 35 active projects in the country.

stories.h: CBAR to auction 100 million manat of notes on Oct 21‑22 at Baku Stock Exchange
stories.s: The auction will feature four issues (28, 84, 168 and 252‑day maturities) each of 25 million manat, with orders collected from 11:00 to 11:30 and only local banks eligible to bid.

stories.h: BSTDB signs financing agreements in Azerbaijan exceeding €450 million
stories.s: The Black Sea Trade and Development Bank announced that its new financing deals with Azerbaijani entities total over €450 million, as reported on 2026-10-21.

stories.h: EBRD's Azerbaijan loan portfolio rises to €879 million, up €2 million
stories.s: The increase of 0.23% brings the portfolio to 35 active projects, with 89% funding sustainable infrastructure, 7% to financial institutions and 3% to corporates.

stories.h: EBRD loan portfolio in Azerbaijan approaches €880 million
stories.s: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development reports its outstanding loan portfolio in Azerbaijan has grown to nearly €880 million, indicating continued financing activity in the country.

stories.h: BSTDB finances 47 Azerbaijani projects worth €450.946 million, actual funding €711.819 million
stories.s: The Black Sea Trade and Development Bank signed agreements for 47 projects and its board approved €453.802 million in projects, with the financial sector receiving 50.28% (€169.670 million) and credit lines to Bank Respublika, Unibank and Azer‑Turk Bank included.

stories.h: FSB Secretary General outlines AI and stablecoin risks in speech to G20 audience
stories.s: He highlighted AI‑driven cyber and operational risks for banks and non‑banks, and warned that cross‑border stablecoins pose supervision challenges, urging coordinated international action.

stories.h: Azərbaycanın Maliyyə Nazirliyi oktyabrın 20-dəki auksionda 200 milyon manatlıq obligasiyadan yalnız 53 milyon manatlıqını yerləşdirə bildi
stories.s: 200 milyon manatlıq 3 illik obligasiya 223 milyon manatlıq tələb cəlb etsə də, yalnız 53 milyon manatlıq yerləşdirildi. Bu, bu ay zəif maraqla keçən auksionlar seriyasına davam edir.
stories.he: Azerbaijan's Ministry of Finance sells only 53 million of 200 million manat bonds in Oct 20 auction

stories.h: ABB Bank launched with 1 million manat capital
stories.s: The new Azerbaijani International Bank was established with an initial capital of 1 million manat, according to Fed.az.

stories.h: Bank of Israel expected to hold benchmark rate at 3.25% ahead of Oct 27 election
stories.s: All 15 economists surveyed by Reuters expect the rate to stay unchanged on Wednesday, despite prior cuts and stable inflation, as political uncertainty looms.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's Minister Rashad Nabiyev discusses AI data centre cooperation with US DFC
stories.s: Nabiyev and DFC Chief Policy Officer Caroline Vick exchanged views on AI data centres, digital infrastructure, transport, logistics and financing joint projects, including the Middle Corridor.

stories.h: Azerbaijan State Oil Fund reports over 6.5 billion manat revenue in Jan‑Sep 2026
stories.s: The revenue comes from oil sales from the ACG block and is tracked for its impact on state finances, foreign reserves and economic stability, according to the fund’s report.

stories.h: Azerbaijan International Bank registers new asset‑management subsidiary with 1 000 000 manat charter capital
stories.s: The subsidiary, ABB‑Asset Management MMC, was registered at 67 Nizami St., Baku, with legal representative Hasan Etibar oglu Eminov, also director of ABB Innovation MMC, following a shareholders' decision on 7 May.

stories.h: Azerbaijan tax authority to use AI for cash‑receipt risk detection
stories.s: Deputy head of the State Tax Service Samira Musayeva announced at a "Sustainable Business" event that AI will analyse cash‑register data to flag sector‑related and abnormal transactions for immediate tax review.

stories.h: CFI Asset Management MMC reduces its charter capital by 1,500 manat to 150,000 manat
stories.s: The reduction, announced by CFI Financial Investment Company QSC, allows creditors to submit claims within one month to the firm's address in Baku, Nəsimi district, Neftçilər prospect 64.

stories.h: Maliyyə Nazirliyi’s 1080‑day state bond auction placed 53,040,200 manat at an average price of 99.3577 manat, yielding 7.2420%
stories.s: The 200 million manat issue attracted 222,899,300 manat of orders from 11 investors, with 26.5% of the issue allocated; the cut‑off price was 99.3366 manat (7.25% yield).

stories.h: Two candidates passed the CBAR insurance intermediary attestation with full scores
stories.s: Balayev Nəriman Natiq oğlu scored 70 points and Əlizadə Mirməhəmməd Asif oğlu scored 64 points in the October 12, 2026 exam, meeting the 70‑question requirement under Rule 4.6

stories.h: Assist Finance issues 800,000 manat discount unsecured bond auction on BFB
stories.s: The 8,000 bonds with 100 manat nominal each will be auctioned on 23 Oct 2026 with a minimum price of 90 manat and a 182‑day term.

stories.h: State Oil Fund raises AAA-rated assets to 26.7% of its bond portfolio
stories.s: The fund disclosed that AAA instruments now make up 26.7% of its bonds and money‑market holdings, up from 24.9% on 1 Oct 2025, while AA share fell to 36.3% as of 30 Sep 2026.

stories.h: FINCA Azerbaijan placed a 2 million manat bond with 50 investors on Baku Stock Exchange
stories.s: The micro‑finance organisation issued 20,000 unsecured 15% interest bonds maturing in 18 months, each at a nominal 100 manat, with all orders fully subscribed at the auction on 20 Oct 2026.

stories.h: Banco.az publishes Q3 2026 ranking of Azerbaijani banks by charter capital
stories.s: The report, compiled by Gülnar Əhmədli, lists banks ordered by their charter‑capital size for the third quarter of 2026.

stories.h: m10 digital wallet launches unified view of bank and card accounts in Azerbaijan
stories.s: The app lets users link accounts from different banks in a minute, view balances and transaction history in one place, with data shared only with consent under CBAR open‑banking rules.

stories.h: POS-terminal commissions in Azerbaijan range 1.3‑1.8% and burden small merchants
stories.s: Deputy Vüqar Bayramov said the fees exceed the 2% simplified tax for micro‑entrepreneurs and urged lower rates to boost cashless payments, noting only 184.4 k terminals for 883 k active taxpayers.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's Ministry of Finance to host conference on digital transformation of public finances on Oct 22
stories.s: The event, titled "Digital Financial Ecosystem: A New Stage in Governance," will discuss unified digital governance, payment infrastructure and data security, with participation from government, private sector and civil society representatives.

stories.h: Azerbaijan allocates 210,000 manats in soft loans for solar panel installations
stories.s: Energy Minister Parviz Shahbazov said the Energy Efficiency Fund will provide the funds through agreements with 14 credit organisations, aiming to boost energy‑saving investments and make solar power more accessible.

stories.h: SOFAZ's bond share falls to 33.9% of its portfolio, down 0.8 points YoY
stories.s: Equity share rose to 27% up 1.2 points, gold fell to 32.3% and real estate rose to 6.8% as of Oct 1, 2026, according to the fund.

stories.h: FMS Deputy Chairman Azər Abbasov warns administrative fines could harm banks' international ties
stories.s: Speaking at a GRC event in Baku, Abbasov said fines can cause legal, reputational and correspondent‑banking risks, citing recent court rulings protecting victims of cyber‑loan fraud.

stories.h: Maliyyə Monitorinq Xidmətinin müavini: banklar və notariuslar cinayət əlamətlərini bildirməlidir
stories.s: Maliyyə Monitorinq Xidmətinin müavini Azər Abbasov Bakıda keçirilən GRC tədbirində bankların və notariusların AML komplayens çərçivəsində cinayət göstəricilərini müəyyən edib bildirməli olduğunu açıqlayıb.
stories.he: Financial Monitoring Service deputy says banks and notaries must report criminal signs

stories.h: SOFAZ's investment portfolio reaches $74.003 bn, European share falls to 26.3%
stories.s: The State Oil Fund of Azerbaijan reports a 5.5% YoY increase in total assets to $74.004 bn, with European holdings down 2.8 pp and AAA‑rated assets rising to 26.7% of bonds and money‑market instruments.

stories.h: Azərbaycanın Milli Məclisi kredit, lizing və faktoring alacaklarının sekuritizasiyasına imkan verən qanun dəyişikliklərini qəbul edib
stories.s: "Bankçılıq" və "Qiymətli Kağızlar Bazarı" qanunlarına edilən dəyişikliklər 16 oktyabr 2026-cı ildə birinci oxunuşda qəbul edilib. Dəyişikliklər sekuritizasiya şirkətlərinə gələcək nağd axınları ilə zəmanətli obligasiya buraxmağa imkan verir, hər bir plan üçün isə Mərkəzi Bankın (CBAR) təsdiqi tələb olunur.
stories.he: Azerbaijan parliament adopts law changes to enable securitisation of loan, leasing and factoring receivables

stories.h: Azərbaycan Dövlət Neft Fondu (ARDNF) (9 ay, 2026): xalis mənfəət 7 milyard 343,9 milyon manat; aktivlər 74 milyard 4 milyon ABŞ dolları
stories.he: Azerbaijan State Oil Fund transfers 9.6 billion manat to state budget in Jan‑Sep 2026

stories.h: Azerbaijan State Oil Fund's investment in BlackRock money‑market fund rises 19.4% to 1,120,121,000 manat
stories.s: The fund's total money‑market holdings reached 1,170,718,000 manat, 22% higher than a year earlier, with 50,597,000 manat allocated to Goldman Sachs, whose stake doubled over the year.

stories.h: Azərbaycan rezident olmayan elektron ticarət iştirakçıları üçün qeydiyyatı məcburi edir, 23-nün artıq qeydiyyatdan keçdiyini qeyd edir
stories.s: Dövlət Vergi Xidmətinin baş direktorunun müavini Çingiz Musayev parlament komitəsinə bildirib ki, Elektron Ticarət haqqında Qanuna edilən yeni dəyişiklik əvvəllər könüllü olan qeydiyyatı məcburi edəcək və həm xidmət göstərmə, həm də malların satışını əhatə edəcək.
stories.he: Azerbaijan makes registration mandatory for non‑resident e‑commerce participants, citing 23 already registered

stories.h: Azerbaijan's Central Bank highlights rising significance of non‑financial risks
stories.s: The CBAR said that non‑financial risks are becoming more material for banks and urged institutions to strengthen their risk‑management frameworks, according to Trend News Agency.

stories.h: SOFAZ reports 564.1 million manat revenue from Shah Deniz gas field in Jan‑Sept 2026
stories.s: The State Oil Fund says revenue fell 20% year‑on‑year, down 131.9 million manat from the same period in 2025, despite continued production under the extended PSA.

stories.h: Azerbaijan has only 184.4 k POS terminals for 883 k active taxpayers, about one per 60 people
stories.s: Deputy Vüqar Bayramov said 62.1% of terminals are in Baku and highlighted higher interchange fees than regional peers, urging fee cuts to boost cashless payments.

stories.h: Yelo Bank launches auto‑payment feature in its Yelo App for Android users
stories.s: The function lets customers set recurring payments by date or by outstanding debt, automatically debiting the account or card, reducing missed‑payment risk, according to the bank’s announcement.

stories.h: CBAR to share cyber‑threat indicators with banks, says Nadir Novruzov
stories.s: The State Service for Special Communication and Information Security will forward IP addresses and malware hash data to financial institutions via the central bank to help banks take preventive measures against cyber attacks.

stories.h: Deputy Vüqar Bayramov calls for lower POS‑terminal fees in Azerbaijan
stories.s: He highlighted high fees harming micro‑entrepreneurs and noted that 62% of terminals are in Baku, urging the Central Bank to act after his bill proposal is adopted.

stories.h: Azerbaijan drafts law to broaden e‑commerce scope and classify mobile phones as POS terminals
stories.s: Deputy head of the Ministry of Economy, Kamran Ahmadov, said the draft expands the law beyond domestic transactions, adds a tech‑neutrality principle and allows mobile devices to act as POS terminals.

stories.h: Azerbaijan State Oil Fund reports assets of $74.004 bn as of 1 Oct, 0.6% higher than Jan 1
stories.s: For the Jan‑Sep period the fund recorded budget revenues of 12.3413 bn manat, expenses of 9.6812 bn manat and a profit of 7.3439 bn manat from oil‑gas sales, and transferred 9.628 bn manat to the state budget.

stories.h: Birbank launches cash loan up to AZN 80,000 with interest starting at 10.9%
stories.s: The loan can be repaid over up to 59 months, with a maximum effective annual rate of 43.84% and no collateral required in most cases, according to the bank.

stories.h: Norm ASC plans new large investment project in Karabakh, adds dry-mix and ready‑beton production
stories.s: Marketing head Ramil Mahmudov told Fins.az that the cement maker has opened a new concrete plant in Karabakh and will launch further large‑scale projects, expanding into dry‑mix and ready‑beton under the Storm brand.

stories.h: Mortgage and Credit Guarantee Fund to auction 50 million manat bonds on BFB
stories.s: The auction on 21 Oct 2026 will collect orders from 11:00 to 12:30, with a 3.0% coupon, 1,000 manat nominal, and a 7,560‑day maturity, underwriter Invest‑Az QSC.

stories.h: III Islamic Finance Forum to be held in Baku on Oct 22
stories.s: The forum, organized by the Center for Economic Resources Studies, will discuss Islamic finance development, banking, insurance, sukuk, leasing and micro‑finance products, and training and certification of staff.

stories.h: CBAR Governor Taleh Kazımov leads delegation to World Bank and IMF annual meetings in Bangkok
stories.s: The four‑day trip included a speech at the Election Group session, meetings with central bank heads and a reception with Thailand's Prime Minister, plus bilateral talks with global finance officials.

stories.h: Parliament proposes expanding the scope of Azerbaijan's Electronic Commerce Law
stories.s: The draft amendment, discussed by the Economic Policy, Industry and Entrepreneurship Committee, would require sellers to disclose cash‑less payment details to buyers and authorities, introduce technological neutrality and remove the restriction to domestic e‑commerce.

stories.h: ABB and Kapital Bank liabilities rise by 4.8 billion manat in Jan‑Sept 2026
