stories.s: ABB’s liabilities grew 2.3727 billion manat (20.8%) to 13.795 billion, while Kapital Bank’s rose 2.4325 billion manat (24%) to 12.575 billion, according to Fed.az.

stories.h: Pasha Bank signs project financing agreement with Yeo Teknoloji for Azerbaijan energy storage project
stories.s: The agreement, announced by Yeo Teknoloji, will provide financing for an energy storage initiative in Azerbaijan, with Pasha Bank acting as the lead lender.

stories.h: Azərbaycan Mərkəzi Bankı kommersiya bankları üçün korporativ idarəetmə tələblərini yeniləyəcək
stories.s: Müavini Toğrul Əliyev davamlılıq forumunda bəyan etdi ki, AMB daxili müzakirələri yekunlaşdırır və tezliklə layihə çərçivəsini bank sektoruna rəy üçün təqdim edəcək.
stories.he: Azerbaijan Central Bank to update corporate governance requirements for commercial banks

stories.h: AFB Bank leads 2026 liability growth with a 43.5% increase to 495.3 million manat
stories.s: Bank of Baku ranked second with a 40.5% rise to 1.3727 billion manat, while Yapı Kredi Azerbaijan posted a 30.4% increase to 872.5 million manat, according to the September 30 ranking.

stories.h: Azerbaijan updates rules for the Electronic Credit and Guarantee system
stories.s: The Ministry of Economy approved a revised charter on 15 Oct 2026, expanding data fields and linking the system to the Azerbaijan Business Development Fund, tax authorities and the State Property Fund, with free access for banks and credit organisations.

stories.h: Bank of Baku selects Netmera platform for personalized customer engagement
stories.s: The bank will use Netmera's data collection, analytics and real‑time journey automation to track mobile app behavior and launch targeted push and in‑app campaigns, said Digital Banking Director Nicat Musayev.

stories.h: CBAR onlayn istehlak kreditləri üçün 2 saatlıq və ya 24 saatlıq köçürmə müddətləri müəyyən edib
stories.s: 2026-cı ilin 1 oktyabrından etibarən minimum əmək haqqının ikiqatından çox olmayan kreditlər 2 saat ərzində, daha böyük məbləğlər isə 24 saat ərzində hesabına köçürülməlidir. Kredit alanlar Azərbaycan Kredit Bürosu vasitəsilə uzaqdan kredit müqavilələrini məhdudlaşdıra bilər.
stories.he: CBAR sets 2‑hour or 24‑hour disbursement windows for online consumer loans

stories.h: Azerbaijan State Oil Fund's sovereign bond holdings fell to 21.700041 billion manat in Jan 2026
stories.s: Investments in US Treasuries dropped 33.6% YoY to 4.846758 billion manat, while corporate bond holdings rose 40.4% to 4.025554 billion manat, the fund reported.

stories.h: Fitch Ratings CEO says Azerbaijan's financial resources underpin manat stability
stories.s: In an interview, Fitch Ratings CEO highlighted that the country's fiscal strength helps keep the manat exchange rate stable, without announcing new policies.

stories.h: SOFAZ's real estate fund holdings rose to 4.894 billion manats, up 7.2% YoY
stories.s: The State Oil Fund of Azerbaijan reported that its real estate fund investments increased by 7.2% from the start of 2025, while the share of such assets fell to 3.9% of total holdings.

stories.h: SOFAZ's gold bullion share rose to 37.9% of assets, up from 20.5%
stories.s: The State Oil Fund reported holdings of 47.707 billion manats in gold, a 2.3‑fold increase since Jan 1 2025, raising gold's weight in the portfolio to 37.9% as of Jan 1 2026.

stories.h: OFAC issues new PAIPA designations and associated general licenses
stories.s: The U.S. Office of Foreign Assets Control released updated designations under the Protecting American Intellectual Property Act of 2022 and published related general licenses, expanding the sanctions list.

stories.h: Dövlət Neft Fondu obligasiya saxlanışını 17,1% azaldaraq 35.281 milyard manata endirdi
stories.s: Dövlət Neft Fondu 2026-cı il maliyyə hesabatlarına görə, obligasiya portfelini aktivlərin 28,1%-inə endirib (əvvəlki 41,5%-dən), səhm saxlanışı isə 23,1% artaraq 27.955 milyard manata çatıb.
stories.he: SOFAZ cuts bond holdings by 17.1% to 35.281 billion manats

stories.h: Uzbekistan and the United States sign 54 agreements worth $12 billion
stories.s: The deals cover industry, transport, energy, critical minerals, the financial sector and digital technologies, with partners like Citigroup, BlackRock and GE Aerospace involved.

stories.h: BMO economist says recent inflation data likely won’t shift Fed policy
stories.s: Jennifer Lee of BMO Capital Markets notes that while inflation appears high, its breadth has narrowed and expects PCE inflation later this month to show a similar trend, keeping the Fed on the sidelines.

stories.h: Turkey's capital markets regulator chief Mahmut Sutcu resigns amid fund turmoil
stories.s: Sutcu stepped down citing health issues while Deputy Treasury Minister Osman Celik also tendered resignation, as SPK had suspended trading in 131 funds affecting half a million investors and BIST 100 fell 2.49%.

stories.h: Bluestone Investment Bank meets Uzbek officials to discuss capital market development
stories.s: The meeting aims to explore ways to deepen Uzbekistan's capital markets, though no specific projects or amounts were disclosed.

stories.h: SOFAZ raises short-term deposit with Japan's Mizuho Bank to 14.857 million manats, a 7.15‑fold increase
stories.s: The State Oil Fund of Azerbaijan reports the deposit grew from the previous year to 14.857 million manats, while its total term deposits reached 13.731 million manats, up 17.5% from Jan 1 2025.

stories.h: Turkish insurers set aside TL 2 billion ($40.4 million) for flood claims after record rainfall
stories.s: The Insurance Association of Türkiye estimates insurers will owe over TL 1.9 billion across 2,379 damage files, with TL 1.56 billion reserved for fire insurance and TL 345.75 million for motor insurance.

stories.h: Turkey plans interim payouts to investors in 66 settled troubled funds covering 45,000 people and TL 40.8 billion
stories.s: The Economic Coordination Board, chaired by Vice President Cevdet Yılmaz, said payments will start after Parliament passes a liquidation bill, with the remaining funds from Tera, Pusula, Hedef and Atlas still pending.

stories.h: State Computing Council (Hesablama Palatası) appoints a new auditor
stories.s: The appointment was announced by the council on 2026-10-18, replacing the previous auditor, to oversee its financial reporting.

stories.h: World Bank begins review of Azerbaijan's planned development projects
stories.s: The World Bank announced it will assess the feasibility and compliance of several upcoming projects in Azerbaijan, with findings to be reported later this year.

stories.h: Auditor Hafiz Mahir oglu Ismayilbeyli's term at the State Accounting Council is set to be extended
stories.s: The extension was proposed for discussion at the Milli Majlis Economic Policy Committee meeting, following his original appointment by the 22 Oct 2019 parliamentary decision.

stories.h: Azərbaycan Mərkəzi Bankı Slovakiya Milli Bankı ilə Niyyyət Memorandumu imzaladı
stories.s: Rəis Taleh Kazımov Dünya Bankı/IMF illik toplantılarında Peter Kazimir ilə görüşüb. Niyyyət Memorandumu monetar siyasət, ödənişlər, fintex, eləcə də bankların, sığorta şirkətlərinin və kapital bazarlarının nəzarəti sahəsində əməkdaşlığı gücləndirəcək.
stories.he: Azerbaijan Central Bank signs MoU with Slovakia's National Bank

stories.h: International Risk Forum organized by ABB held in Baku with CBAR deputy chairman and banking leaders
stories.s: The forum, supported by Mastercard, featured speeches by Toğrul Əliyev, Zakir Nuriyev and others on emerging risks like AI and cyber threats.

stories.h: MJ Finance BOKT ASC bonds fully placed at 2,000,000 AZN with 16% annual yield
stories.s: The auction, led by ABB‑Invest and Troni Investment, attracted 208 investors who placed 247 orders, filling the entire issue of 2,000,000 AZN at 100 AZN nominal value and 18‑month term

stories.h: Morgan Stanley's Andrew Sheets says market should lower ECB hike expectations
stories.s: Sheets, global head of fixed income research, cited French bond and equity volatility as a factor that could curb ECB rate hikes during his Bloomberg Surveillance interview.

stories.h: EU officials propose tighter rules for insurance risk transfer to banks
stories.s: The proposal aims to strengthen oversight of the booming insurance‑linked securities market as part of a broader package to ease securitisation access, according to Bloomberg.

stories.h: Mastercard retracts notice about Apple Pay and Google Pay disruption in Azerbaijan
stories.s: The payment network withdrew its earlier alert that the services were down, indicating the issue has been resolved or was incorrectly reported.

stories.h: 345,522 ASAN Imza electronic signature certificates issued in Azerbaijan Jan‑Sep 2026
stories.s: The figure, provided by the State Tax Service under the Ministry of Economy, is 4.4% lower than the same period last year and reflects a 7% drop in applications versus a year earlier.

stories.h: Uzbekistan and Azerbaijan agree to deepen cooperation on fintech and digital‑asset regulation
stories.s: The two governments said the partnership will focus on joint standards, supervisory frameworks and cross‑border information sharing, aiming to boost innovation while managing risks.

stories.h: Central Bank of Azerbaijan and World Bank discuss financial sector development trends
stories.s: Deputy Chairman Aliyar Mammadyarov and Deputy Finance Minister Anar Karimov met WB Vice President Antonella Bassani at the WB/IMF Annual Meetings to review macroeconomic conditions and ongoing cooperation projects.

stories.h: Top five Azerbaijani banks hold 71.5% of sector assets as of 1 Oct 2026
stories.s: ABB, Kapital Bank, PAŞA Bank, Xalq Bank and Bank Respublika together control 45.51 billion manat, up from 71.0% in January, with the HHI rising to 1,472, CBAR Governor Shahin Mahmudzade said concentration remains moderate.

stories.h: Fitch Ratings expects Azerbaijan's sovereign external assets to reach $91 billion in 2026
stories.s: Erik Arispe Morales said the assets of the Central Bank and State Oil Fund will total about $91 billion, about 73% of GDP, supporting a stable BBB rating outlook.

stories.h: Kapital Bank finances its first energy‑efficiency project, installing solar panels
stories.s: The loan, under the Energy Efficiency Fund with EMTA, aims to save about 50,000 cubic metres of natural gas and avoid 100 tonnes of CO₂ emissions annually, marking the bank's push into green financing.

stories.h: İKZF plans to issue 50 million manat mortgage bond series of 50 000 notes
stories.s: The 3% annual interest, 7 560‑day term bonds will fund long‑term mortgage lending; issuance date is pending and the fund’s recent loan volume fell 13.7% YoY.

stories.h: Azerbaijani‑invested companies in Georgia exceed 5,500, total investment $3.6 bn
stories.s: Ambassador Faiq Quliyev said trade turnover between the two countries is $1.4 bn annually and aims to reach $2 bn, highlighting deepening economic ties.

stories.h: Kapital Bank ranks second with 587.5 million manat in Q3 2026 mortgage loans
stories.s: ABB leads with 1.8 billion manat, while Xalq Bank placed third with 532.2 million manat, according to Banco.az data for Jan‑Sep 2026.

stories.h: PAŞA Həyat launches mandatory workers' insurance with tariffs of 0.2‑0.5% for caregivers and 0.4‑2.0% for laborers
stories.s: The insurer says premiums are calculated on the annual payroll fund, e.g., a 100,000 manat payroll yields 200‑500 manat for caregivers and 400‑2,000 manat for laborers, covering death or loss of work capacity from industrial accidents or occupational diseases

stories.h: Banco.az publishes ranking of Azerbaijani banks for business loans
stories.s: The study by Gülnar Əhmədli evaluates banks' performance in providing business credit, listing them by criteria such as loan volume and terms.

stories.h: China's PBOC signals overnight reverse repo rate will become new policy benchmark
stories.s: The People's Bank of China indicated the overnight reverse repurchase rate will replace the current seven‑day rate, aligning China’s monetary framework with global peers, Bloomberg reports.

stories.h: Depozit Sığortası Fondu Mərkəzi Bankın Bank BTB-nin lisenziyasını ləğv etməsindən sonra 21 iştirakçı bankı siyahıya daxil edib
stories.s: 5 avqust 2026 tarixinə olan yenilənmiş reyestrə əsasən, proqramda 21 bank və filialı qeydə alınıb, Bank BTB isə 27 iyul 2026 tarixli Mərkəzi Bankın İdarə Heyəti qərarı ilə siyahıdan çıxarılıb.
stories.he: Deposit Insurance Fund lists 21 participating banks after CBAR revokes Bank BTB licence

stories.h: Kapital Bank leads consumer loan volume in nine‑month period, followed by ABB and Bank of Baku
stories.s: Based on financial statements up to 1 October, Kapital Bank held the top share of consumer credit, with Azerbaijan International Bank second and Bank of Baku third, according to Banco.az analysis.

stories.h: Bank Avrasiyası (III rüb, 2026): aktivlər 239,2 milyon manat (+17%); kredit portfeli 139,5 milyon manat; depozitlər 89,7 milyon manat
stories.he: Bank Avrasiya reports Q3 2026 profit rise to 10.1 million manat

stories.h: Central Bank of Azerbaijan's Nakhchivan office will hold mobile citizen receptions in Ordubad and Julfa on 22 Oct 2026
stories.s: The events aim to address financial‑service queries from consumers and investors, with support offered via the bank’s 966 hotline and a WhatsApp line (+994 55 966 19 66).

stories.h: World Bank plans to allocate $500 million to the Livable Baku infrastructure project
stories.s: The initiative, costing $591.25 million overall, includes $410 million initially earmarked and a $91.25 million government contribution, with funding routed through the IBRD and project approval expected by 18 Feb 2027.

stories.h: Xalq Bank offers consumer loans up to 250,000 AZN with rates starting at 12%
stories.s: The loan term is up to 59 months, FİFD ranges 15.21‑39.35%, and the promotional rate is valid until 30 Dec 2026, with a 0.5% commission minimum 20 AZN.

stories.h: Mərkəzi Bank MJ Finance BOKT ASC və MMK-014 MMC rəsmilərinə ümumilikdə 3 000 manat cərimə kəsib
stories.s: Nərimanov rayon məhkəməsi MJ Finance BOKT ASC rəsmisinə AML pozuntuları üzrə 2 000 manat, Yasamal rayon məhkəməsi isə MMK-014 MMC rəsmisinə valyuta mübadiləsi qaydalarının pozulması üzrə 1 000 manat cərimə kəsib. Ümumi cərimə 3 000 manat təşkil edir.
stories.he: CBAR fines officials of MJ Finance BOKT ASC and MMK-014 MMC a total of 3,000 manat

stories.h: Rusiyanın kölgə filot tankerləri sanksiyalardan qaçmaq üçün saxta koordinatlardan istifadə edir – FT
stories.s: Financial Times-ın araşdırmasına görə, ən azı 12 tanker Bosfor boğazı üzrə hərəkətlərini gizlətmək üçün eyni anda həm real, həm də saxta koordinatlar ötürüb, altısı isə bunu eyni vaxtda həyata keçirib.
stories.he: Russian shadow fleet tankers use fake coordinates to evade sanctions, FT reports

stories.h: Brent oil fell to $107.88 on Oct 18, a 1.8% drop, raising concerns for Azerbaijan's budget and State Oil Fund
stories.s: The Ministry of Energy reports 19.9 million tonnes produced Jan‑Sept 2026 with 15.5 million tonnes exported, and the Finance Ministry warns lower prices could hurt the budget balance and fund assets.

stories.h: Kapital Bank sells 2 million manat of unsecured BOKT bonds to a foreign bank
stories.s: The bonds, nominally 100 manat each, carry a 10.5% annual yield and a 24‑month term, marking Kapital Bank’s first foreign‑bank funding via manat bonds; 208 investors placed orders for the MJ Finance 2 million manat issue as well.

stories.h: Euro falls up to 0.5% against the dollar amid France protests and Russia‑Ukraine tensions
stories.s: The euro slid to $1.1183 before partially recovering to around $1.1226 as investors react to heightened geopolitical risk in France and the Ukraine conflict, pushing French bond yields to 4.9% and CAC 40 down 1.5%.

stories.h: Azərbaycan Beynəlxalq Bankının kredit portfeli 10,9% artaraq 7 854 140 000 manata çatıb
stories.s: Portfel 2026-cı ilin 30 sentyabrı tarixinə 7 854 140 000 manata çatıb ki, bu da 2025-ci ilin sonuna nisbətən 774 156 000 manat (10,9%) artımdır. İstehlak kreditləri 2 224 060 000 manat, biznes kreditləri 3 801 753 000 manat, əmlak kreditləri isə 1 808 326 000 manat təşkil edir.
stories.he: Azerbaijan International Bank's credit portfolio grew 10.9% to 7,854,140,000 manat

stories.h: CBAR keeps USD at 1.7000 AZN, EUR rises to 1.9097 AZN on 20 Oct 2026
stories.s: The Central Bank of Azerbaijan reported the US dollar unchanged at 1.7000 manats, the euro up 0.02% to 1.9097 manats, and 100 Russian rubles at 2.0531 manats.

stories.h: Turkey to import Russian diesel after US sanctions exemption
stories.s: Turkish Energy Minister Alparslan Bayraktar said Turkey will purchase part of Russian diesel following a Moscow‑Washington agreement and a US Treasury temporary exemption until April 7, 2027.

stories.h: Azericard unveils new credit‑risk model with Mastercard, improves scoring by 3‑7%
stories.s: Azericard's deputy CEO Zakir Ahmadov presented a Mastercard‑co‑developed model that uses 56 indicators to predict payment delays, cutting default rates to 0.3% versus 16% in existing scores.

stories.h: Proposed pension law would cut individual pension capital share from 90% to 85%
stories.s: A draft amendment would reduce the portion of social insurance contributions directed to personal pension accounts from 90% to 85%, lowering a 1,200 manat salary holder's monthly contribution by 15 manat.

stories.h: Lawyer Ceyhun Məmmədvəliyev wins court order to be reinstated at his former bank
stories.s: Ceyhun Məmmədvəliyev, a lawyer dismissed from his long‑time bank, obtained a ruling from the Baku Nəsimi District Court restoring his employment, citing recent judicial reforms as a factor.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's $15.4 billion reserve cushion bolsters manat stability
stories.s: AzerNews reports that Azerbaijan's foreign exchange reserves have risen to $15.4 billion, strengthening the case for a stable manat amid external pressures.

stories.h: Azerbaijan manat ends week unchanged versus dollar, euro rate rises
stories.s: The manat closed the week flat against the US dollar while the euro rate increased, according to AzerNews on 2026-10-18.

stories.h: Turkmenistan's top bank holds 51.5% of internet banking volume over eight months
stories.s: The leading bank in Turkmenistan accounted for 51.5% of all internet banking transactions during an eight‑month period, according to Trend News Agency.

stories.h: CBA to extend risk‑based supervision to non‑bank financial segments
stories.s: Executive Director Fuad Isayev announced at the Sustainable Business event that the ARAS framework will be applied beyond banks from late 2025, covering corporate governance and internal controls.

stories.h: Bank of Baku (9 ay, 2026): faiz gəlirləri 164 milyon 93 min manat (+27%)
stories.he: Bank of Baku's interest income rises 27% to 164.093 million manat in first 9 months of 2026

stories.h: Yelo Bank (9 ay, 2026): kredit portfeli 1 milyard 150 milyon 291 min manat (+5,6%)
stories.he: Yelo Bank's business loan portfolio grew 7% to 46.864 million manat in first 9 months of 2026

stories.h: IMF warns of heightened global economic risks amid conflicts and energy price spikes
stories.s: IMF member states urged to expand financial support for countries facing economic hardship due to armed conflicts and rising energy prices, focusing on low‑and‑middle‑income and conflict‑affected nations.

stories.h: First Deputy Minister of Finance Anar Karimov discussed cooperation with IMF and ADB in Bangkok
stories.s: He met IMF Middle East and Central Asia Director Jihad Azour and Fiscal Affairs Director Rodrigo Valdés to review Article IV consultations and explore fiscal reforms and investment projects.

stories.h: CBAR Governor Taleh Kazımov says monetary policy alone cannot diversify Azerbaijan's economy
stories.s: In a Global Finance interview, CBAR Governor Taleh Kazımov highlighted that price stability, a sound banking system and market conditions are needed for diversification, noting non‑oil sector grew 5.5% in H1 2026.

stories.h: Oil price rise adds $1.2bn to Azerbaijan's current‑account profit, gas adds $0.9bn
stories.s: A 10 USD increase per barrel of "Azeri Light" crude is said to raise Azerbaijan's annual current‑account profit by $1.2 billion, while a $50 rise per 1,000 m³ of natural gas adds about $0.9 billion, according to CBAR Governor Taleh Kazımov.

stories.h: CBAR outlines plan to boost interest‑rate transmission, targets 6.1% inflation in 2026
stories.s: CBAR Governor Taleh Kazımov said the bank aims to deepen rate transmission while keeping inflation at 6.1% by end‑2026 and 5.8% by end‑2027, citing three priorities including market‑rate transmission and AI‑enhanced forecasting.

stories.h: Azerbaijan revokes licence of another insurance agent
stories.s: The regulator cancelled the operating licence of an insurance agency in Azerbaijan, removing it from the market.

stories.h: CBAR chair Taleh Kazımov meets SNB chair Martin Schlegel to discuss global financial challenges
stories.s: The Azerbaijan Central Bank and the Swiss National Bank held a meeting during the World Bank and IMF Annual Meetings, exchanging views on global challenges and future cooperation.

stories.h: FINKA Azerbaijan to auction 2 million AZN tranche of 5 million AZN unsecured bonds on BFB
stories.s: On Oct 13, Baku Stock Exchange will hold an auction for a 2 million AZN tranche of 5 million AZN unsecured, interest‑bearing, non‑documented bonds issued by FINKA Azerbaijan, each with a 100 AZN nominal value and 15% annual yield.

stories.h: Birbank launches SİMA digital signature for faster money transfers
stories.s: Birbank now allows transfers to be confirmed with the SİMA digital signature, removing the need for one‑time SMS codes for registered users.

stories.h: Uzbekistan bank lending up 7.4% to $53.8 billion
stories.s: Bank lending in Uzbekistan grew 7.4% year‑on‑year, reaching about $53.8 billion, according to Trend News Agency.

stories.h: US Treasury launches Operation Economic Outcast targeting Iran's international financial networks
stories.s: The U.S. Department of the Treasury announced Operation Economic Outcast, aimed at disrupting Iran's international financial networks and shadow banking structures.

stories.h: OFAC issues General License No.1 under Russian Harmful Foreign Activities Sanctions Regulations
stories.s: The U.S. Office of Foreign Assets Control published General License No.1 under 31 CFR part 587, modifying the Russian Harmful Foreign Activities sanctions framework.

stories.h: OFAC issues General License 60A under Venezuela sanctions regime
stories.s: The U.S. Office of Foreign Assets Control released General License No. 60A, authorizing certain transactions under the Venezuela Sanctions Regulations (31 CFR part 591).

stories.h: OFAC issues general license for transactions under ICC sanctions
stories.s: The U.S. Office of Foreign Assets Control has issued a general license permitting certain transactions that would otherwise be prohibited under its International Criminal Court sanctions regime.

stories.h: CBAR and Slovakia's National Bank sign MoU to boost cooperation in payments and fintech
stories.s: Chairman Taleh Kazimov and Peter Kažimír signed the agreement at the World Bank/IMF meetings, outlining joint work on monetary policy, payment systems, fintech and supervision of banking, insurance and capital markets.

stories.h: CBAR Governor talks Azerbaijan financial reforms in Global Finance interview
stories.s: The Governor of the Central Bank of Azerbaijan discussed the country's financial reforms during an interview with Global Finance, as reported by AZƏRTAC on 16 Oct 2026.

stories.h: ING says high oil prices and stable manat protect Azerbaijan from global shocks
stories.s: ING analysts state that elevated oil prices and a stable Azerbaijani manat are buffering the country against worldwide economic turbulence.

stories.h: Azerbaijan Central Bank discusses cooperation with UAE's ADCB and UBS Asset Management
stories.s: CBAR deputy chairman Aliyar Mammadyarov met with leaders of Abu‑Dhabi Commercial Bank and UBS Asset Management in Bangkok to explore cooperation and discuss macro‑economic and risk‑management issues.

stories.h: CBAR talks with BlackRock on possible cooperation
stories.s: The Central Bank of Azerbaijan held talks with BlackRock to explore potential cooperation, according to Trend News Agency and azərtac.

stories.h: Azerbaijan's Central Bank reviews financial sector trends with Swiss National Bank
stories.s: The Central Bank of Azerbaijan held a meeting with the Swiss National Bank to discuss recent trends in the financial sector.

stories.h: Azerbaijan State Oil Fund posts net revenue of $4.58 bn (₼7.78 bn) in Jan‑Sep 2026
stories.s: The State Oil Fund reported net revenue of about $4.58 bn (₼7.78 bn) from hydrocarbon sales in January‑September 2026, achieving 91% of its annual target.

stories.h: Azerbaijan Ministry of Economy forecasts 4.3% inflation by 2030 and GDP of 169.1 bn manat
stories.s: The Ministry projects average inflation falling to 4.3% by 2030, GDP reaching 169.1 bn manat (non‑oil‑gas 138.6 bn) and household income rising to 137 bn manat.

stories.h: Azerbaijan forecasts manat exchange rate to stay stable through 2030, inflation to fall to 4.3%
stories.s: The Ministry of Economy projects the manat will remain at its current level against the dollar through 2030, with average inflation dropping from 5.7% in 2026 to 4.3% by 2030 and GDP reaching 169.1 billion manat.

stories.h: 2027 state budget revenues raised by 20 million manat
stories.s: The Ministry of Finance increased the 2027 budget revenue forecast by 20 million manat, to 39.254 billion manat, a 1.7% rise over the 2026 forecast.

stories.h: Fed terminates enforcement actions against Gardner Bancshares and Small Business Bank
stories.s: The Federal Reserve Board announced on Oct 16 that it terminated cease‑and‑desist orders and a Prompt Corrective Action for Gardner Bancshares, Inc. and Small Business Bank, effective Oct 13, 2026.

stories.h: A‑Qroup Insurance paid over AZN 132,231 for oncology claims in first nine months of 2026
stories.s: A‑Qroup Insurance reported 69 oncology-related claims in the first nine months of 2026, covering diagnosis and treatment costs totaling more than AZN 132,231 for insureds both domestically and abroad.

stories.h: Foreign investment in Azerbaijan's core capital rises 16.5%
stories.s: Foreign investment in Azerbaijan's core capital increased by 16.5% according to the latest data released on 2026-10-16.

stories.h: Azerbaijan could attract $63.9 billion of investment by 2030, Ministry of Finance says
stories.s: The Ministry of Finance forecasts that up to $63.9 billion may be directed to Azerbaijan's economy over the next four years, focusing on non‑oil sectors.

stories.h: Azerbaijan allocates over 1.4 billion manat for foreign state debt servicing
stories.s: The government announced that more than 1.4 billion manat will be earmarked for servicing foreign sovereign debt in the 2027 state budget.

stories.h: CBAR holds talks with Abu Dhabi Commercial Bank and UBS Asset Management on sector trends
stories.s: The Central Bank of Azerbaijan met with Abu Dhabi Commercial Bank and UBS Asset Management to discuss financial sector trends.

stories.h: Azerbaijan Ministry of Finance forecasts oil price swings could affect State Oil Fund by up to $1.8 bn
stories.s: The Ministry’s medium‑term fiscal framework (2027‑2030) projects that a $5‑20 change in oil price per barrel could shift ARDNF assets by $0.9‑1.8 bn and alter the budget balance by 1.4‑2.7 percentage points of GDP.

stories.h: Azerbaijan Finance Ministry publishes 2027-2030 Medium-Term Expenditure Framework
stories.s: The Ministry of Finance released the 2027-2030 Medium-Term Expenditure Framework, outlining budget policy, fiscal risks, priority spending and program‑based budgeting reforms.

stories.h: CBAR forecasts inflation at 6.1% in 2026 and 5.8% in 2027
stories.s: The Central Bank of Azerbaijan, led by Governor Taleh Kazımov, projects inflation of 6.1% by end‑2026 and 5.8% by end‑2027, emphasizing price stability and interest‑rate transmission.

stories.h: CBAR publishes next‑day USD/AZN exchange rate
stories.s: The Central Bank of Azerbaijan announced the USD to manat rate for the upcoming business day on 2026‑10-15.

stories.h: Avropa Şurası Rusiya sanksiyalarından yayınmağa görə 3 şəxsə və 9 subyekta qarşı sanksiyalar qəbul edib
stories.s: Avropa Şurası sanksiyaya məruz qalan malların Rusiyaya idxal edilməsi və neft və maliyyə sanksiyalarından yayınma ilə ittiham olunan 3 şəxsə və 9 subyekta qarşı məhdudlaşdırıcı tədbirlər qəbul edib.
stories.he: EU Council adopts sanctions on 3 individuals and 9 entities for evading Russia sanctions

stories.h: Turan Bank III kvartalda xalis mənfəətini 35,6% artıraraq 2,2 milyon manat əldə etdi.
stories.he: Turan Bank posts 35.6% rise in Q3 net profit to 2.2 million manat

stories.h: Expressbank's credit portfolio rises to 592.4 million manat, up 7.8% YTD
stories.s: By end‑Q3 2026 Expressbank's loan book reached 592.4 million manat, a 42.7 million manat (7.8%) increase since the start of the year, driven by consumer, business and real‑estate loans.

stories.h: PAŞA Bank's credit portfolio grew 17% to 4.0019 billion manat by Q3 2026
stories.s: PAŞA Bank's credit portfolio increased by 569.9 million manat (16.6%) to 4.0019 billion manat in Q3 2026, with consumer loans falling 25.6% and business loans rising to 3.6825 billion manat.

stories.h: Expressbank reports Q3 2026 net profit of 9.9 million manat, assets up 8.8% to 725.4 million
stories.s: Expressbank disclosed its Jan‑Sep 2026 results: net interest income 70.2 m AZN, net profit 9.9 m AZN, total assets 725.4 m AZN (+8.8% YoY), and capital 130.9 m AZN (+3.6%).

stories.h: PAŞA Bank 2026-cı ilin III kvartalında 133,8 milyon manat xalis mənfəət və aktivləri təxminən 10 milyard manat olduğunu bildirdi.
stories.he: PAŞA Bank reports 133.8 million manat net profit and assets near 10 billion manat in Q3 2026

stories.h: ABB Bankın kredit portfeli 2026-cı ilin III kvartalının sonuna qədər 7,8541 milyard manata çatdı.
stories.he: ABB Bank's credit portfolio reaches 7.8541 billion manat by end of Q3 2026

stories.h: Xalq Bank 2026-cı ilin yanvar‑sentyabr dövründə 24,1 milyon AZN xalis mənfəət əldə etdi, kredit portfeli isə 3,4% artdı.
stories.he: Xalq Bank posts 24.1 million AZN net profit for Jan‑Sep 2026, credit portfolio up 3.4%

stories.h: Azerbaijan drafts legal framework for securitisation, CBAR to define eligible cash claims
stories.s: Parliament's Economic Policy Committee approved amendments to the Securities Market Law to create a securitisation framework, giving the Central Bank authority to determine eligible cash claims and exclude certain assets.

stories.h: PAŞA Həyat launches "GüclüSən" insurance offering AZN 30,000 for breast cancer patients
stories.s: PAŞA Həyat Sığorta introduced the "GüclüSən" life insurance product that provides a 30,000 manat benefit to women diagnosed with breast cancer, usable for any treatment abroad or locally.

stories.h: CBAR revokes insurance agent license No 080682 of Xədicə Rəhimli
stories.s: The Board of the Central Bank of Azerbaijan cancelled the insurance‑agent licence issued on 7 August 2015 (No 080682) to physical person Xədicə Rəhimli, citing non‑compliance with Article 107.1.2 of the Insurance Activity Law.

stories.h: Top 5 Azerbaijani banks by deposit portfolio for Jan‑Sep 2026
stories.s: Banco.az ranks the five banks with the largest deposit portfolios based on their Jan‑Sep 2026 financial data.

stories.h: Azerbaijan drafts law to enable securitisation, requiring Central Bank approval of plans
stories.s: The draft amendment to the Securities Market Law defines the framework for securitisation companies, agents and plans, mandating Central Bank approval and risk‑management provisions.

stories.h: PAŞA Bank shares rise 0.5% to 54.57 AZN ahead of nine‑month results and dividend
stories.s: PAŞA Bank's stock climbed to 54.57 manat, up 0.5%, as the bank reported nine‑month profit of 133.8 million manat and announced a dividend payout of 53.52 million manat.

stories.h: PAŞA Bank serves as official bank partner of Caspian Construction Week 2026
stories.s: PAŞA Bank acted as the official banking partner at the Caspian Construction Week held 14‑16 Oct 2026 in Baku, presenting financing solutions and supporting SMEs in the region.

stories.h: Azerbaijan fixes USD/AZN rate at 1.70 until 2030 in macro forecast
stories.s: The Ministry of Economy projects the manat will remain at 1.70 per US dollar through 2030, citing reduced currency risk and stronger deposits, with CBAR Governor Taleh Kazimov supporting the stable regime.

stories.h: PAŞA Kapital underwrites AZƏRMAŞ GROUP's 10 million AZN state‑guaranteed corporate bond issuance
stories.s: PAŞA Kapital acted as underwriter for AZƏRMAŞ GROUP's 10 million AZN corporate bonds guaranteed by the State Mortgage and Credit Guarantee Fund, fully placed on Baku Stock Exchange on 15 Oct 2026 with 71 investors.

stories.h: Basel Committee finalises amendments to curb G‑SIB window‑dressing, raises reporting threshold
stories.s: The Basel Committee published final amendments requiring G‑SIBs to disclose indicator averages over the reporting year and raising the leverage‑ratio exposure threshold to €350 billion, with implementation by Jan 2030 and 2027 respectively.

stories.h: ECB President Lagarde emphasizes sustainable public finances in Thailand speech
stories.s: Christine Lagarde highlighted the role of sound public finances for economic stability while addressing budget ministers worldwide in Thailand.

stories.h: Bank of Russia finds market manipulation by Vadim Solomakhin of Kinetic Capital
stories.s: The Bank of Russia confirmed that Vadim Solomakhin, CEO and beneficial owner of Kinetic Capital, manipulated trades on the Moscow Exchange, causing price distortions and losses to the firm, and issued prohibitions and referrals to law enforcement.

stories.h: Turkey to enact new capital‑market abuse law by early 2027 after fund crisis
stories.s: Turkey aims to pass legislation by early 2027 to curb capital‑market crimes after a fund turmoil that saw 131 funds suspended, half‑million investors affected and over 80 arrests.

stories.h: ECB approves UniCredit's €35 bn takeover of Commerzbank
stories.s: The European Central Bank authorized UniCredit to cross the 30% equity threshold and increase its stake in Commerzbank, paving the way for a €35 bn acquisition and a future 50% voting control.

stories.h: Expressbank announces tender for FortiGate firewalls
stories.s: Expressbank ASC issued a tender to purchase FortiGate 901G and 701G firewalls, with proposals due by 28 Oct 2026 12:00 at Dəmirçi Plaza, Baku.

stories.h: Azerbaijan Parliament passes amendment expanding CBAR supervision to financial groups
stories.s: The draft amendment to the Law on the Central Bank of Azerbaijan, approved in first reading, extends the CBAR's oversight from individual institutions to entire financial groups, including banks, insurers, reinsurers, investment firms and fund managers.

stories.h: ADB allocates over $652 million for Azerbaijan rail and metro upgrades
stories.s: The Asian Development Bank approved a $350 million loan for the 192‑km Bilajari‑Yalama double‑track railway electrification and a $302.38 million loan for modernising Baku Metro signalling, part of a $652 million package.

stories.h: World Bank Group mobilizes about $100 million private capital for Azerbaijan in FY 2026
stories.s: The World Bank Group deployed roughly $100 million of private capital to Azerbaijan during fiscal year 2026 to support productivity, job creation and sustainable development projects.

stories.h: CBAR chair says 2025 financial sector strategy implementation reached 85.6%
stories.s: Taleh Kazımov told Global Finance that the 2024‑2026 financial sector development strategy’s execution level was 85.6% in 2025, up from 81.8% in 2024, a 3.8‑point rise.

stories.h: IMF deputy chief Bo Li praises Azerbaijan's progress in diversifying non‑oil revenues
stories.s: IMF Deputy Managing Director Bo Li told Finance Deputy Minister Anar Kərimov that Azerbaijan's reforms to broaden the economy and strengthen fiscal resilience are viewed positively.

stories.h: Finance Deputy Minister Anar Karimov seeks expanded IMF technical assistance for fiscal reforms
stories.s: Deputy Minister of Finance Anar Karimov told IMF Deputy Managing Director Bo Li that Azerbaijan wants to broaden IMF technical assistance for public finance management, medium‑term budgeting and fiscal risk monitoring.

stories.h: CBAR plans to expand AI use in monetary policy, says Governor Taleh Kazimov
stories.s: The Central Bank of Azerbaijan announced that data analytics and AI will be a priority to improve forecasting, strengthen rate transmission and broaden AZIR-linked instruments.

stories.h: Ziraat Bank Azerbaijan launches 15 million manat second tranche of unsecured bonds with 10% annual yield
stories.s: Ziraat Bank Azerbaijan started subscription for the second tranche of a 15 million manat bond issue (150 000 x 100 manat) offering 10% annual coupon and 12‑month term, with trading approved by BFB.

stories.h: Azerbaijan Deposit Insurance Fund signs memorandum with Uzbekistan Deposit Insurance Agency
stories.s: The Azerbaijan Deposit Insurance Fund (ƏSF) and Uzbekistan's Deposit Insurance Agency signed a memorandum of cooperation at an international conference in Bukhara to strengthen deposit insurance systems and share best practices.
